chapters.title: Chapter 951 - 490: Frenzied Advancement (Part 2)
paragraphs: "In that case, let’s absorb that half of the rule first."
With this thought, Han Xing directly took out the glowing half of a nerve network from his backpack.
Then, he retrieved the three Divine Formats obtained from the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s Nest and the five acquired from Samoyed.
At this moment, eight Divine Formats, plus the half glowing nerve network, floated in front of Han Xing.
In the next moment.
Han Xing directly released his Divine Power, covering it all.
Crack! Crack!
All eight Divine Formats shattered.
Including that half glowing nerve network, was directly absorbed by Han Xing.
A system notification appeared.
[Successfully absorbed Divine Grade·Absorption, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully absorbed Divine Breath, Divine Power Value +2000]
[Successfully absorbed Divine Format: Distortion, Divine Power Value +4000]
[Successfully absorbed Divine Barrier, Divine Power Value +2500]
[Successfully absorbed Divine Form: Illusion, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully absorbed Divine Format: Iron, Divine Power Value +2000]
[Successfully absorbed Divine Grade: Mind, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully absorbed Divine Format: Domination, Divine Power Value +2000]
[Successfully absorbed the incomplete ’Forgotten’ Law, Divine Power Value +5000]
After a string of system notifications, a terrifying aura erupted from Han Xing!
The intensity of this aura even surpassed that of an average High-tier Demigod.
Even Cheng Jianyong, after his breakthrough, fell short of him!
Clearly, this was the most number of Divine Formats Han Xing had absorbed in history, leading to an unprecedented surge.
Eight Divine Formats plus half a complete rule.
Brought him a Divine Power Value increase of 26500.
Meanwhile, the aura surrounding Han Xing became even more profound.
He glanced at the complete rules he now wielded in his hands.
They were: Serpent, Ant, Poison, Demon, Bone Erosion, Hatred, six complete rules in total.
Then, Han Xing looked at his Divine Power Value.
[Divine Power Value: 93712]
"Great, directly broke through the ninety thousand barrier!"
"Just 11000 Divine Power Value short, plus 4 complete rules, and I can break the rules and make a single leap to Demigod!"
Han Xing was very satisfied.
Remember, from the time he arrived at the Land of Divine War until now, it had been less than two days.
In these two days, he had been almost continuously battling and traveling.
But similarly, the intense battles resulted in enormous gains.
He was a step away from the breakthrough to Demigod!
In Han Xing’s hand, there was still one Divine Format, the ’Judgment’ rule.
But because the God of Judgment was a True God Level entity, Han Xing previously dared not absorb it.
Han Xing looked at the God of Radiance and asked, "Radiance, the God of Judgment, shouldn’t be able to come here now, right?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "I haven’t sensed any residual aura of Judgment here; perhaps, like other True Gods, he’s also sealed inside the Forbidden Star River."
Han Xing nodded and then directly tossed a Divine Format to the God of Radiance.
The God of Radiance, in a daze, caught it.

Han Xing said, "Swallow it. This Divine Format can accelerate your breakthrough time by two years. I’ll see if I can find a few more True God’s Divine Formats later so you can reach the True God Realm as soon as possible."
Currently, the God of Radiance is already a Top-tier Divine Spirit, and his Power of Rules is in a perfect state.
He only needed five years of self-cultivation to naturally breakthrough to the True God Realm.
However, given Han Xing’s current pace, he couldn’t wait for five years, not even five months.
Therefore, Han Xing wanted the God of Radiance to breakthrough to True God as quickly as possible.
But since his rules are perfect now, ordinary Divine Formats have no effect on the God of Radiance.
Only True God Level Divine Formats, or complete Power of Rules, could accelerate the time for the God of Radiance to breakthrough.
"I understand.
The God of Radiance then held the Divine Format firmly without further ado.
Crack!
With the sound of shattering.
The God of Light absorbed the Power of Rules within.
At the same time.
In the depths of the Forbidden Star River.
A majestic figure, sitting cross-legged, floated mid-air.
This figure looked human but was enveloped in a peculiar aura, making it unclear whether it was male or female.
The aura from this being filled the entire space; where the eye could see, all lay within its Divine Power Domain.
Yet more terrifyingly, it was seated inside the Forbidden Star River, resisting the wash of the wild power within.
However, the terrifying force within the Forbidden Star River incessantly battered its Divine Power Domain.
Even such a formidable existence could only muster all its Divine Power to barely hold on.
Just then, this terrifying being suddenly opened its eyes.
"My Power of Rules, absorbed?"
"The audacity!"
"Who is it?"
With a hint of anger in its voice, it stood up, seemingly preparing to burst out of the Forbidden Star River.
At that moment, the sky filled with starlight surged.
This terrifying figure, upon moving slightly, was suppressed by the overwhelming starlight, spitting out a mouthful of silver-white blood.
"Pu!"
This terrifying being quickly sat back down, entering meditation.
It took a long time to stabilize the tumult within.
Then, lifting its gaze towards the vast Forbidden Star River, it said in a deep voice, "For many years, I’ve sensed your power gradually weakening."
"You can no longer bind us for much longer."
"The day I breakthrough, nothing will be able to stop us!"
The God of Radiance, after absorbing the Divine Format, smiled and said, "Master, it’s already good enough."

chapters.title: Chapter 952 - 490: Frenzied Advancement (Part 3)
paragraphs: Han Xing nodded, then asked, "How much longer until the breakthrough to True God?"
The God of Radiance sensed the power within his body and pondered, "Previously, the master gave me a divine format of the God of Light, which accelerated my progress by two years."
"This ’Judgement’ divine format has further accelerated me by another two years."
"Now, it only takes one more year, or another True God’s divine format, for me to immediately break through to True God."
Hearing this, Han Xing felt a thrill in his heart,
He only needed to obtain one more True God’s divine format, and on his side, there would be another True God’s power!
Thinking of this, Han Xing was filled with anticipation.
Thus, he ordered, "Then let’s go. The next step is to take a look at this so-called Silent City."
"Find more divine formats, to help me or Radiance break through."
"By the way, investigate the clues and find out which races have the fragments of the Hunter’s body."
Saying this, Han Xing’s eyes turned cold.
Everyone nodded.
Then, Samoyed resumed its gigantic form, transforming into a Void Giant Crocodile, appearing in front of the Divine Demon Battleship to lead the way.
Everyone began moving straight towards the upper reaches of the Forbidden Star River.
Time flashed by, and two days later.
During these two days, all major forces in the Land of Divine War heard a shocking news.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin race, which had been dominant for many years in the Forbidden Star River, declared extinction.
Not only did the two divine-level creatures in the clan die, but not a single other Bone-Eroding Griffin remained.
After hearing this news, a large number of races rushed to the nest of the Bone-Eroding Griffin race near the Forbidden Star River.
But when they arrived, they found no trace of any bird’s nest.
Not only had those Griffins disappeared, but even the nest, which was as large as a star, vanished without a trace.
The strong ones from various races searched the area in bewilderment.
They speculated on who had secretly wiped out the Bone-Eroding Griffin race.
This news reached Silent City, catching the attention of the Ten Thousand Realms Alliance.
After all, although the Bone-Eroding Griffin race was notorious, it was still a member of the Ten Thousand Races Alliance.
Now being silently wiped out, even to account for other members of the Ten Thousand Races Alliance, they had to find out who did it.
Thus, Silent City quickly sent out three divine spirits to investigate.
Among them was a high-tier divine spirit.
With the means of these strong ones, they could quickly ascertain what happened at that time,
And the culprit, Han Xing and the others, were heading towards the direction of Silent City.
Three days later.
A message arrived.
They sensed Moya’s presence near the old nest of the Bone-Eroding Griffin.
And there were many eyewitnesses who saw Moya coming and going from that place.
Many clues pointed out that Moya was the one who eradicated the Bone-Eroding Griffin race and destroyed their bird’s nest.
Exterminating the Bone-Eroding Griffin from the Land of Divine War!
This news quickly sparked discussions among many strong ones in Silent City, and a meeting was temporarily convened.
In the center of Silent City, within a black building.
There gathered dozens of races and hundreds of divine spirits.
They came from different worlds, their appearances chaotic and varied.
There was a lion covered in spikes, a flower like an ice sculpture.
Among them, a divine-level creature resembling a black Violent Bear spoke: "Everyone, you all received the news that Moya first killed Borco and then wiped out the Bone-Eroding Griffin race."
"Various clues suggest that it might have already broken through to high-tier divine spirit."
Beside him, a birdman with three pairs of wings nodded, "I also received news that Moya indeed broke through to high-tier divine spirit."
"What do you plan to do about Moya?"
"It has killed so many divine spirits, already violating our Ten Thousand Realms Alliance’s rules."
"Should we send a top-tier divine spirit to capture it, or report directly to the True God of Yellow Sand?"
Hearing the name of the True God of Yellow Sand, all the divine spirits at the scene trembled in their hearts.
However, only a top-tier divine spirit or a true god could confidently deal with a high-tier divine spirit.
At the scene, many divine spirits remained silent, not speaking up immediately.
Because among these races, most didn’t even have a single middle-tier divine spirit.
To have them express a stance on dealing with a high-tier divine spirit.
If the other side found out, and then caused trouble, they would cry with nowhere to go for help.
Even those races with high-tier divine spirits found it difficult to make a statement.
At this time, a divine spirit of the Green-headed Eagle Race said, "I think we should just let this matter go, shouldn’t we?"
Hearing this, all the divine spirits on the scene turned their eyes towards it.
The Green-headed Eagle Race divine spirit said, "Although Moya took action and killed them, it was for a reason."
"Borco and the others saw Moya’s aura was weak, and tried to take advantage of the situation, but ended up being counter-killed by Moya."
"And as for the Bone-Eroding Griffin race, according to the information I received, Moya had old grievances with them too."
"Many years ago, the Bone-Eroding Griffin race hunted Moya, so now, it counts as legitimate revenge."
After listening to this Green-headed Eagle Race’s explanation.
All the divine spirits on the scene realized and nodded.
Then, they all laughed and said, "I see, since that’s the case, it’s not surprising then."
"Yes, yes, I don’t think there’s any need to report this matter to the True God of Yellow Sand. Disputes within clans are also quite normal."
The other divine spirits echoed.
They also didn’t want to bring about any more trouble.
At this moment, the birdman with three pairs of wings saw the opinions of the major races and nodded.
"If so, then this matter is settled; as long as Moya doesn’t continue to break the rules, it remains a member of our Ten Thousand Realms Alliance."
"On my side, I will also send people to remind it not to kill divine spirits of other races again."
"So, this meeting is hereby concluded."

chapters.title: Chapter 953 - 491: God of Prophecy, Signs of Treasure Emergence!
paragraphs: "Alright, this meeting is adjourned."
The gods present all breathed a sigh of relief, then scattered.
However, on the ceiling of this grand hall,
a terrifying figure, blood-red all over and with eight legs, had a look of interest in its eyes.
She gazed deep into the void, and in the next instant, her figure vanished.
At this moment, Han Xing and the others were still hurrying through the void.
They had already covered hundreds of millions of kilometers in the Silent Star River.
Han Xing asked, "Samoyed, how much farther is it to Silent City from here?"
Moya turned her head and replied, "Master, we’re close, probably about a day left in the journey."
Han Xing nodded.

At this moment, Moya said worriedly, "Master, I’m a bit concerned. We’ve consecutively slain Borco and wiped out the Bone-Eroding Griffin Race. This might incite hostility from the Ten Thousand Realms Alliance, that is, Silent City."
Han Xing asked in confusion, "Oh? Why?"

Moya replied, "Because the Ten Thousand Realms Alliance has rules; beings within the same faction are not allowed to slaughter each other at will, or they will face a collective extermination by the major races."
"In severe cases, it might even provoke the True God of Yellow Sand to take action personally."
Upon hearing the last sentence, Han Xing frowned.
"You mean a True God might come after us?"
Moya nodded, "Yes, such things have happened before in the Land of Divine War."
"A top-tier divine spirit among the Wraith Evil Bird Race wanted to break through to True God Level by slaughtering deities and seizing their Power of Rules in the Land of Divine War."
"After it killed seven or eight divine spirits consecutively, it provoked the True God of Yellow Sand to take personal action."
"Then, the True God of Yellow Sand killed that Wraith Evil Bird on the spot with just one move."
Han Xing was stunned, "Just one move?
"Is the gap between a top-tier divine spirit and a True God that vast?"
Moya nodded, "Yes, the difference between divine spirits and True Gods is like heaven and earth!"
Han Xing couldn’t help but look at the God of Radiance, "Radiance, didn’t you say you could hold out for a while against the True God of Judgment?"
The God of Radiance quickly coughed twice upon hearing this.
"Ahem... That’s right, Master."

"The True God of Judgment is a newly merged entity with the rules, weaker than other True Gods. Plus, having been suppressed in the Forbidden Galaxy for so long, its strength must have declined significantly."
"That’s why I said I’d be confident I could hold my ground against it for a while."
"Against a real True God, I could barely withstand a single move."
After the God of Radiance finished speaking, everyone rolled their eyes.
But Han Xing’s heart was shrouded in a layer of gloom.
Even though he had already highly estimated the existence of True God Level beings.
But now he realized that True God Level beings seem even more terrifying than he had imagined.
At this time, Samoyed said, "But Master, you need not worry. Although we’ve killed many divine spirits, it probably won’t provoke the True God of Yellow Sand to take personal action."
"Because the targets I chose all had grudges with me in the past, so there is a reason."
"Moreover, since so much time has passed and no one from the Ten Thousand Realms Alliance has come to find me, it shows that they don’t intend to pursue this matter further."
After Samoyed finished speaking, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Han Xing gave it a sidelong glance and said, "You rascal, remember to say everything next time."
"I was already preparing to run away."
Samoyed scratched its head sheepishly.
However, because its arms were really short, it looked a bit comical doing so.
Then, Samoyed continued to lead the way ahead.
Half an hour later, everyone suddenly noticed.
In the void ahead, there were several huge Sky Islands.
Upon them were many creatures with powerful auras.
They appeared to be of different races.
Han Xing saw Evil Dogs engulfed in flames, members of the White Bone Race with over a hundred bone arms on their backs, and a group of Cyclops-like giants made of rock...
At least six large Sky Islands were stationed in that area, maintaining a distance, seemingly on guard against each other.
"Samoyed, what are they doing?"
Samoyed turned back and replied, "Reporting to Master, they are likely waiting for the treasure burst in the Forbidden Galaxy."
Hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes immediately lit up.
"Oh? You mean they already know in advance that treasures will burst from the Forbidden Galaxy in this area?"
Samoyed nodded, "Yes, there’s a God of Prophecy in Silent City who can predict certain events through their Power of Rules."
"Many races purchase intel from him, predicting the next location of a treasure burst in the Forbidden Galaxy."
"However, this guy doesn’t have good business ethics and sells one piece of intel multiple times to earn more profit."
"Obviously, these six races all bought the same piece of intel and became the suckers."
Upon hearing this, everyone seemed to understand something and nodded knowingly.
Cheng Jianyong laughed, "Wow, this guy’s so shady, and you still buy intel from him?"
Samoyed said helplessly, "Even though we know this guy is shady, we still have to buy."
"After all, with the intel, they are only competing with a small number of people, so the pressure isn’t as big."
"If you don’t buy, you wouldn’t even know when a treasure burst will happen in the Forbidden Galaxy."
After hearing this, everyone nodded, feeling that Samoyed made a good point.
At this moment, all six races had divine spirit level beings.
When they saw Samoyed’s massive figure appear, they suddenly felt a bit nervous.

Han Xing couldn’t help but look at the God of Radiance, "Radiance, didn’t you say you could hold out for a while against the True God of Judgment?"
The God of Radiance quickly coughed twice upon hearing this.
"Ahem...
That’s right, Master."
"The True God of Judgment is a newly merged entity with the rules, weaker than other True Gods.
Plus, having been suppressed in the Forbidden Galaxy for so long, its strength must have declined significantly."
"That’s why I said I’d be confident I could hold my ground against it for a while."
"Against a real True God, I could barely withstand a single move."
After the God of Radiance finished speaking, everyone rolled their eyes.
But Han Xing’s heart was shrouded in a layer of gloom.
Even though he had already highly estimated the existence of True God Level beings.
But now he realized that True God Level beings seem even more terrifying than he had imagined.
At this time, Samoyed said, "But Master, you need not worry.
Although we’ve killed many divine spirits, it probably won’t provoke the True God of Yellow Sand to take personal action."
"Because the targets I chose all had grudges with me in the past, so there is a reason."
"Moreover, since so much time has passed and no one from the Ten Thousand Realms Alliance has come to find me, it shows that they don’t intend to pursue this matter further."
After Samoyed finished speaking, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Han Xing gave it a sidelong glance and said, "You rascal, remember to say everything next time."
"I was already preparing to run away."
Samoyed scratched its head sheepishly.
However, because its arms were really short, it looked a bit comical doing so.
Then, Samoyed continued to lead the way ahead.
Half an hour later, everyone suddenly noticed.
In the void ahead, there were several huge Sky Islands.
Upon them were many creatures with powerful auras.
They appeared to be of different races.
Han Xing saw Evil Dogs engulfed in flames, members of the White Bone Race with over a hundred bone arms on their backs, and a group of Cyclops-like giants made of rock...
At least six large Sky Islands were stationed in that area, maintaining a distance, seemingly on guard against each other.
"Samoyed, what are they doing?"
Samoyed turned back and replied, "Reporting to Master, they are likely waiting for the treasure burst in the Forbidden Galaxy."
Hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes immediately lit up.
"Oh?
You mean they already know in advance that treasures will burst from the Forbidden Galaxy in this area?"
Samoyed nodded, "Yes, there’s a God of Prophecy in Silent City who can predict certain events through their Power of Rules."
"Many races purchase intel from him, predicting the next location of a treasure burst in the Forbidden Galaxy."
"However, this guy doesn’t have good business ethics and sells one piece of intel multiple times to earn more profit."
"Obviously, these six races all bought the same piece of intel and became the suckers."
Upon hearing this, everyone seemed to understand something and nodded knowingly.
Cheng Jianyong laughed, "Wow, this guy’s so shady, and you still buy intel from him?"
Samoyed said helplessly, "Even though we know this guy is shady, we still have to buy."
"After all, with the intel, they are only competing with a small number of people, so the pressure isn’t as big."
"If you don’t buy, you wouldn’t even know when a treasure burst will happen in the Forbidden Galaxy."
After hearing this, everyone nodded, feeling that Samoyed made a good point.
At this moment, all six races had divine spirit level beings.
When they saw Samoyed’s massive figure appear, they suddenly felt a bit nervous.

chapters.title: Chapter 954 - 491: God of Prophecy, Signs of Treasure Emergence! (Part 2)
paragraphs: One of the flaming evil dogs reprimanded, "Moya, this place has already been claimed by us. Leave quickly, or bear the consequences."
Han Xing and the others sensed the aura of this flaming evil dog, possessing the strength of a middle-tier divine spirit.
No wonder this guy dared to be so arrogant.
Just then, it seemed a strong presence nearby offered it a reminder.
The flaming evil dog’s expression changed.
After all, everyone knows now that Moya has broken through to a high-tier divine spirit.
And furthermore, has successively slain Borco, the Bone-Eroding Griffin, a total of five divine level beings.
In the impressions of other races in the Land of Divine War.
Samoyed has become a cunning, fierce, and tiger-eating pig presence.
Whoever provokes it gives the counterpart a reason to strike.
Including the other five races’ divine spirits on the field, none dared to utter a word.
Cheng Jianyong mocked from the back, "Samoyed, you’re notorious now, your name alone scares them into silence."
Samoyed turned around and smiled helplessly.
Han Xing asked, "Samoyed, do you know what treasures might appear in this place?"
Samoyed thought for a moment, gazing into the depths of the Forbidden Star River, at that fluctuating area.
Then slowly said, "Back to master, the fluctuations do not seem strong, most likely some divine format or fragments of power of rules will appear."
"Of course, there could also be some corpses of strong beings or complete rules, but the probability is rather low."
Upon hearing, Han Xing nodded.
Then said, "Samoyed, go tell them the treasure here belongs to us."
"If they are smart, they should leave quickly, otherwise you, Samoyed, will get rid of them all."
Upon hearing, Samoyed’s eyes showed bitterness once more.
Goodness, he’s planning to make me the villain again!
It realized that throughout this journey it did nothing but take the blame for Han Xing and the others.
Now everyone believes that Borco was slain by it.
The divine spirit of the Bone-Eroding Griffin race was also slain by it.
Truly notorious in the Land of Divine War.
Once Han Xing and others leave, Samoyed doesn’t know how to act anymore.
However, it has already pledged a lifelong vow with this human race and must follow this master henceforth.
Upon thinking, Samoyed felt indifferent.
Anyway, it didn’t care about so-called reputation.
Thus, Samoyed changed its expression, a fierce smile appeared on its face.
It looked at the six Sky Islands on the field and shouted, "Frank, you said this place is yours, how come I don’t know?"
"I clearly had my eyes on this place first, as early as half a year ago, I foresaw this place would burst with treasures, that’s why I intentionally waited here today."
"Be smart and roll away quickly!"
Upon hearing Samoyed’s assertive declaration, not only the flaming evil dog but other strong beings of the five major races were stunned.
They looked at Samoyed puzzled and asked, "Moya, what do you mean?"
Samoyed sneered, "Don’t you understand what I mean?"
"I said, I had my eyes on this place first, all of you quickly roll away!"
Upon saying this, the expressions of all the strong beings were very unpleasant.
The flaming evil dog angrily stated, "Moya, don’t be too arrogant, this place is clearly claimed by us, you just happened to come here."
However, Samoyed stated, "I’m arrogant, what can you do?"
"I give you thirty seconds to leave this place."
"Any being staying here after thirty seconds, bear the consequences yourself!"
On the field, not only the flaming evil dog, even the divine spirits on the other five Sky Islands felt some anger.
"Arrogant!"
"Maniac!"
At this moment, the flaming evil dog couldn’t bear it anymore and directly charged at Samoyed.
"Roar!"
It transformed into a giant void dog, occupying a million meters in size.
Black red flames roasted the void as if twisting it.
Opening its giant mouth, it’s about to bite Samoyed.
Samoyed’s heart pounded violently.
Oh crap! Overplayed!
This fellow has too explosive a temper; a few words from me and it ignited.
If real combat ensues, my true strength would be immediately exposed!
However, despite the turmoil inside Samoyed’s mind.
It stood unmoving and maintained.
A smile full of interest, watching the opponent’s attack actions.
The more Samoyed behaved this way, the more uncertain the evil dog felt.
It inevitably fell into speculation.
Samoyed, this guy is so calm, surely has definitively broken through to high-tier divine spirit.
Its previous words were deliberately to anger me.
If I make the first move on it now, won’t I be giving it a chance to kill me?
Later, even if it swallows me, Silent City won’t be able to cause trouble for it.
Since I’m the one striking first.
Thinking of this, flame evil dog’s figure with open mouth halted in mid-air.
This scene left everyone on the field dumbfounded.
Simultaneously, Samoyed’s tightly squeezed heart slightly relaxed.
But it did not reveal it, still using an interested tone, said, "Frank, what’s wrong?"
"Did you want to attack me just now?"
"Why did you stop?"
Facing Samoyed’s questioning and its expression.
This moment, that flaming evil dog finally affirmed, this guy was deliberately luring me!
It looked at Samoyed coldly and said, "Moya, you indeed have broken through to high-tier divine spirit."

chapters.title: Chapter 955 - 491: God of Prophecy, Signs of Treasure Emergence!
paragraphs: "You want to lure me into making the first move, and then take the opportunity to deal with me."
"I won’t fall for your trick!"
Upon hearing the Flaming Evil Dog’s words, the five remaining divine spirits from the other races changed their expressions drastically.
After all, among the many divine spirits present, the strongest was Frank, a middle-tier divine spirit.
A high-tier divine spirit was a formidable force throughout the Forbidden Star River.
They were no match for Samoyed.
At this moment, after the Flaming Evil Dog finished speaking, it directly returned to its Sky Island.
It turned around, glaring hatefully at Samoyed.
"Moya, I’ll remember that you robbed me of my treasure today!"
Having spoken, the Flaming Evil Dog unhesitatingly controlled its Sky Island to turn and leave.
After all, compared with the possible treasures here, its life and its race were more important,
Meanwhile, seeing the Flaming Evil Dogs leave,
the powerful ones from the other races exchanged glances and also controlled their Sky Islands to leave this place.
Their steps were hurried, as if fearing that Samoyed would turn its sights on them.
The six Sky Islands transformed into six streaks of light, quickly disappearing into the void.
Until the presence of these six formidable beings was no longer detectable,
Samoyed finally breathed a heavy sigh of relief and then, still shaken, said, "Phew... It’s a good thing Frank didn’t make a move on me."
"If that crazy dog had bitten me even once, I would have been exposed!"
Seeing Samoyed’s frightened expression, Han Xing laughed, "Samoyed, your acting is impressive."
"I even thought you were going to get exposed."
Samoyed nodded with a wry smile.
At this moment, Han Xing spoke again.
"After I finish breaking through, if there’s any extra Divine Format or Power of Rules, I’ll give you one so you can regain your Divine Spirit Level combat strength."
Hearing these words, Samoyed’s eyes brightened.
It had suffered severe injuries from withstanding a bombardment wave from Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship.
Although it survived in the end, its strength was significantly reduced,
and more seriously, it might never again reach the middle-tier divine spirit level.
However, having narrowly escaped death, Samoyed was content.
Now, hearing Han Xing saying that he would grant it the rules to restore its strength,
Samoyed was filled with anticipation.
It excitedly said, "I am willing to face any challenge for my master!"
Then, they remained in place, continuing to wait.
At a place millions of kilometers away from this area, the divine spirits of the six great races gathered together again.
Among them, a Cyclops Race divine spirit asked in confusion, "Frank, are you sure that Moya really broke through to become a high-tier divine spirit?"
"I carefully sensed several times before leaving."
"No matter how I sensed, Moya’s aura is only at the level of an ordinary divine spirit, or even weaker."
"Are you sure there’s no mistake?"
Listening to this, the Flaming Evil Dog cast a ferocious look and said, "You’re right, if I made a mistake, do you want to test it?"
Hearing this, the face of the Cyclops immediately stiffened, and he said, "You’re a middle-tier divine spirit and didn’t dare to make a move, where would I find the courage?"
The Flaming Evil Dog replied, "That’s right."
"This guy deliberately suppressed his aura to such a weak level, yet he was completely unconcerned with my attack."
"Would a regular divine spirit dare to do that, except a high-tier divine spirit?"
Hearing this, the divine spirits of the other five races all nodded.
They also agreed with the Flaming Evil Dog’s statement,
At this moment, a woman from the White Bone Race said softly, "It seems that the Land of Divine War will gain another high-tier divine spirit level powerhouse, won’t it?"
The other divine spirits also sighed and quickly transmitted the relevant information.
At this moment, Han Xing and others.
Were still intently watching the Forbidden Galaxy ahead.
The galaxy resembled a starry river in the void, the water composed of a peculiar energy, sprinkled with starlight.
In the direction Han Xing and the others were watching, the river surface seemed to be half boiling, constantly surging.
As time passed, the energy fluctuation in that area became increasingly intense.
This was a sign that a treasure was about to emerge.
Samoyed excitedly said, "I can sense it, it should only be a rather powerful Divine Format."
"This eruption’s treasure isn’t something too precious."
Upon hearing this, everyone felt somewhat disappointed.

After all, they had just arrived in the Forbidden Star River and stumbled upon the corpse of a Half-Beast, harvesting a large number of divine-level ferocious beast scales, along with a Godslaying Spike.
Regarding this upcoming treasure eruption, everyone expressed their great anticipation.
Yet Samoyed said it was just a Divine Format.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Divine Format is just a Divine Format, better than nothing."
"Think positively, if this eruption contains a True God’s Divine Format."
"Could we not directly give it to Radiance, allowing him to break through to a True God?"
Upon hearing this, everyone was taken aback, then realization dawned in their eyes.
Indeed!
The God of Radiance was only short of the last Divine Format to break through to a True God right then and there.
And when recalling Samoyed’s previous introduction, the difference between a True God and a divine spirit is like that between clouds and mud!
For a moment, everyone began to feel a sense of anticipation.
Just then, for some unknown reason,
the galaxy fluctuation in a small area suddenly underwent some changes.
Within the galaxy, a small vortex suddenly appeared, rapidly growing.
Gradually forming a massive energy storm.
Rumble!
The Forbidden Star River quaked continuously, as if something terrifying was about to emerge.
"Samoyed, what’s happening?"
"Didn’t you say only a Divine Format was going to erupt? Does a Divine Format cause such a commotion?"

chapters.title: Chapter 956 - 492: Discovering the True God’s Corpse
paragraphs: Cheng Jianyong asked in surprise from the rear, "Didn’t they say, only one divine format would burst forth? Why is the movement of a single divine format so massive?"
Samoyed was also unclear about what had happened.
It watched the swirling vortex in the Forbidden Star River with uncertainty.
"This is..."
"Is there some change in the treasure about to appear?"
"But this has never happened before?"
Samoyed was full of doubt.
At the same time.
Han Xing suddenly felt something vibrating in his backpack.
He opened the backpack, and a stream of light shot out swiftly.
"Whoosh!"
The sound of breaking through the air echoed, as the stream of light began to spin rapidly in the void, causing even stronger ripples in the vortex within the Forbidden Galaxy!
Everyone couldn’t help but look at the sudden stream of light.
It was a blood-stained arrow.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to understand something, a contemplative look appearing in his eyes.
Moments later.
As the blood-stained arrow kept spinning, the vortex in the Forbidden Galaxy grew larger and larger.
"Boom!"
Tremendous energy waves surged like a tide.
Then, Han Xing and the others saw.
A gigantic spherical body suddenly emerged from the vortex!
"It’s out? What is this thing?" Shen Yun asked in confusion.
However, this was not the full view of the thing within the vortex.
Everyone saw that the sphere was covered with thick yellow fur.
It looked like the head of some enormous creature.
Then, as the energy vortex continued to spin.
The upper body of the huge creature was also revealed.
Just like the head, the entire body was still covered with thick yellow fur.
Terrifying muscles bulged on its hairy arms!
Then, its entire body appeared.
It was an enormous ape, comparable in size to a star!
The aura from its body far exceeded the fluctuations of a top-tier divine spirit.
At the moment of seeing this gigantic ape.
Everyone on the scene felt a weight like a thousand pounds on their shoulders!
A terrifying pressure swept over them, causing their faces to blush.
Shen Yun gritted his teeth and asked, "Damn! What is this thing? A true god?"
Han Xing was also struggling to resist, he glanced up at the gigantic ape, then nodded, "It should be a true god-level existence."
"But fortunately, it’s already dead, it’s just a corpse."
Upon hearing this last sentence, everyone felt slightly relieved.
Compared to the Beast of Calamity, the feeling this gigantic ape gave was completely different.
It was a feeling akin to ants facing a giant elephant.
As if just moving a finger, it could easily crush them to death.
The God of Radiance said in shock, "This is... the True God of Mighty Power who commands the rules of mighty force..."
"It’s said to have the most terrifying strength among true gods of the same level, capable of shaking an entire world with mere power!"
"It actually died too?!"
Han Xing and the others were struggling to resist the terrifying pressure, and also heard the words of the God of Radiance.
Cheng Jianyong, while resisting, complained, "Damn! This guy is dead, yet the power of rules on its body is still so terrifying?"
Already heavily injured, Samoyed at this time was hit like a thunderbolt, almost fainting on the spot.
And at this moment.
The God of Radiance unleashed terrifying divine power, enveloping everyone in his divine power domain.
The domain isolated the rule suppression of the True God of Mighty Power.
Everyone let out a sigh of relief.
As a half-step true god, the God of Radiance could naturally easily resist the rule suppression here.
Cheng Jianyong said, "Old Guang, good thing you’re here.
Beside him, the God of Radiance nodded.
With that terrifying oppressing feeling gone.
Everyone began to curiously examine the body of this gigantic ape.
After all, this was the second true god-level creature they saw, aside from the Beast of Calamity.
However, as everyone’s gaze swept over, something peculiar was noticed, they didn’t see any wounds on this gigantic ape’s body.
But the ape was indeed dead.
So it was very peculiar.
Han Xing continued examining from the ape’s corpse upwards.
Finally, he discovered something unusual.
In the center of the ape’s forehead, an arrow was inserted.
This arrow appeared rather insignificant.
Comparing it to its enormous size, it seemed as small as a speck of dust.
However, that arrow was emanating with endless mighty power.
It forcibly sealed the divine body of the True God of Mighty Power.
Indeed, it was this arrow that killed such a terrifying existence as the True God of Mighty Power.
Han Xing then said, "Radiance, can you take us over for a closer look?"
The God of Radiance thought for a moment, then nodded, "Certainly."
With a flash, everyone transitioned from the cabin of the Divine Demon Battleship to the void.
At this moment, the God of Radiance released boundless divine power, forming a layer of golden eggshell, surrounding Han Xing and the other five within it.
Samoyed quickly shrank its body, following them inside.
Inside the golden eggshell, Samoyed cautiously glanced at the God of Radiance, noticing he wasn’t paying attention, it felt a bit relieved.
Then, under the God of Radiance’s control.
Everyone gradually approached the corpse of this true god-level creature.
The closer they got, the more intense the oppressive feeling from their souls became.
Even through the divine power shield of the God of Radiance, they still felt waves of suffocation.
Though the True God of Mighty Power was already dead, everyone gained a clear impression of the combat strength at the true god level.
Moments later, they finally approached this enormous corpse.

sentences.text: Cheng Jianyong asked in surprise from the rear, "Didn’t they say, only one divine format would burst forth?
Why is the movement of a single divine format so massive?"
Samoyed was also unclear about what had happened.
It watched the swirling vortex in the Forbidden Star River with uncertainty.
"This is..."
"Is there some change in the treasure about to appear?"
"But this has never happened before?"
Samoyed was full of doubt.
At the same time.
Han Xing suddenly felt something vibrating in his backpack.
He opened the backpack, and a stream of light shot out swiftly.
"Whoosh!"
The sound of breaking through the air echoed, as the stream of light began to spin rapidly in the void, causing even stronger ripples in the vortex within the Forbidden Galaxy!
Everyone couldn’t help but look at the sudden stream of light.
It was a blood-stained arrow.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to understand something, a contemplative look appearing in his eyes.
Moments later.
As the blood-stained arrow kept spinning, the vortex in the Forbidden Galaxy grew larger and larger.
"Boom!"
Tremendous energy waves surged like a tide.
Then, Han Xing and the others saw.
A gigantic spherical body suddenly emerged from the vortex!
"It’s out?
What is this thing?" Shen Yun asked in confusion.
However, this was not the full view of the thing within the vortex.
Everyone saw that the sphere was covered with thick yellow fur.
It looked like the head of some enormous creature.
Then, as the energy vortex continued to spin.
The upper body of the huge creature was also revealed.
Just like the head, the entire body was still covered with thick yellow fur.
Terrifying muscles bulged on its hairy arms!
Then, its entire body appeared.
It was an enormous ape, comparable in size to a star!
The aura from its body far exceeded the fluctuations of a top-tier divine spirit.
At the moment of seeing this gigantic ape.
Everyone on the scene felt a weight like a thousand pounds on their shoulders!
A terrifying pressure swept over them, causing their faces to blush.
Shen Yun gritted his teeth and asked, "Damn!
What is this thing?
A true god?"
Han Xing was also struggling to resist, he glanced up at the gigantic ape, then nodded, "It should be a true god-level existence."
"But fortunately, it’s already dead, it’s just a corpse."
Upon hearing this last sentence, everyone felt slightly relieved.
Compared to the Beast of Calamity, the feeling this gigantic ape gave was completely different.
It was a feeling akin to ants facing a giant elephant.
As if just moving a finger, it could easily crush them to death.
The God of Radiance said in shock, "This is... the True God of Mighty Power who commands the rules of mighty force..."
"It’s said to have the most terrifying strength among true gods of the same level, capable of shaking an entire world with mere power!"
"It actually died too?!"
Han Xing and the others were struggling to resist the terrifying pressure, and also heard the words of the God of Radiance.
Cheng Jianyong, while resisting, complained, "Damn!
This guy is dead, yet the power of rules on its body is still so terrifying?"
Already heavily injured, Samoyed at this time was hit like a thunderbolt, almost fainting on the spot.
And at this moment.
The God of Radiance unleashed terrifying divine power, enveloping everyone in his divine power domain.
The domain isolated the rule suppression of the True God of Mighty Power.
Everyone let out a sigh of relief.
As a half-step true god, the God of Radiance could naturally easily resist the rule suppression here.
Cheng Jianyong said, "Old Guang, good thing you’re here.
Beside him, the God of Radiance nodded.
With that terrifying oppressing feeling gone.
Everyone began to curiously examine the body of this gigantic ape.
After all, this was the second true god-level creature they saw, aside from the Beast of Calamity.
However, as everyone’s gaze swept over, something peculiar was noticed, they didn’t see any wounds on this gigantic ape’s body.
But the ape was indeed dead.
So it was very peculiar.
Han Xing continued examining from the ape’s corpse upwards.
Finally, he discovered something unusual.
In the center of the ape’s forehead, an arrow was inserted.
This arrow appeared rather insignificant.
Comparing it to its enormous size, it seemed as small as a speck of dust.
However, that arrow was emanating with endless mighty power.
It forcibly sealed the divine body of the True God of Mighty Power.
Indeed, it was this arrow that killed such a terrifying existence as the True God of Mighty Power.
Han Xing then said, "Radiance, can you take us over for a closer look?"
The God of Radiance thought for a moment, then nodded, "Certainly."
With a flash, everyone transitioned from the cabin of the Divine Demon Battleship to the void.
At this moment, the God of Radiance released boundless divine power, forming a layer of golden eggshell, surrounding Han Xing and the other five within it.
Samoyed quickly shrank its body, following them inside.
Inside the golden eggshell, Samoyed cautiously glanced at the God of Radiance, noticing he wasn’t paying attention, it felt a bit relieved.

Even through the divine power shield of the God of Radiance, they still felt waves of suffocation.

Moments later, they finally approached this enormous corpse.

chapters.title: Chapter 957 - 492: Discovering the True God’s Corpse (2)
paragraphs: Just like the beast’s corpse, the True God of Mighty Power’s flesh body also has a layer of divine power prohibition, blocking everyone’s divine power investigation.
Therefore, they can only rely on their eyesight to search the corpse of the True God of Mighty Power.
At this moment, Han Xing saw that the left hand of this giant ape held a black giant hammer.
That giant hammer was so enormous, its length reaching at least millions of kilometers!
Han Xing asked, "Radiance, is that the weapon usually used by the True God of Mighty Power?"

The God of Radiance observed for a moment, shook his head, and said, "Not sure. The True God of Mighty Power possesses the most terrifying power of the same tier and usually fights relying on the flesh body, forcibly suppressing the enemy."
"No one has ever seen it use a weapon."
Han Xing nodded and continued, "Let’s go over and see if we can take it down."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes instantly lit up.
If it can be taken down, then it is an extremely powerful artifact.
After all, it’s the weapon used by a True God.
At the very least, it is at the Divine Artifact Level?
Everyone slowly approached.
Because of the protection from the God of Radiance’s eggshell, they didn’t feel anything.
However, as they approached the mighty force, the God of Radiance furrowed his brow.
He felt that the closer he got to that giant hammer, the stronger the sense of oppression in his heart became.
Making even the top-tier Divine Spirit, the God of Radiance, feel a bit unbearable.
The God of Radiance took a deep breath, gradually entering a serious state.
He kept transmitting more divine power.
However, despite this, the God of Radiance still struggled to hold on.
"Crack! Crack!"
A series of cracking sounds were heard.
Everyone looked up, golden cracks appeared on the eggshell above their heads.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Oh damn, Radiance, can you make it?"
"Say something if you can’t hold it, if the eggshell breaks while we’re halfway, we won’t be able to bear it!
The God of Radiance took a deep breath and said, "I can do it, rest assured."
As if refusing to concede, he forced a breath.
After all, he is a top-tier Divine Spirit, just a step away from a True God.
Now a True God is already dead, not even able to resist the pressure from its body would be too humiliating to speak out.
Thinking of this, the God of Radiance extended both hands and suddenly clenched in the void.
In an instant, his body erupted with ten thousand rays of light again.
All these rays of light gathered together, frantically repairing that golden eggshell.
The golden eggshell became solid again.
Everyone gradually breathed a sigh of relief.
The God of Radiance indeed has some tricks up his sleeve.
Next, the God of Radiance continued to manipulate the eggshell, leading everyone forward.
When they came near that giant hammer, everyone seemed as small as dust under a mountain.
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, "Such a big hammer, how can we take it down?"
"Speaking of which, even if we take it down, can Xiaoyunzi use it?"
Shen Yun rolled his eyes at him and said, "How do you know I can’t use it?"
"You should know, artifacts like these should come with size-adjusting functions."
"Didn’t your Holy Artifact Battleaxe also have the ability to change size?"
Shen Yun’s words seemed to remind Han Xing of something, and he quickly responded, "Let me give it a try."
After saying that, Han Xing released a bit of divine power, gradually disengaging with this giant hammer.
The system notification appeared.
[Detected ownerless high-tier divine artifact: Eternal Storm Holy Hammer, would you like to collect it?]
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, it really is possible!
This thing is just like the Giant Beast Tail Spike, as long as you touch it with divine power, you can directly store it in the backpack!
So, Han Xing directly clicked yes.
At the same time.
In front of everyone’s eyes, the incredibly huge giant hammer suddenly vanished.
And the hand of the True God of Mighty Power also became empty again.
"Brother Xing, did you store it?" Shen Yun asked tentatively.
Han Xing smiled and nodded.
At this moment, a strong sense of joy appeared in everyone’s eyes!
After all, this is the weapon used by a True God, at least at the Divine Artifact Level!
However, Han Xing heard something different in the system notification.
That is, a high-tier divine artifact.
So, Han Xing directly asked, "Radiance, are there different grades among divine artifacts?"
The God of Radiance was startled and then nodded, "Indeed there are."
"Divine artifacts include those ordinary ones that only possess a bit of divine power, usable by beings below the Legendary Level."
"The power of this kind of artifact isn’t so strong, but it can provide powerful combat strength to five-tier and below existences."
Han Xing nodded, the ordinary divine artifact mentioned by the God of Radiance should be similar to the [Armor of Calamity], an artifact acquired in the early stages.
The God of Radiance continued to explain.
"Aside from ordinary divine artifacts, there are some basic ones, containing a portion of the power of rules, generally usable by legends and demigods."
"These basic divine artifacts are much more formidable, even an initial-stage legend possessing one can have the strength to confront middle-tier legends."
"Further up, are the mid-tier quality divine artifacts used by us divine spirits, only usable by existences that have mastered rules."
"Apart from that, there are the most precious and powerful high-tier divine artifacts, exclusive weapons of True God-level existences!"
Han Xing nodded after hearing this, and said joyfully, "It seems we made a good haul this time."
The God of Radiance said, "Master, do you mean the one just stored is a high-level divine artifact?"
Han Xing nodded.
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance also showed a hint of a smile at the corner of his mouth and agreed, "Indeed, lucky."
"Even among True Gods, there aren’t many who can possess high-tier divine artifacts."

paragraphs: "This powerful weapon can enable an initial-tier True God to possess the combat strength to deal with a middle-tier True God, a huge enhancement."
Upon hearing this, everyone became more expectant.
Han Xing looked at the two hammers in his backpack.
Both are of Divine Artifact Level.
The first one is a reward obtained after killing the God of Light, while the second one was acquired from the True God of Mighty Power.
Thus, Han Xing directly posted the attributes of both hammers.
[Hammer of Authority of the God of Light (Red)]
[Quality: Initial-tier Divine Artifact]
[Attack Power: 33273~34792]
[Attribute Bonus: Spirit+3000, Constitution+4000]
[Attached Effect 1: Eye of Light (Condenses Light Divine Power, gathers it in both eyes, sees through all disguises below divine-level, and additionally provides a 50% hit rate)]
[Attached Effect 2: Light Will (Legendary Effect, when releasing enhancement skills, there is a 50% probability of doubling the enhancement effect)]
[Attached Effect 3: Light Incarnation (Epic Effect, condenses Light incarnation, immune to 90% of magic damage received and 50% of physical damage for 60 seconds)]
[Attached Effect 4: Authority of Light (Divine-level Effect, holding light authority automatically absorbs Power of Light, enhancing one’s divine power, increasing 5 Divine Power Value daily)]
[Wear Requirement: Level 60 and above, demigod-level creatures]
[Eternal Storm Holy Hammer (Red)]
[Quality: High-tier Divine Artifact]
[Attack Power: 63723~66231]
[Attribute Bonus: All Attributes+5000]
[Attached Effect 1: Absolute Suppression (During attack, compares total attributes on both sides; if the enemy’s attributes are lower, deal an additional 50% suppression damage)]
[Attached Effect 2: Violent Holy Hammer (Legendary Effect, during attack has a 100% chance that this attack carries 200,000 points of true damage)]
[Attached Effect 3: Power Burst (Epic Effect, when releasing enhancement skills, there is an 80% chance of increasing the enhancement effect by 120%)]
[Attached Effect 4: Eternal Storm (Divine-level Effect, when releasing skills, has a 100% probability of extending skill duration by 50 seconds)]
[Wear Requirement: Level 70 and above, True God-level creature.]
After reading the attributes of these two hammers, Shen Yun exclaimed, "Wow! What incredibly powerful hammers!
"And there are two of them!"

Han Xing smiled, first handing the [Hammer of Authority of the God of Light] to Shen Yun, then said, "This hammer requires demigod-level to use, once you breakthrough to demigod, you can directly swap it."
Shen Yun was delighted as he took it, excitedly saying, "Thank you, Brother Xing!"
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the remaining black giant hammer in his backpack.
After pondering for a while, he directly handed the [Eternal Storm Holy Hammer] to the God of Radiance.
The God of Radiance, looking at the giant hammer in his hand that exuded infinite mighty power, suddenly had his pupils shrink.
He nervously asked, "M-master? Is this for me?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, aren’t you about to break through to True God?"
"This high-tier divine artifact, except for you, no one else here can equip it in the short term."
"Moreover, you are also a Light Attribute Divine Spirit, this giant hammer should greatly enhance you."
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance suddenly held his breath.
He knew better than anyone the precious value of a high-tier divine artifact!
Even True God-level beings rarely possess such mighty weapons, which are only second to holy artifacts.
Yet now, Han Xing gave such a precious weapon to him.
The God of Radiance’s body couldn’t help but tremble, and for a moment, he hesitated to accept it.
At this time, Shen Yun patted his shoulder and said, "Alright, Old Guang, accept it, don’t make a fuss."
"Following Brother Xing, you’ll have plenty of good food and drink, and divine artifacts won’t be lacking for you, understand?"
Listening to Shen Yun with a somewhat bandit-like tone.
The God of Radiance also smiled and took it lightheartedly.
Then, he secured the [Eternal Storm Holy Hammer], solemnly saying, "Thank you, Master. Radiance will fight to the end for Master!"
Han Xing smiled and then said, "Radiance, lead us further up."
The God of Radiance heard this and nodded immediately.
Then he led everyone, proceeding swiftly along the giant ape’s corpse.
Whoosh!
The Golden Eggshell transformed into a stream of light and swiftly rushed into the sky.
From the abdomen of this giant ape, they gradually approached the chest area.
Han Xing’s target this time was, naturally, the arrow acquired by the Hunter.
He wanted to try and see if he could take that arrow down.
Therefore, Han Xing needed the God of Radiance to take him to the giant ape’s forehead.
However, as they passed by the giant ape’s mouth, the God of Radiance suddenly stopped and frowned.
He began releasing boundless radiance, exploring the surface of the giant ape’s corpse.
Everyone watched him in confusion.
"Have you found anything?" Han Xing asked.
The God of Radiance nodded, "I sense something inside the True God of Mighty Power’s mouth."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes brightened and they asked, "What is it?"
The God of Radiance sensed for a moment, then shook his head, "Not too sure, need to go in and take a look."
Everyone was stunned.
"Does going inside mean entering this big monkey’s mouth?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes, Master."
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing didn’t mind, and then nodded, "Then take us there."
The God of Radiance retracted his divine power.
Then, everyone was led by the God of Radiance to the edge of the giant ape’s mouth.
At this moment, its mouth wasn’t completely closed, with a gap left.
However, despite just being a gap, it resembled a chasm thousands of meters wide.
This gap seemed to lead to some unknown world, pitch black inside.
Following this gap, the group gradually entered the mouth of the True God of Mighty Power, visibility dimming progressively.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong joked, "Doesn’t it feel like we’re small sheep sending ourselves to the monster’s mouth?"

chapters.title: Chapter 959 - 493: Hunter’s Gift, the Ultimate Killing Weapon!
paragraphs: The team members also smiled.
Fortunately, the True God of Mighty Power is already dead.
Otherwise, what they’re doing now is much like sheep entering a tiger’s den.
The oral cavity of the True God of Mighty Power is extremely dark, with no light at all.
But they have the God of Radiance, a ready-made light bulb, so illumination is not a problem.
"Buzz!"
As the divine power of the God of Radiance bursts forth, the space inside becomes as bright as daylight.
The oral area of the True God of Mighty Power is revealed.
At this moment, the God of Radiance continues to search.
A moment later, his eyes light up.
In the throat area of the True God of Mighty Power, the God of Radiance seems to have discovered something.
A chain of light instantly shoots over.
Whoosh!
Then, a small black sphere is dragged out by the chain of light.
It then appears in the hand of the God of Radiance.
Looking at this small sphere, Han Xing asked in confusion, "Radiance, is this the special item you sensed?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes, Master."
"On this, there seems to be some kind of mark left by the True God of Mighty Power, but I don’t know what this sphere is used for."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing directly said, "Let me take a look."
Although the God of Radiance does not know the purpose of this sphere.
But Han Xing and they know!
Because as long as these items appear in the hands of the Survivor.
The system will introduce the function of this sphere for them.
After hearing this, the God of Radiance directly handed the sphere to Han Xing.
Han Xing took it, and a system prompt appeared.
[Obtained Realm-Breaking Pearl of True God of Mighty Power*1]
[Realm-Breaking Pearl of True God of Mighty Power: Special Item]
[Item Effect: Through this Realm-Breaking Pearl, a hidden world in the void can be found and the treasure vault of the True God of Mighty Power opened.]
Seeing the effect description behind it, Han Xing’s pupils suddenly widened, and he exclaimed, "Holy crap! Treasure vault of True God of Mighty Power!"
At first, everyone was a bit confused.
However, when they heard Han Xing’s second sentence, everyone was immediately surprised.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, do you mean this thing is related to the treasure vault of the True God of Mighty Power?"

Han Xing nodded, "Not related to the treasure vault of the True God of Mighty Power, but with this thing, we can find the small world where his treasure vault is and directly open the treasure vault!"
Everyone held their breath upon hearing this.
They all know how immense the value of this small pearl is.
"Damn... a True God’s treasure vault, we haven’t opened a True God treasure vault until now!" Cheng Jianyong muttered.

Shen Yun also nodded, "Yeah, the wealth in a high-tier Divine spirit’s treasure vault like the God of Light is already incredibly impressive, I wonder how precious the treasures in the treasure vault of a True God like Mighty Power are!"
Upon hearing this, everyone became very expectant.
After coming out from the mouth of the True God of Mighty Power.
Han Xing took out the pearl first and sensed it.
Then he rolled his eyes and said, "Well, that place is at least a few months’ journey from us, can’t be opened in a short time."
Upon hearing this, everyone also expressed some regret.
Han Xing did not think too much about it, after all, this thing is in his hands, sooner or later he will be able to open it.
Han Xing looked at Radiance and said, "Radiance, well done this time."
Hearing Han Xing’s praise, the God of Radiance nodded, "Happy to serve the master."
Since Han Xing gave the Eternal Storm Holy Hammer to Radiance, he has become very polite.
Then, the God of Radiance led Han Xing to the forehead of the True God of Mighty Power.
Here, there is an extremely strong piercing power.
Just nearing ten thousand kilometers in the vicinity, cracks appeared on that Golden Eggshell.
Everyone could feel that the piercing power emanated from the arrow on the forehead of the True God of Mighty Power.
The God of Radiance took a deep breath.
Then continued to unleash divine power, moving everyone forward by about five thousand kilometers.
In this area, the piercing power emanating from the arrow became increasingly terrifying!
The Golden Eggshell was filled with dense cracks, seemingly ready to shatter at any moment.
Through the Golden Eggshell, everyone could feel a needle-like prickling sensation.
This pricking sensation is completely different from the tail spike of the Beast of Calamity.
In addition to eliminating some divine power, it also carried a sealing effect.
When they used their power, it was extremely difficult.
The God of Radiance almost gritted his teeth and advanced about two thousand kilometers.
At this point, he hurriedly said, "Master, I’m having a hard time holding on."
"The piercing law contained on that arrow is too terrifying, almost impossible for anyone below True God to approach!"
"I feel that if we go any closer, even I will be at risk of falling."
The God of Radiance’s face looked difficult.
Everyone deeply realized the terror of that single arrow.

Cheng Jianyong exclaimed at this moment, "Holy crap! A single arrow not only took down a True God, but even after all these years, this arrow still holds terrifying power enough to make a top-tier Divine spirit fall!"
"Is this the power of the Hunter? That’s terrifying!"
Others nodded in agreement.
After all, the fear of a True God is well known.
However, under the Hunter’s attack, a True God seemed to be only a matter of one arrow.
At this moment, Shen Yun looked at Han Xing and said, "Brother Xing, what should we do now?"
"We seem unable to go through."
According to the current situation, at least someone of True God level can approach this arrow.
With their current power, they indeed cannot pass.
However, Han Xing had a strange feeling.

chapters.title: Chapter 960 - 493: Hunter’s Gift, the Ultimate Killing Weapon! (Part 2)
paragraphs: He had a hunch that the Law on that Arrow didn’t seem like it would harm him.
So Han Xing said, "Let me try."
With that, he released a strand of Divine Power, letting it extend beyond the eggshell as a probe.
A moment later, Han Xing’s expression lit up!
Just as he’d anticipated, the Piercing Power in this area didn’t inflict any damage on him.
Moreover, because of the Arrow’s presence, it also suppressed the True God of Mighty Power’s Law of Giant Power.
So Han Xing not only suffered no harm from the Piercing Power, even the oppressive pressure brought by the True God of Mighty Power completely vanished.
Han Xing then said, "You wait here. I’ll go over and take a look first."
Hearing this, not only the team members, but even the God of Radiance all showed shock on their faces.
Before he could say anything more, they saw Han Xing already charge out of the Golden Eggshell on his own.
In that instant, the God of Radiance almost reflexively wanted to yank Han Xing back!

After all, that Piercing Law was something that could cause even Top-tier Divine Spirits, even True Gods, to fall; an ordinary Demigod or Legend, once stained by the slightest trace, would die on the spot.
Yet at this moment, he saw Han Xing standing in the Void completely unscathed, and slowly drawing closer to that Arrow.
The God of Radiance was stunned.
This scene seemed to overturn his understanding of the world.
Still, once he remembered that this was his master, he felt relieved.
After all, this man always managed to bring people one surprise after another.
Seeing that Han Xing was fine, Cheng Jianyong and the others also let out a sigh of relief.
Then, their gazes fixed on Han Xing’s back, watching him inch closer and closer to the forehead of the True God of Mighty Power.
Very soon, Han Xing reached the area near that Arrow.
Among a patch of bloodstained fur, Han Xing saw a feathered Arrow, deeply embedded at a point close to the True God’s glabella.
So Han Xing tried extending his Divine Power to pull out this Arrow.
He’d thought it would take a fair bit of effort.
But the moment his Divine Power touched the Arrow, he easily pulled it free.
[Obtained Hunter’s Burning Blood Arrow*1]
At the very instant the system prompt ended—
Everyone suddenly felt as though some change had occurred in the corpse of the True God of Mighty Power.
Crack!
As a sharp splitting sound rang out, everyone realized what that change was.
From the True God of Mighty Power’s brow, a terrifying fissure suddenly appeared.
This crack followed his cheek downward, instantly Piercing through his entire body.
Then, a second, a third appeared!
In less than a second—
On that vast body like a star, countless dense cracks spiderwebbed across the True God of Mighty Power.
Under everyone’s stunned gaze—
With a thunderous boom!
As if some colossal mountain range had collapsed—
The True God of Mighty Power’s body shattered into innumerable pieces in an instant.
Crash...
Fragments of the corpse filled the sky, drifting in the Void.
The flesh and blood that had looked so fresh at first, upon contacting the Void Energy for less than a second, rapidly withered and split.
Then, it turned into a mass of black powder and vanished into the Void.
"Damn... the True God of Mighty Power exploded?" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
After his initial shock, Han Xing also understood what had happened.
Originally, the moment the True God of Mighty Power was struck by this Arrow, his body should have shattered.
However, that Arrow was not only the ultimate killing strike that slew the True God of Mighty Power, it also sealed away the very last strand of Power within him.
That was why, after all this time, the True God of Mighty Power’s body had remained in a relatively intact State.
Now that Han Xing had removed it—
The True God of Mighty Power’s final strand of Power also dissipated.
Thus, his body completely collapsed in an instant.
At the same time, an enormous nerve-like network suddenly appeared across the sky.
And on that nerve-like network, there seemed to be an Arrow embedded as well.
An unprecedented shock appeared in the God of Radiance’s eyes as he cried out, "Rule of the True God!"
"It’s the True God of Mighty Power’s Power of Rules, my god!"
Hearing this, everyone lifted their gazes toward the sky.
After all, this was also the first time they had ever seen a True God Level Rule.
Compared to the Divine Spirit Level, this nerve-like structure was at least dozens of times thicker.
From what had once been a single leaf, it now seemed to have become a complete giant tree.
Its lush branches extended outward.
Cheng Jianyong asked doubtfully, "Radiance, didn’t you say the True God of Mighty Power was already dead?"
"Then what’s going on here?"
The God of Radiance calmed the shock in his heart, then sighed in awe, "That being’s methods are truly vast and unfathomable."
"He could have slain the True God of Mighty Power in an instant, and even shattered his Power of Rules on the spot."
"But that being chose not to do so."
"Instead, he chose to employ sealing Power, sealing the True God of Mighty Power’s Rules and flesh body alike."
"And now, because of your arrival, it seems some condition has been triggered."
"So the True God of Mighty Power’s body chose to manifest from the Forbidden Star River on its own."
"Then, because you removed that Arrow, the complete Rule of the True God of Mighty Power only now snapped apart."
"This was left specifically for you, Master."
At this point, everyone pretty much understood what had happened.
This thing wasn’t something they’d stumbled upon by coincidence.
It was something that being had left as a gift for Han Xing many years ago.
And this gift was incomparably precious.
A High-level Divine Artifact, a True God’s treasure vault key, plus a True God’s Rule.
Han Xing stood there, tightly gripping that bloodstained Arrow, his heart unable to calm for a long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 961 - 493: Hunter’s Gift, the Ultimate Super-killing Weapon! (3)
paragraphs: At this moment, the glowing Tree of Rules in the sky.
Also shattered along with the corpse of the True God of Mighty Power, exploding into fragments.
"Crack! Crack!"
All creatures across the Land of Divine War heard this crisp sound of breaking.
A sense of impending dread emerged from deep within the soul.
At this moment, whether it was True Gods or Divine Spirits, their expressions changed dramatically.
At the same time.
The rules in the entire Land of Divine War fell into unprecedented chaos,
a phenomenon that only occurs when a True God-level existence dies.
"Oh my god! What happened?"
"The Tree of Rules collapsed, could it be that a True God has fallen!"
Those below Divine Spirit level couldn’t perceive what happened.
However, the Divine Spirits acted as if the sky was falling, their faces pale, trembling all over.
They immediately rushed out of Silent City, starting to flee into the void in panic.
The entire Silent City was in chaos, they all felt it, that crisis from deep within the soul!
Yet, even though these Divine Spirits knew that some major event might have happened in the Land of Divine War.
They didn’t dare to investigate.
Even the terrifyingly powerful figure in Silent City chose to flee.
After all, it was an event where a True God fell!
If he went over, if the other could kill a True God, could he not kill him too?
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the hundreds of falling meteors in the sky.
A trace of complex emotion flashed in his eyes.
These meteors were each a Divine Format.
They fell into the void, merged together, and transformed into a miniature Tree of Rules.
In the void, this Tree of Rules was so bright and three-dimensional.
Like a 3D model.
It radiated sacred and vast Power of Rules.
Han Xing walked over and collected it.
System notification appeared.
[Obtained True God Rule: Giant Strength *1]
Han Xing sighed with emotion, this was the first True God-level rule he obtained.
Then, he checked the related attributes.
[Tree of Rules (True God Level)]
[Attributes]: Giant Strength
[Effect 1]: The complete ’Giant Strength’ rule, allows one to break through to the Divine Realm at the limit of demigod, becoming the new True God of Mighty Power, and unlocks level limit 80.

[Effect 2]: Exists at the Divine Spirit level, upon absorbing this Power of Rules, can directly replace the rule they possess, breaking through to level 80 in a short time, becoming a True God-level existence.
[Effect 3]: Direct absorption can increase Divine Power Value by 200,000.
After seeing the attributes, Han Xing sighed again.
It truly is deserving of being a True God-level rule.
This thing, both demigods and Divine Spirits can use.
As long as it’s used, one will surely become the new True God of Mighty Power in the future.
If other Divine Spirits get news of it, it will definitely drive them crazy.
Even True Gods would come running to hunt Han Xing for this Power of Rules.
Even if directly absorbed, it would allow Han Xing to increase Divine Power Value by 200,000, fulfilling one condition for breaking through demigod.
Han Xing looked toward the depths of the Forbidden Galaxy.
He knew this was a gift specially left for him by Hunter.
Han Xing softly said, "Thank you."
After returning to the side of the God of Radiance, Han Xing noticed the surprise in everyone’s eyes.
He smiled and said, "As you can see, this is the complete True God-level rule, that allows a demigod or True God to become the new True God of Mighty Power."
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance was indifferent, as he was about to break through to become a True God.
However, Samoyed beside them started breathing heavily.
A True God!
It was an existence it could only long for.
No, forget about a True God, even high-tier Divine Spirits, or top-tier Divine Spirits, were realms it could not touch.
And now, Han Xing says.
As long as this complete rule is absorbed, one is bound to become the new ’True God of Mighty Power’ in the future.
One can imagine how intense the shock was in Samoyed’s heart now.
Han Xing naturally saw Samoyed’s fervent gaze.
Han Xing glared at it.
Of course, he wasn’t going to give such a precious thing to Samoyed.
This [Tree of Rules], Han Xing planned to keep for himself.
"Now, only 3 more Power of Rules are needed!"
"The Old Tree previously needed 10 complete rules but didn’t specify what strength rules were needed."
"If I also use this True God-level rule to make a breakthrough, I wonder if there would be some different kind of change?"
"I’m afraid, even Hunter and Demon Emperor would have never done this when breaking through demigod?"
Thinking of this, Han Xing’s heart rose with excitement.
Because he was going to accomplish something those two had never done before!
"Samoyed, continue forward!"
"Take us to Silent City!"
Samoyed, upon hearing this, stowed away its heavy desire, then nodded solemnly.
It transformed back into a Void Giant Crocodile, leading the way up front.
The group began to move forward again.
During the journey, Cao Xing looked at the attributes of the Burning Blood Arrow in his backpack.
This was the most powerful item he obtained.
[Hunter’s Burning Blood Arrow]
[Quality: Unknown]
[Attack Power: 500 million]
[Attached Effect 1: Arrow of Destiny (The target locked by you will be hit 100%, ignoring rules, space, time, causing full damage)]
[Attached Effect 2: Sealing Heaven and Earth (The target hit will have all Divine Power and Power of Rules sealed)]
[Attached Effect 3: Burning Blood (The target hit will lose 1% of blood per second, cannot be cleared by any state, until death)]
[Remaining Usage: 1 time]
After looking at the attributes of this arrow, Han Xing heaved a sigh of relief.
Clearly, this is the most powerful weapon he received this time!
million Attack Power, far exceeds the Celestial Rail Strike Device by several times.
Plus Han Xing’s own Attack Power, combined with a host of skills and effect bonuses.
With one arrow, even a True God would surely fall!
