[Effect 2]: Exists at the Divine Spirit level, upon absorbing this Power of Rules, can directly replace the rule they possess, breaking through to level 80 in a short time, becoming a True God-level existence.
[Effect 3]: Direct absorption can increase Divine Power Value by 200,000.
After seeing the attributes, Han Xing sighed again.
It truly is deserving of being a True God-level rule.
This thing, both demigods and Divine Spirits can use.
As long as it’s used, one will surely become the new True God of Mighty Power in the future.
If other Divine Spirits get news of it, it will definitely drive them crazy.
Even True Gods would come running to hunt Han Xing for this Power of Rules.
Even if directly absorbed, it would allow Han Xing to increase Divine Power Value by 200,000, fulfilling one condition for breaking through demigod.
Han Xing looked toward the depths of the Forbidden Galaxy.
He knew this was a gift specially left for him by Hunter.
Han Xing softly said, "Thank you."
After returning to the side of the God of Radiance, Han Xing noticed the surprise in everyone’s eyes.
He smiled and said, "As you can see, this is the complete True God-level rule, that allows a demigod or True God to become the new True God of Mighty Power."
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance was indifferent, as he was about to break through to become a True God.
However, Samoyed beside them started breathing heavily.
A True God!
It was an existence it could only long for.
No, forget about a True God, even high-tier Divine Spirits, or top-tier Divine Spirits, were realms it could not touch.
And now, Han Xing says.
As long as this complete rule is absorbed, one is bound to become the new ’True God of Mighty Power’ in the future.
One can imagine how intense the shock was in Samoyed’s heart now.
Han Xing naturally saw Samoyed’s fervent gaze.
Han Xing glared at it.
Of course, he wasn’t going to give such a precious thing to Samoyed.
This [Tree of Rules], Han Xing planned to keep for himself.
"Now, only 3 more Power of Rules are needed!"
"The Old Tree previously needed 10 complete rules but didn’t specify what strength rules were needed."
"If I also use this True God-level rule to make a breakthrough, I wonder if there would be some different kind of change?"
"I’m afraid, even Hunter and Demon Emperor would have never done this when breaking through demigod?"
Thinking of this, Han Xing’s heart rose with excitement.
Because he was going to accomplish something those two had never done before!
"Samoyed, continue forward!"
"Take us to Silent City!"
Samoyed, upon hearing this, stowed away its heavy desire, then nodded solemnly.
It transformed back into a Void Giant Crocodile, leading the way up front.
The group began to move forward again.
During the journey, Cao Xing looked at the attributes of the Burning Blood Arrow in his backpack.
This was the most powerful item he obtained.
[Hunter’s Burning Blood Arrow]
[Quality: Unknown]
[Attack Power: 500 million]
[Attached Effect 1: Arrow of Destiny (The target locked by you will be hit 100%, ignoring rules, space, time, causing full damage)]
[Attached Effect 2: Sealing Heaven and Earth (The target hit will have all Divine Power and Power of Rules sealed)]
[Attached Effect 3: Burning Blood (The target hit will lose 1% of blood per second, cannot be cleared by any state, until death)]
[Remaining Usage: 1 time]
After looking at the attributes of this arrow, Han Xing heaved a sigh of relief.
Clearly, this is the most powerful weapon he received this time!
million Attack Power, far exceeds the Celestial Rail Strike Device by several times.
Plus Han Xing’s own Attack Power, combined with a host of skills and effect bonuses.
With one arrow, even a True God would surely fall!

chapters.title: Chapter 962 - 494: Painful Empress Appears
paragraphs: Han Xing shook his head, "Unfortunately, the divine power on this arrow is already insufficient, leaving only the chance for one last shot."
"Otherwise, with this great weapon, even a few true gods wouldn’t be able to return once they came."
Dismissing these thoughts, Han Xing focused on the journey.
A few hours later, they advanced tens of millions of kilometers once again.
In the void, a giant crocodile and a battleship slowly sailed into a special area.
The void energy here seemed very calm, as if suppressed by something.
At this moment, the God of Radiance seemed to sense something amiss, "Master, there’s something wrong with this area."
Hearing this, Han Xing questioned, "Something wrong?"
"Yes."
The God of Radiance nodded, "I can feel a faint fluctuation of divine power in this area, but it’s so weak that it’s hard to determine exactly what it is."
Hearing this, Han Xing furrowed his brows.
He directly called to Samoyed ahead, "Stop."
Samoyed immediately stopped his movement, turned around, and asked in confusion, "Master, what’s the matter?"
Han Xing didn’t speak but attentively sensed the surroundings.
Due to the God of Radiance’s power being unable to be casually exposed.
So Han Xing had to investigate the surrounding situation himself.
He put on the [Mask of the Golden Goddess] and then activated the [Eye of Divine Power] effect, scanning through the void.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly discovered faint fluctuations of divine power around them.
These fluctuations were extremely weak, as inconspicuous as a strand of hair.
However, when the number of hair strands reaches billions, the divine power fluctuation becomes very apparent.
As Han Xing’s Eye of God swept through.
He was surprised to find that an area of at least several million kilometers was entirely covered by these strands of divine power.
It was like a huge woven spider web, waiting for prey to step in.
Han Xing’s eyes narrowed immediately and he slowly said, "It seems we’re in trouble."
"Someone has set a trap here waiting for us!"
Hearing this, everyone was shocked.
Although they hadn’t sensed anything yet.
They trusted Han Xing’s words.
Even Samoyed was astonished, "A trap? Why didn’t I sense it?"
He watched the surroundings nervously, his massive body twisting continuously.
At this time, Samoyed also noticed something amiss.
He found that his body seemed to be entangled with invisible threads.
These threads were inconspicuous at first, but as they started moving, they all began to wrap around crazily.
By the time Samoyed realized it.
His entire body was already completely wrapped in the web!
Samoyed seemed to think of something and said in horror, "This is... the method of the Painful Blood Spider race!"
"The Painful Empress is nearby!"
At the same time, a light, bell-like laughter suddenly echoed through the void.
"Hehehe~"
"To think that my little bug discovered it early..."
"Moya, they say you have already advanced to a high-tier divine spirit, is it true?"
Samoyed didn’t reply, but instead looked around nervously.
However, he couldn’t find the opponent’s figure at all.
"Painful Empress, what do you want?"
The opponent didn’t answer but changed location.
A moment later, a voice echoed nochmals through the void, "Hehehe~ what do I want?"
"Of course, to retrieve the prey that escaped from me hundreds of years ago."
"Prey targeted by our Painful Blood Spider race has never escaped."
Hearing this, Moya felt an ominous feeling.
But he still declared strongly, "Painful Empress, although you are a top-tier divine spirit, I have also advanced to a high-tier divine spirit.
"If it comes to a fight, I might not be afraid of you!"
"After this matter is over, I will report your actions to the Ten Thousand Realms Alliance, and let the True God of Yellow Sand bring sanctions against you!"
Samoyed began to threaten sharply internally, even bringing up the True God of Yellow Sand.
This time, the Painful Empress didn’t speak; she seemed quite apprehensive of the True God of Yellow Sand as well.
However, even though the Painful Empress remained silent, Samoyed could still feel a gaze persistently fixated on him.
As if trying to completely see through his secrets.
And at this time, an invisible divine power fluctuation swept through.
"Buzz!"
After a tremor, a blood-colored spider web suddenly appeared in the void.
This blood-colored web was so vast, filling the void for thousands of miles.
This method was somewhat similar to the God of Radiance’s Chain of Light.
But in terms of control ability, the opponent’s blood-colored web was superior.
Because the ears of Han Xing and the others received a broadcast from the Divine Demon Battleship.
"Alert! Alert!"
"The battleship has been subjected to an unknown energy bind, unable to move or teleport!"
At this moment, the Divine Demon Battleship lost its ability to act.
Including the team members, who were also immobilized by the terrifying divine power.
At this time.
The spider web in the void trembled lightly.
Rustle... rustle...
Everyone felt that something was crawling nearby,
The opponent seemed to notice the battleship behind Samoyed.
A divine power fluctuation swept over Han Xing and the others.
But after realizing they were just a group of Legends and Demigods, it didn’t pay much attention.
Then, the divine power continued to sweep over Samoyed’s body repeatedly, as if confirming something.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong inside the cabin asked, "Radiance, our pursuer seems to be a top-tier divine spirit as well, can you handle it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 963 - 494: Painful Empress Appears_2
paragraphs: The God of Radiance nodded and said, "As top-tier divine spirits, there isn’t much of a gap between us."
"But because I control the light element rules, and I’m on the brink of a breakthrough."
"In a direct battle, she might not be as strong as me."
Hearing this, everyone let out a sigh of relief.
As long as the God of Radiance can win the fight, there shouldn’t be any problems.
Cheng Jianyong laughed at this moment, "Not bad, Radiance, you can even handle top-tier divine spirits."
The God of Radiance nodded, not modestly, "However, although I can defeat her, capturing her is a bit troublesome."
"This requires the master’s help."
Han Xing nodded, "I understand."
"Just in time for me to see the power of the Celestial Rail Strike Device."
Hearing this, everyone also brightened their eyes.
Speaking of which, ever since the Celestial Rail Strike Device was built, they haven’t used it.
Though they knew it was definitely powerful, its exact potency remained somewhat nebulous.
Now, there’s finally a chance to use it.
Meanwhile, the spider web in the void stopped trembling.
It seemed that it noticed something was wrong with Samoyed’s state.
A huge blood-red spider suddenly appeared on the void spider web.
Swollen venom sacs, eight terrifying long legs.
On its insect-like body was the torso of a human female.
The human female’s head turned towards Samoyed.
On her forehead, eight eyes watched Samoyed with interest.
Then, a silvery laugh rang out, "Hehehe~ Moya, your lying techniques seem to have improved."
"You actually fooled so many into thinking you’d broken through to a high-tier divine spirit."
"Now it seems you’ve not only failed to break through, but you’ve fallen down to a middle-tier divine spirit.
"Your current aura isn’t even as good as a regular divine spirit, hahaha~"
Hearing this, Samoyed also knew it could no longer keep up the charade.
But it still sneered and said, "Painful Empress, do you really intend to make a move on me?
"Though you are a top-tier divine spirit, I’m no pushover either. If I escape back to Silent City, the True God of Yellow Sand is sure to punish you."
At this moment, the Painful Empress licked her lips.
Having confirmed that Samoyed’s combat strength was only at a regular divine spirit level, she had no concerns left in her heart.
She laughed lightly and said, "Hehehe~ Moya, do you think there’s a chance to escape once you’ve entered my divine power spider web?"
"Even a fellow top-tier true god cannot easily break free from my web~"
Samoyed didn’t speak, because it knew what the Painful Empress said was true.
Her web’s binding ability was truly terrifying.
However, Samoyed had little fear in its heart.
Because it knew Han Xing would intervene.
At this moment, the Painful Empress suddenly retracted her smile, adopting a serious expression and said, "My little pet, it’s time to go home."
With that, she extended ten black fingers and suddenly pulled on the web,
"Buzz!"
In the void, those red spider webs directly covered Samoyed’s entire body and began to frantically wrap around it.
In an instant, Samoyed was wrapped into a cocoon.
In the void, a massive cocoon tens of thousands of meters long struggled frantically, its body twisting.
"Painful Empress, let me go!"
However, no matter how hard it struggled, it couldn’t break even a single spider thread.
Instead, it was getting more tightly bound.
After all, the Painful Empress was a top-tier divine spirit, and Samoyed had no chance of escape.
Just when the Painful Empress was about to take Samoyed away.
A faint voice suddenly came from behind.
"I say, just taking my person away like this, isn’t it a bit improper?"
The voice spread far through divine power.
The Painful Empress slightly turned around and noticed Han Xing and others on the divine demon battleship.
"Oh, I almost forgot about the presence of a few little bugs here."
"In that case, I’ll take you all with me."
With that, the Painful Empress again moved her fingers slightly.
In the void, countless divine power spider threads directly wrapped around the divine demon battleship.
Crunch! Crunch!
Squeaking sounds appeared.
It looked like it was about to destroy the defense tower on the deck.
And at this moment, a strong light suddenly burst out from within the divine demon battleship.
This light rapidly filled the entire area, a radius of ten thousand miles around the battleship, and continued to expand.
In no time, it completely enveloped this piece of void within a radius of a million kilometers!
Those divine power webs melted away in an instant, as if encountering flames.
Including Samoyed, who was cocooned, fell out of the web at this moment.
Its heart was filled with excitement.
Because Samoyed knew, this was Han Xing stepping in.
And at this moment.
Before she could speak, a giant light spear came rushing towards her at high speed.
At the same time, the Painful Empress’s expression suddenly changed.
She said in shock, "Top-tier divine spirit..."
"I didn’t expect you to have hidden such a power of a top-tier divine spirit!"
Shocked, the Painful Empress also asked with some confusion, "Light element rules, who are you?"
"In the Land of Divine War, I’ve never heard of a top-tier divine spirit that controls the light element rules?"
However, the God of Radiance didn’t want to engage in much conversation with the Painful Empress.
In an instant, thousands of wings of light, like raindrops, attacked her.
The Painful Empress let out a sharp cry.
The sound wave turned into substance, rapidly spreading around her.
Those wings of light dissipated into light points upon contact with the sound waves.
Swish, swish!
The sound of raindrops continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 964 - 494: Painful Empress Appears_3
paragraphs: At this moment, a chain of light suddenly rushed in.
The target wasn’t the Painful Empress, but the nearby Samoyed.
The Painful Empress reacted promptly.
"Oh? You’re trying to snatch my little pet away?"
"That’s not going to happen~"
She swung her belly, and a mass of red spider web enveloped Moya again.
And right then.
A stream of light quickly shot out from the divine demon battleship.
Its speed was almost teleportation-like!
And it charged straight towards the Painful Empress.
"Radiant Fluctuation Fist!"
As a faint voice rang out, a planet-sized light fist rapidly shot up into the sky.
The God of Radiance was terrifyingly strong, immediately engaging in close combat!
Bang!
The fist hit the Painful Empress.
Instantly propelling her colossal body into the void!
She felt a heavy blow to her abdomen!
The intense pain even caused her to arch her body.
An even more terrifying scream emerged.
This scream transformed into a substantial sound wave, spreading through the entire void.
"Rumble!"
The void energy began to fall into turmoil.
Samoyed, upon hearing the sound wave, flipped his eyes and fainted.
Luckily, the God of Radiance reacted quickly, directly casting a shield of light to cover the entire divine demon battleship.
Through the shield of light, everyone could hear the screams like the wails of lost souls.
These screams seemed to embody all the pain of the world, filled with endless grievances.
Cheng Jianyong’s face turned pale, "Oh my... this woman’s scream is really terrifying, just like a damn banshee!"
Shen Yun nodded in agreement, "Indeed, it’s too horrifying."
"This is the combat power of the top-tier Divine Spirit Level, just a bit of combat aftermath can severely injure ordinary divine spirits. If we faced this sound wave head-on, we’d all be finished."
Everyone shared the same thought.
However, what they didn’t know was, this was the Painful Empress’s signature skill, [Painful Scream].
Countless divine-level beings had perished under this attack.
At this moment, the Painful Empress noticed the divine demon battleship protected by the God of Radiance as well.
She rapidly distanced herself, with a smile of interest appearing on her beautiful yet eerie face.
"Seems like that little spaceship is very important to you."
"Since that’s the case, I’ll just have to destroy it first~"
Once she finished speaking, the Painful Empress’s body instantly disappeared from its original spot.
When she appeared again, she was above Han Xing and the others.
She intended to directly attack the divine demon battleship!
Han Xing felt a chill on his scalp, just as he was preparing to use the [Celestial Rail Strike Device], to fire at the mother spider.
"Clang clang..."
Thousands of iron chains shot forth instantly, binding the Painful Empress entirely.
"Pfft!"
The God of Radiance suddenly tugged, dragging the Painful Empress’s massive body back.
Before she could react, the God of Radiance’s body also disappeared instantly.
In terms of speed, he who masters the light element rules is clearly faster than the Painful Empress.
"Buzz!"
A flash of light streaked through.
Then transformed into a glowing celestial shuttle.
Along the way, all the divine power spider webs dissolved instantly under the celestial shuttle’s high speed.
The Painful Empress’s gaze tightened, feeling the terror of the God of Radiance’s strike.
She quickly adjusted her angle and launched a fierce attack at the glowing object.
"Pfft! Pfft pfft pfft!"
Various terrifying venom and divine power spider webs rained down on the God of Radiance.
However, the God of Radiance, transformed into a celestial shuttle, didn’t defend at all and charged forward like an arrow released from the bowstring.
"Buzz buzz buzz!"
All attacks were strongly dispelled by the God of Radiance.
He reached the Painful Empress’s presence in an instant.
This beautiful mother spider had an image of a glowing figure reflected in her eight eyes on her forehead.
The next moment.
A radiant battle spear rapidly enlarged in her pupils.
"So fast..."
The Painful Empress murmured, then a sense of crisis surged.
At that moment, the Painful Empress lifted her four long legs, all bracing against the spear of light!
"Sizzle! Sizzle sizzle!"
Smoke rose from her four long legs.
The spear of light carried not only an extremely strong piercing power but also a terrifying power of erosion.
This time, pain really showed on the face of the Painful Empress.
The Painful Empress let out another scream, releasing the God of Radiance’s spear.
Then, all her limbs began to frantically whirl, like the waving of spirit snakes.
The God of Radiance remained fearless.
The next moment, four light arms extended from his body, wildly clashing with the Painful Empress’s eight long legs.
"Bang! Bang bang bang!"
Rumble!
The two terrifying entities engaged in fierce close combat.
Terrifying fluctuations of divine power continuously burst forth.
The energy of the void was pulled into madness, then evaporated.
From one hundred kilometers, to one thousand kilometers, even to tens of thousands of kilometers!
The chaotic void was blasted into a vast area of nothingness.
All vanished, only the two terrifying entities, engaging in hundreds of thousands, even millions of collisions per second.
From afar, the spectators could barely see their movements.
They could only see two masses of figures engaging in close-range wild combat!
Cheng Jianyong swallowed and said, "It’s really terrifying!"
"At their level, every casual move is a great skill, the gap between them and those middle-tier divine spirits, and low-tier divine spirits is truly huge."
The team members nodded in agreement.
To be honest, the God of Radiance was incredibly formidable.
But the Painful Empress was no weakling either.
Without using certain control methods, even if Han Xing uses the defense tower to bombard, the Painful Empress would quickly escape.
After all, her movement speed was truly terrifying.
However, currently, Han Xing only had one way to control such an entity.

sentences.text: At this moment, a chain of light suddenly rushed in.
The target wasn’t the Painful Empress, but the nearby Samoyed.
The Painful Empress reacted promptly.
"Oh?
You’re trying to snatch my little pet away?"
"That’s not going to happen~"
She swung her belly, and a mass of red spider web enveloped Moya again.
And right then.
A stream of light quickly shot out from the divine demon battleship.
Its speed was almost teleportation-like!
And it charged straight towards the Painful Empress.
"Radiant Fluctuation Fist!"
As a faint voice rang out, a planet-sized light fist rapidly shot up into the sky.
The God of Radiance was terrifyingly strong, immediately engaging in close combat!
Bang!
The fist hit the Painful Empress.
Instantly propelling her colossal body into the void!
She felt a heavy blow to her abdomen!
The intense pain even caused her to arch her body.
An even more terrifying scream emerged.
This scream transformed into a substantial sound wave, spreading through the entire void.
"Rumble!"
The void energy began to fall into turmoil.
Samoyed, upon hearing the sound wave, flipped his eyes and fainted.

If we faced this sound wave head-on, we’d all be finished."

She rapidly distanced herself, with a smile of interest appearing on her beautiful yet eerie face.
"Seems like that little spaceship is very important to you."
"Since that’s the case, I’ll just have to destroy it first~"

She intended to directly attack the divine demon battleship!

"Clang clang..."
Thousands of iron chains shot forth instantly, binding the Painful Empress entirely.
"Pfft!"
The God of Radiance suddenly tugged, dragging the Painful Empress’s massive body back.

A flash of light streaked through.

Various terrifying venom and divine power spider webs rained down on the God of Radiance.

"Buzz buzz buzz!"
All attacks were strongly dispelled by the God of Radiance.
He reached the Painful Empress’s presence in an instant.
This beautiful mother spider had an image of a glowing figure reflected in her eight eyes on her forehead.
The next moment.
A radiant battle spear rapidly enlarged in her pupils.
"So fast..."

At that moment, the Painful Empress lifted her four long legs, all bracing against the spear of light!

Smoke rose from her four long legs.

chapters.title: Chapter 965 - 495: The Might of the Heavenrail
paragraphs: That is the Holy Artifact given to him by the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots, the [Heart of the Endless Tree Sea].
Without this Holy Artifact, when facing such top-tier Divine Spirits, Han Xing would only be at the mercy of being ravaged one-sidedly.
At this moment, Han Xing thought to himself: "It seems I need to obtain some stronger Control Skills, preferably ones that can affect top-tier Divine Spirits or even True Gods."
This time, the battle between the God of Radiance and the Painful Empress made him realize his shortcomings.
Just then, after a terrifying clash, the two top-tier Divine Spirits, in the fray, suddenly separated.
They widened the distance between them.
However, it was not a cease-fire but a change in strategy.
The Painful Empress’ belly jutted out.
"Puff!"
Countless threads of spider silk sprayed out.
The God of Radiance casually summoned, and in the void, innumerable Chains of Light burst forth.
"Bang! Bang bang!"
The Chains of Light collided with the blood-colored spider silk.
The void within a million miles radius turned into two colors.
One side was suffused with a red blood mist, while the other was shining with golden brilliance.
In the next moment, the blood-colored spider silk and the Chains of Light tangled instantaneously.
"Sizzle... sizzle..."
The blood-colored spider silk melted away like snow and ice.
The golden light enveloped the void, disintegrating all the spider silk completely.
The Painful Empress frowned slightly, full of confusion, and said.
"How did you become so powerful? Could it be you’ve touched that realm?"
The God of Radiance did not answer.
Just then, a thick Chain of Light swiftly struck towards the Painful Empress.
She wanted to dodge but was a step too late.
"Puff!"
With a sound of flesh being hit.
A blood-colored figure was instantly sent flying tens of thousands of miles.
The crowd observing the battle could not help feeling a surge of happiness.
Because they knew that in this exchange, the God of Radiance had the upper hand.
"Boom!"
The massive Blood Spider continuously retreated in the void.
Han Xing saw, on her body, appeared numerous blood holes, with a faint golden light emanating from the wounds.
After retreating continuously for tens of thousands of miles.
The Painful Empress spat out a mouthful of fresh blood.
"Puff!"
Then, she gazed at the dazzling figure in the void, disbelief on her face as she said.
"You’re not an ordinary top-tier Divine Spirit, you’re just one step away from a True God!"
"Who the hell are you?"
The God of Radiance didn’t reply but said coldly: "Release Moya, he belongs to us."
The Painful Empress had regained her calm by now.
She grabbed a large cocoon in the void, inside of which was the pitiful Samoyed wrapped up.
Then, she touched her lips with her finger and said with an enchanting smile, "What if... I don’t release him?"
The God of Radiance was very straightforward.
He just tightened his fist.
In the next moment, millions of Light Spears appeared in the sky, making the radius of a million miles bright as day.
Then, he said lightly, "If you don’t release him, you’ll stay here today."
Seeing the familiar posture and the arrogant words of the God of Radiance, everyone knew he was about to unleash a big move.
Cheng Jianyong excitedly said from the back: "Here it comes, Old Guang’s signature Ultimate Skill, the Feather of Light!"
Shen Yun said blankly: "Uh, how do you know this is Guanghui’s signature Ultimate Skill? I remember the Feather of Light is the God of Light’s Skill?"
Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily, "Who cares, as long as we know this move is powerful!"
Shen Yun was speechless.
At this moment, the Painful Empress’s expression also changed slightly.
She sensed the terror of this move.
Just one hit from any of these Light Spears could severely injure her body.
If struck by all, she might get pierced like a sieve.
But the Painful Empress reacted, her expression suddenly turned pitiful as she said: "Boohoo... are you going to use this move against a humble servant like me?
"Sobbing... then a humble servant can only let Moya die in my place..."
After speaking, the Painful Empress put the large cocoon in front of herself.
Poor Samoyed still didn’t know, in his unconscious state, he had been used as a shield by the Painful Empress.
The God of Radiance’s expression tightened, but he knew he absolutely must not show weakness in this situation.
So, the God of Radiance said coldly: "It’s okay, if Moya dies, I’ll kill you."
"Surely a top-tier Divine Spirit accompanying him to the netherworld would delight him greatly."
In the next moment, the God of Radiance directly commanded: "Feather of Light, go!"
Buzz!
The sky filled with Light Spears, shooting swiftly toward the Painful Empress.
The Painful Empress didn’t expect them to make a move so decisively, completely without any hesitation.
But as a top-tier Divine Spirit’s combat instincts would allow, she reacted instantly.
She let out a truly Painful Scream again and began to furiously attack the Light Spears.
However, this attack of the God of Radiance far exceeded the previous strength.
This time, the sonic wave of [Painful Scream] had no effect against the Light Spears of [Feather of Light].
Tens of thousands of strikes appeared around the Painful Empress in an instant and pierced through straight away.
Puff! Puff, puff, puff!
The dense sound of flesh being pierced arose.
At this moment, numerous blood holes appeared all over the Painful Empress’s body.
In an instant, she suffered severe injuries.
The combat strength of the God of Radiance exceeded everyone’s expectations significantly.
Han Xing, who was observing the battle, also let out a sigh of relief.
Because in this scenario, the Divine Demon Battleship wasn’t needed to intervene for the opponent to be unilaterally suppressed.
At this moment, after suffering the attacks from tens of thousands of spears, the Painful Empress was already covered in blood.
Her current appearance was both tragic and horrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 966 - 495: The Might of the Celestial Track! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Large holes of light appeared densely across the enormous spider body, triggering trypophobia among the viewers.
With such injuries, if not for her being a top-tier Divine Spirit, any ordinary High-tier Divine Spirit would have died on the spot.
And even more terrifying is the residual Light Divine Power on these wounds.
Still eroding her flesh body, preventing her from using the Power of Rules for recovery.
The Painful Empress gave the God of Radiance a deep look.
And realized that she is no match for this frightening entity before her.
However, bizarrely, no expression of fear or pain appeared on her face.
Instead, it carried an expression of enjoyment.
In front of everyone, the Painful Empress thrust her arm, riddled with holes, into her abdomen, and wildly stirred.
"Gurgle, gurgle..."
A mass of organs was yanked out directly by her.
Then, right in front of everyone, she began to put this mass into her mouth, chewing frantically.
This display made everyone’s scalps tingle.
Yet, the Painful Empress, chewing, was trembling violently.
With a fierce shaking, that intestine was directly torn off.
And from her mouth came a moan of pleasure.
This bizarre scene left the God of Radiance baffled.
And even more bizarre was that as she tore her organs, a powerful self-healing force seemed to emerge from her body.
The holes initially pierced by the Feather of Light started swiftly healing.
Soon, the Painful Empress’s body was restored to its original state.
The God of Radiance remarked from the side, "Interesting, stimulating the rules through extreme pain, then extracting stronger power from them for recovery?"
He instantly recognized the Painful Empress’s current action.
However, the Painful Empress licked her lips and chuckled softly, "You’re correct~"
"As top-tier Divine Spirits, you should know there’s no way you can kill me, right?"
"We can always extract the Power of Rules to restore ourselves."
The God of Radiance nodded, because he knew the Painful Empress was stating facts.
Opposite, the Painful Empress chuckled softly, "Well then, glowing guy, I’ll take my little pet and leave first~"
"See you later~
After finishing, the Painful Empress turned on her heel, intending to leave immediately.
As her stomach swayed, she planned to take Samoyed along.
Yet, at this moment, the God of Radiance declared directly, "You shall not leave."
With those words.
He spread his arms wide.
The Chains of Light burst again, in a terrifying number, exceeding the total before.
The entire Void was completely filled.
The spider web released by the Painful Empress crumbled instantly.
Simultaneously, she felt a dreadful Power of Imprisonment descend upon her.
The Painful Empress’s expression slightly furrowed.
She started contemplating utilizing top-tier Divine Spirit movement techniques to escape.
And just then.
Several Chains of Light instantly attacked.
"Bang! Bang, bang, bang!"
The Chains of Light wrapped around her eight long legs, binding her waist, neck, and two arms.
The God of Radiance pulled with one hand.
"Creak! Creak!"
Sounds of joints misaligning echoed.
The Painful Empress’s limbs hung in midair at an eerie angle, suspended by the chains.
With the Chains of Light encompassing her neck and waist.
Her eight long legs and arms twisted behind her.
Under such an angle, her exaggerated pair of giant breasts was showcased vividly.
Suspended mid-air, like two bowling balls.
Though showing a painful expression, the female spider nonetheless revealed a difficult smile and said, "So... you like this position..."
"You could’ve mentioned, I would’ve cooperated~"
"Humph!
The God of Radiance snorted coldly, grabbing the chains with an intent to drag the Painful Empress closer.
However, at this moment.
The Painful Empress chuckled softly, "Glowing guy, we are both top-tier Divine Spirits, even if you’re a bit stronger than me, you should know - you can’t hold onto me."
With those words.
The Painful Empress unleashed her Divine Power suddenly.
In the sky, a vast luminous network suddenly appeared.
This belonged to the Painful Empress’s Power of Rules, at that moment providing her infinite power.
And in an instant, all her injuries were healed completely.
The Painful Empress opened her mouth full of sharp teeth wide, fiercely biting at the chains binding her.
"Crunch!"
After a crisp sound.
The Chains of Light released by the God of Radiance immediately showed dense cracks.
On the verge of breaking completely.
The God of Radiance frowned, realizing that the Painful Empress spoke the truth.
Their Divine Power strength was about equal.
Attempting to suppress each other with Divine Power alone wouldn’t prevent escape.
Now that she had summoned the Power of Rules, as soon as she shakes off the Divine Chain’s bindings, she could escape into the rule itself.
Impossible to hold her!
At this moment, the Painful Empress too began recovering her injuries.
She steadied her figure in the Void, counteracting the God of Radiance’s Divine Power Chain.
"Crunch! Crunch!"
Chains breaking!
Seeing the Painful Empress about to break free from the bonds.
Her seductive lips curled into a smile, "Well then, see you next time, glowing guy~"
And at that moment, the God of Radiance suddenly turned around, respectfully saying, "Master, please intervene!"
Having intended to directly escape into the rules, the Painful Empress.

chapters.title: Chapter 967 - 495: The Might of the Heaven’s Rail! (Part 3)
paragraphs: Upon hearing the God of Radiance call someone ’Master,’ an intense curiosity suddenly arose in her heart.
One must know, this being is only a step away from becoming a True God as a top-tier Divine Spirit.
For such an existence, even a True God wouldn’t be able to make them call themselves ’Master.’
So now, who exactly is this glowing guy calling Master?
Reason told the Painful Empress that she should run away immediately.
However, the curiosity in her heart drove her to take a second look.
Yet, it was precisely these two glances that cost her the final chance to escape.
At this moment, on Han Xing’s God-Demon War Demon, the bow section was shining brightly.
The instant burst of light directly surpassed the strongest strike from the God of Radiance!
At the same time.
At the bow section, a circular transparent crystal-like device began to rotate wildly.
A massive amount of energy gathered at the center of that transparent donut.
At this moment, the circle center seemed to have created a singularity.
The energy fluctuations emitted by that singularity caused the entire Divine Demon Battleship to enter a state of uncontrolled distortion.
At this moment, the Painful Empress’s pupils contracted sharply!
Because she truly felt a deadly crisis!
"True God..."
"It’s actually True God Level power!"
The Painful Empress was thoroughly panicked, she frantically mobilized energy, snapping her own chains.
However, at this moment, the God of Radiance was also mobilizing all his divine power to control the Painful Empress,
Crack!
More chains of light erupted.
"Ah!! Let go of me!
The Painful Empress was completely flustered.
What kind of joke is this, that’s a True God Level attack!
The difference between a Divine Spirit and a True God is like heaven and earth!
She has a premonition that she will be completely annihilated by this strike!
However, the charging time for the Celestial Rail Strike Device, amplified by two Sun Crown Steles, was shortened to an extremely brief moment.
In the next instant, a terrifying beam erupted from that black singularity.
This beam extended out millions of kilometers in just a moment.
What concept is this?
Bear in mind, even the speed of light is only 300,000 kilometers per second.
Now, the attack speed of the Celestial Rail Strike Device far exceeds light speed by several times.
When the speed of this beam surpassed a certain critical point, it seemed to undergo a marvelous change.
Time began to freeze along the way, and even started to show signs of flowing backward.
Everyone saw the chains on the Painful Empress that had snapped apart were restored.
She seemed to have returned to a few seconds earlier.
As the beam hit her in an instant, a look of horror appeared in the Painful Empress’s eyes.
The next moment, terrifying light erupted.
Han Xing and others could see nothing.
Because the attack from the Celestial Rail Strike Device was so bizarre that it even disturbed time along its path.
Everyone even saw the fight scenes between the God of Radiance and the Painful Empress from a few seconds earlier.
Numerous images of the God of Radiance and the Painful Empress appeared in the Void.
Cheng Jianyong swallowed his saliva at the side: "Is this the Celestial Rail Strike Device? Strange, really strange!"
"It’s not like the Painful Empress was harmed only after the attack, but it’s like Brother Xing had already used the Celestial Rail Strike Device on the Painful Empress a few seconds back!"
Shen Yun agreed: "Indeed, this thing has a bit of that causality weapon vibe, once the attack is launched, the enemy can’t escape at all."

"I even have a premonition, even if the Painful Empress had just fled into the rules and escaped, she would still be pulled back by the Celestial Rail Strike Device’s attack and face this strike head-on.
Everyone was shocked beyond belief.
After all, before this, the description of the Celestial Rail Strike Device didn’t include an effect akin to time reversal.
Anything involving time and space becomes exceedingly strange.
After some thought, Han Xing understood the reason, "It might be due to the effect brought by the two Sun Crown Steles."
"They made the attack speed of the Celestial Rail Strike Device exceed light speed, leading to some unexpected special features."
Then, Han Xing said worriedly, "The power of the Celestial Rail Strike Device is a bit beyond my expectations; this mother spider won’t be directly blasted to death, will it?"
Everyone froze.
Cheng Jianyong wondered: "What’s wrong, Brother Xing, can’t we directly kill this mother spider?"
Han Xing nodded, "It’s not that we can’t kill it, but we can’t kill it just yet. Didn’t they say? Silent City has a True God."
"It’s okay that we took out those Initial Tier and Middle Tier Divine Spirits before, didn’t attract much attention."
"Now directly taking out a top-tier Divine Spirit might attract the attention of that True God, and it wouldn’t be surprising if they directly take action against us."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong and others realized something, and exclaimed in surprise: "Wow, you make a good point!"
"If a True God comes now, we’ll be in trouble!"
For a moment, the team felt a bit worried.
At this time, Han Xing reassured, "It’s okay, if we blast it to death, we blast it to death."
"If a True God comes looking for trouble, I have a way to control them."
"Then we’ll directly focus our fire on them; with the power of the Celestial Rail Strike Device, it should be enough to heavily wound them."
"If we really can’t win, we’ll just leave the God of Radiance behind; a top-tier Divine Spirit can at least buy us some time."
Hearing that last sentence, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun smiled knowingly at the corners of their mouths.
They actually knew Han Xing was joking.
Unless absolutely necessary, Han Xing would never abandon any teammate.
Even though the God of Radiance had only just joined their team.
But clearly, the performance of the God of Radiance during this time had already won everyone’s recognition.

chapters.title: Chapter 968 - 496: Subduing the Painful Empress
paragraphs: Moments later, the chaotic temporal scene caused by the Celestial Rail Strike Device gradually subsided in that fast area.
At this moment, everyone saw that the nerve network belonging to the Painful Empress in the sky had appeared with dense cracks.
As if it was about to shatter into pieces, barely holding together.
However, ultimately, that nerve network did not break apart.
At the same time.
Suddenly, a gigantic spider fell down from the void.
However, this spider was now covered in blood, with half of its spider body gone.
Only the upper half of a human body remained.
It looked incredibly wretched.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, "Oh, not dead?"
"These top demigods seem to have some life-preserving skills."
Joy appeared in everyone’s eyes.
At this moment, that mother spider seemed to have fallen into a coma.
At this time, Han Xing controlled the Divine Demon Battleship to move closer and then said, "Radiance, hold her down for me."
The God of Radiance obeyed, directly bursting out thousands of chains, penetrating all her joints.
"Pu pu pu!"
A series of sounds of flesh being pierced appeared.
In a flash, the remaining upper half body of this spider empress was completely penetrated by at least hundreds of chains of light.
It looked somewhat pitiful.
But everyone knew that dealing with such top-tier divine spirits required these necessary methods.
In the next moment.
This dazzling woman who only had half of her body left gradually regained consciousness.
She saw her own condition.
And the Power of Rules above her head that was about to crack.
For a moment, a tragic smile appeared at the corner of her mouth.
"I didn’t expect to be caught here..."
"Moya, is this what you arranged to deal with me?"
Beside her, Samoyed said, full of speechlessness, "How am I supposed to know you would come looking for trouble with me? You ran right into my master’s gun barrel!"
This was the Painful Empress, hearing the word ’master’ from the second divine spirit.
An infinite curiosity arose in her heart.
Who exactly could make these two powerful beings submit?
Then her gaze swept across the field, over Han Xing and the others.
At this time, her eyes did not show the contempt or insect-like gaze typical of other divine spirits.
Instead, she said in surprise, "Scary humans..."
"Those two initial-tier demigods actually have an aura comparable to top demigods."
"All the other Legends have at least middle-tier demigod combat power!"
"You are all unparalleled demons of a species that are hard to come by in ten thousand years!"
The Painful Empress was truly shocked this time.
So many unparalleled demons appeared all at once, each with the potential for godhood, surpassing even her in the past!
Most notably, from one of the Legends, she felt a faint sense of threat.
Bear in mind, the Painful Empress was a top-tier divine spirit.
The gap between her and the Legend was two large realms apart.
Describing this gap in power as between an ant and an elephant would not be an exaggeration.
She fixed her gaze on Han Xing, her eyes shining brightly.
"Are you the master of Moya and this radiant top-tier divine spirit?"
She immediately confirmed that Han Xing was their master.
Han Xing did not reply but instead asked, "Is it the True God of the Silent City who sent you to deal with us?"
Across, the Painful Empress chuckled softly, "This human brother, your aura is truly enchanting to me, I really want to devour you~"
Seeing the Painful Empress completely uncooperative.
Han Xing frowned slightly.
The God of Radiance suddenly yanked the chain of light in his hand, twisting all the joints of the Painful Empress’s body together.
"Crunch! Crunch!"
A series of sounds of bones dislocating occurred.
Instant agony made the mother spider emit a cry of pain.
However, quickly, her expression of pain turned into one of complete enjoyment.
Her whole body began to tremble violently, as if the pain was bringing her an extreme pleasure.
Samoyed explained nearby, "Master, the Painful Empress feeds on pain. The more you torture her flesh, not only will it not cause her pain, but will instead make her feel pleasure."
"Although she is now unable to absorb power from the rules, she is also immune to the feeling of pain."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s face on the scene turned a little strange.
Cheng Jianyong paused for a moment, "Uh, is this woman an M?"
Samoyed did not understand what M meant, full of confusion.
At this moment, the Painful Empress looked at Han Xing, murmuring, "Is there more? Little brother~ Mistress wants more~"
She had a face of intoxication, seemingly craving for that pain to descend once more.
Han Xing’s mouth twitched, knowing he couldn’t get anything out of this mother spider.
But how to deal with her was quite troublesome.
After all, this is a top True God, normal methods cannot contain her.
And she absolutely won’t submit.
Han Xing thought for a moment.
Then his gaze swept over the mother spider, a faint hint of killing intent appeared in his eyes.
He really wanted to kill this mother spider on the spot, then strip away the Power of Rules from her.
By then, giving it to either the God of Radiance or Samoyed would bring a significant boost in combat power.
However, Han Xing was also worried that killing her directly would attract the True God of Silent City, thus triggering a True God battle.
At this time, the God of Radiance seemed to have detected Han Xing’s concerns, and thus said, "Master, I found a special method in the memory of the God of Light."
"Which is to use the Light Divine Power to enter the opponent’s mind and completely seal their consciousness."

chapters.title: Chapter 969 - 496: Subjugating the Painful Empress (2)
paragraphs: "In a sealed state, the opponent will enter a dormant state and will be unaware of everything in the outside world."
Han Xing was taken aback, "Can this method have an effect on top-tier divine spirits?"
The God of Radiance nodded and said, "Under normal circumstances, naturally no."
"But since you’ve already blasted her into a dire state, there’s a good chance it’ll succeed."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes lit up with joy, "That’s great then!"
"Radiance, seal her consciousness, and once I break through to demigod, I can finish her off directly."
"Then, her Power of Rules can be given to Samoyed, allowing it to restore its power."
Upon hearing this, Samoyed’s eyes instantly lit up.
It eagerly exclaimed, "Thank you, master! Samoyed will serve you tirelessly until death!"
At this moment, the Painful Empress’s face changed slightly, and she hastily said, "No! My power cannot be inherited by such an ugly creature."
Samoyed’s face fell.
The Painful Empress continued, "I want that little girl from the Elf Race to inherit my power."
She was referring to Su Xiaoyang, who was behind Han Xing.
Upon hearing this, Su Xiaoyang stood there looking bewildered.
Then, as if realizing something, she shook her head vigorously, "I... I don’t want to turn into a giant spider!"
Before the Painful Empress could speak, Han Xing calmly said, "You’re already a prisoner; this isn’t up to you."
"Your Power of Rules will go to whoever I want."
Just as the God of Radiance intended to take action.
The Painful Empress spoke up, "Wait, don’t seal me yet. Is there something you want to know?"
Han Xing saw that she was finally willing to cooperate and calmly said, "Answer my last question, was it the True God of Silent City who sent you to deal with me?"
The Painful Empress gently shook her head, "No~ I came by myself."
"Silent City held a joint meeting and decided not to pursue Moya for slaughtering the Bone-Eroding Griffin Race."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing felt reassured.
Because this means, at least in the short term, that True God won’t come looking for trouble with him.
Han Xing continued to ask, "Why did you come to kill us?
The Painful Empress sincerely replied, "Because I have to capture Moya and bring her back, she escaped from the Blood Spider Race’s web."
"According to our Blood Spider Race’s tradition, those escaped prey must be brought back at all costs and turned into nourishment."
Samoyed shuddered instantly.
Han Xing nodded again.
After asking a few more questions.
The Painful Empress answered them all, exhibiting utmost cooperation.
Then, Han Xing nodded with satisfaction, "Very well, now you should take a nap."
"When you wake again, you’ll find eternal relief."
The God of Radiance understood.
The next moment, he spread his arms, ready to envelop the Painful Empress’s head.
Suddenly, the Painful Empress shouted, "Wait a minute!"
The God of Radiance’s hand halted midair.
Han Xing asked in bewilderment, "Do you have something else to say?"
The Painful Empress, somewhat bashful, said in midair, "Why didn’t you ask if I am willing to submit?"
Han Xing was taken aback.
Because he knew that these divine spirits are proud and would never acknowledge a Legend as a master, not even in death.
The God of Radiance and Samoyed were exceptions.
So, being a top-tier divine spirit, Han Xing never thought about making her submit to him.
Yet now, her proactive mention somewhat exceeded Han Xing’s expectations.
He then curiously asked, "Uh... you mean, you want to submit to me?"
At this point, the Painful Empress nodded somewhat shyly.
Not just Han Xing, even Samoyed and the God of Radiance beside him were quite surprised.
The Painful Empress chuckled, "I can see how terrifying the potential of this human brother is."
"I’m afraid that with the foundation he has now, once he breaks through to demigod, he’ll have the power of a top demigod."
"And I also see that your ambition extends beyond this; you’re accumulating an even deeper foundation~"
"Even the True God of Yellow Sand, compared to your accumulation in the Legendary Realm, falls short."
"I’m too curious about what this brother wants to achieve, or how powerful a realm he can reach in the future."
"So, I’m willing to submit to you."
After the Painful Empress finished speaking, everyone looked at her, then at Han Xing.
Clearly, she was telling the truth.
The foundation Han Xing currently has is not achievable by normal beings.
Moreover, he’s still accumulating towards an even more terrifying degree.
These creatures from other worlds don’t understand what breaking the rules means.
The Painful Empress simply instinctively felt that whatever Han Xing planned to do next would be terrifying.
Might even cause a turmoil within the Void.
"However, before submitting to you, I have one condition."
Han Xing curiously asked, "What?"
The Painful Empress, her face flushed, said, "After I submit to you, can you often have that glowing fellow use his Divine Power Chain to penetrate my body~"
Han Xing: "..."
The God of Radiance: "..."
Everyone: "..."
At that moment, everyone was stunned.
But soon, Han Xing understood.
Because the Painful Empress feeds on pain, the recent experience brought her unprecedented pain and pleasure.
That’s why she made such a request to Han Xing.

At this point, the Painful Empress nodded somewhat shyly.
Not just Han Xing, even Samoyed and the God of Radiance beside him were quite surprised.
The Painful Empress chuckled, "I can see how terrifying the potential of this human brother is."
"I’m afraid that with the foundation he has now, once he breaks through to demigod, he’ll have the power of a top demigod."
"And I also see that your ambition extends beyond this; you’re accumulating an even deeper foundation~"
"Even the True God of Yellow Sand, compared to your accumulation in the Legendary Realm, falls short."
"I’m too curious about what this brother wants to achieve, or how powerful a realm he can reach in the future."
"So, I’m willing to submit to you."
After the Painful Empress finished speaking, everyone looked at her, then at Han Xing.
Clearly, she was telling the truth.
The foundation Han Xing currently has is not achievable by normal beings.
Moreover, he’s still accumulating towards an even more terrifying degree.
These creatures from other worlds don’t understand what breaking the rules means.
The Painful Empress simply instinctively felt that whatever Han Xing planned to do next would be terrifying.
Might even cause a turmoil within the Void.
"However, before submitting to you, I have one condition."
Han Xing curiously asked, "What?"
The Painful Empress, her face flushed, said, "After I submit to you, can you often have that glowing fellow use his Divine Power Chain to penetrate my body~"
Han Xing: "..."
The God of Radiance: "..."
Everyone: "..."
At that moment, everyone was stunned.
But soon, Han Xing understood.
Because the Painful Empress feeds on pain, the recent experience brought her unprecedented pain and pleasure.
That’s why she made such a request to Han Xing.

chapters.title: Chapter 970 - 496: Subduing the Painful Empress (Part 3)
paragraphs: Han Xing pondered for a moment, then nodded and said, "Sure, I promise you on behalf of the God of Radiance."
Upon hearing this, a satisfied flush appeared on the Painful Empress’s face.
"Thank you, kind master~"
The God of Radiance standing nearby could only twitch at the mouth.
However, since Han Xing was his master, he said nothing more.
Moreover, frequent attacks on this woman didn’t matter much, it was just done casually.
The next moment, without needing Han Xing to say more, the Painful Empress began to swear to the Supreme Rule.
Rumble!
Four vast and boundless nerve networks emerged in the void.
The Painful Empress began her oath.
"I, Painful Empress, Madeleine swear today to this young human, that from this moment on, I will be loyal to him for life."
"Madeleine is willing to obey his every command."
"If violated, I am willing to be struck down by the Supreme Rule!"
As soon as the words fell.
The four nerve networks began to tremble once again.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared in front of Han Xing.
[Painful Empress·Madeleine: Top-tier Divine Spirit Level creature, sworn allegiance to the Supreme Rule, from today she becomes your servant, do you accept?]
Han Xing tapped yes directly.
[The oath has been established, Painful Empress·Madeleine is now a friendly creature.]
At this moment, Han Xing saw that the red name above her head had turned green.
Although the level gap is too large, it’s still impossible to view her specific attributes.
However, this situation indicates that the Painful Empress will no longer attack them.
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Then their expressions turned odd.
They hadn’t expected that this battle would bring such an unexpected joy.
A powerful top-tier Divine Spirit had become their ally.
This way, their team was growing stronger and stronger.
Han Xing then said, "Radiance, let her down now."
The God of Radiance nodded his head.
In the next moment, countless chains of light retracted.
Swish! Swish swish!
The chains withdrew from the Painful Empress’s body.
"Mm~"
The Painful Empress let out an enticing moan.
Everyone present had peculiar looks on their faces.
Han Xing was used to the strange behavior of this odd mother spider, so he asked, "Madeleine, can the injuries on your body still be healed?"
The Painful Empress licked her lips and then softly said, "Yes, master, but I need a little time."
"We top-tier Divine Spirits can draw power from the Power of Rules to quickly heal all our injuries."
"Just now, master’s attack was so intense, so fierce, shattered my heart and liver~"
"Before, I only needed one or two hours to recover, but now it will probably take most of the day..."
This woman’s speaking style is really odd, each sentence carrying a teasing tone.
Han Xing didn’t pay attention.
Because the Painful Empress is also a top-tier Divine Spirit, equivalent to having half a foot in the True God Realm.
And what is a True God?
Synonym for immortal and indestructible.
As long as their Power of Rules isn’t destroyed, they can infinitely revive from the Power of Rules and return to peak state.
This is the terror of a True God!
Although a top-tier True God can’t achieve this, they possess unparalleled terrifying recovery capabilities.
Upon hearing this, Samoyed, nearby, looked full of envy.
Because he was only a middle-tier Divine Spirit and didn’t have such abilities.
Until now, he was still dragging his severely injured body, taking Han Xing and the others around.
Han Xing nodded.
Then said, "Great, now, take me to Silent City."
"Okay, master~"
Since joining Han Xing’s camp, the Painful Empress became incredibly cooperative.
She even took the initiative to lead the way.
Samoyed behind her followed with a peculiar look.
Although they were already on the same team now.
He still had a natural fear of the Painful Empress, not daring to approach actively.
Next, with the Painful Empress joining, they went through without hindrance.
Along the way, some Alien Race Sky Islands looked at the bizarre combination of the Painful Empress and Samoyed in bewilderment.
After all, the incident of Samoyed being captured by the Painful Empress as a pet for hundreds of years was well-known in the Land of Divine War.
The gathering of these foes was indeed peculiar.
Various strong figures from tribes even discussed whether Moya had been captured again by the Painful Empress to be raised as a pet.
These discussions were unknown to Han Xing and the others.
The Painful Empress and Samoyed continued to lead the way.
Madeleine, after a few hours of rest.
Above her head, the nerve network filled with cracks began reconstruction and repair.
Then, the Painful Empress started absorbing the power of the Rules.
She quickly grew a spider’s lower body.
Then grew out six long insect legs again.
Five hours later.
A huge mother spider appeared in the void.
This also signified that the Painful Empress had returned to peak combat strength.
She turned and gave Han Xing a seductive smile.
Han Xing was unmoved, only nodding lightly.
Meanwhile, Han Xing felt a hint of joy in his heart.
"Great, like this, I have the combat power of two top-tier Divine Spirits in hand."
"Although relying on them alone still can’t handle a True God, it can hold on for a while."
"At that time, with their cooperation, I can activate the Celestial Rail Strike Device; even a True God will have to take a beating."
Thinking of this, Han Xing gained more confidence for heading to Silent City.
After advancing a bit further, Han Xing seemingly thought of something else and asked, "Madeleine, if the God of Radiance hides his aura, can he be recognized by the True Gods of Silent City?"

chapters.title: Chapter 971 - 497: City of Wails
paragraphs: "Madeleine, if the God of Radiance conceals his presence, will the True God of Silent City notice?" Han Xing asked.
The Painful Empress nodded after hearing this, "He would~"
"In front of a True God, these disguises are useless."
Hearing this, Han Xing furrowed his brows.
If they can’t hide his presence, then it’s a bit troublesome.
After all, the God of Radiance had never been to Silent City before, and suddenly there was an additional Top-tier Divine Spirit, which would likely attract the attention of that True God.
But it’s not safe without the God of Radiance.
At this moment, the Painful Empress softly said, "Master, no need to worry. Before I came out, the True God of Yellow Sand had already left Silent City and shouldn’t be back for a short period."
Hearing this, Han Xing was taken aback, "Oh? The True God of Yellow Sand isn’t home? Where did he go?"
The Painful Empress shook her head, "I’m not sure where exactly he went; I only know that recently there was a Void fluctuation, and it’s said that a Tree of Rules collapsed."
"From that moment, the True God of Yellow Sand left Silent City directly."
After hearing this, Han Xing was enlightened and nodded, knowing that what the Painful Empress said was true.
After all, he was the one who caused that disturbance.
Thinking of this, Han Xing was immediately pleased, "Then there’s no need to worry, just lead us to Silent City!"
"Alright, Master~"
The Painful Empress chuckled gently, then began to lead the way.
The Forbidden Star River is vast.
After roughly a dozen hours or so.
They gradually arrived at the so-called Silent City.
From tens of millions of kilometers away, Han Xing saw a white silhouette from afar.
That white silhouette, like a mountain ridge across the Void, was particularly noticeable.
However, Han Xing found this silhouette somewhat familiar.
He furrowed his brows and continued moving forward.
The closer he got, the more familiar the appearance of that silhouette became.
Slender limbs, snow-white fur, and a majestic wolf’s head.
It looked like a white giant wolf.
Han Xing’s breath caught, but he suppressed the anger in his heart and asked, "Madeleine, is this Silent City?"
The Painful Empress turned around and nodded gently, "Yes, Master."
Han Xing asked, "Who built Silent City, and why would they build a city on a giant wolf’s corpse?"
By now, the team members had sensed the unease in Han Xing’s tone.
The Painful Empress softly said, "Specifically, I’m not really sure. I just know that when the Blood Spider Race arrived in the Land of Divine War, Silent City was already built."
"And at that time, the City Lord was the True God of Yellow Sand."
After listening, Han Xing gently nodded.
His face showed no expression change.
However, at this moment, a chill and murderous intent surged in his heart.
Because he recognized the figure of this giant wolf.
It was the Hunter’s partner.
Previously, in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, Han Xing had met it once.
Clearly, it also perished in the last battle, its corpse floating near the Forbidden Galaxy, eternally undying.
And now, those guys actually built a massive city on its corpse.
Not only did they desecrate the Hunter’s body, but now they won’t even spare his partner’s corpse!
If not for fearing that so-called True God of Yellow Sand.
Han Xing wanted to control the Divine Demon Battleship and destroy this so-called Silent City right on the spot.
"Hoo... hoo..."
Han Xing continuously took deep breaths.
"Calm down, calm down."
"The urgent matter now is to go to Silent City and retrieve the Hunter’s body fragments from those races."
"As for these guys, I’ll deal with them one by one after I break through to a Demigod!
Han Xing adjusted his emotions, and this, too, was the reason why he came to Silent City.
From the mouth of the Bone-Eroding Griffin, he had learned that many races in Silent City held the Hunter’s body fragments.
And Han Xing was determined to reclaim all those body fragments.
Soon, they arrived above Silent City.
Here, it resembled a Great World with a round sky and square earth.
All the city buildings were constructed on a flat plane.
Han Xing saw at least hundreds of cities, both large and small.
Each city’s area was at least equivalent to the total volume of ten Blue Stars.
From this, one could imagine how immense the body of this white giant wolf was.
Moreover, the architectural style of each city here was different.
Some decayed buildings entwined with various vines, palaces directly built in the sea, and nests inside towering mountains.
At the center of Silent City.
There lay a vast desert.
In the desert, there were towering Divine Halls reaching up to ten thousand meters, as well as oases.
The Painful Empress turned to introduce, "Master, since it’s your first time in Silent City, let me give you an introduction."
Han Xing nodded.
"Here, hundreds of races from various worlds are active, and those cities are the territories granted to them by the True God of Yellow Sand."
"In Silent City, the True God of Yellow Sand has clearly stipulated that no combat is allowed, making it a haven for all the major races."
"They develop their forces here."
"Those races with only Low-tier and Middle-tier Divine Spirits need not be mentioned."
"There are nearly thirty races with High-tier or higher Divine Spirits combined."
Hearing this number, Han Xing nodded.
It wasn’t too far beyond his expectations.
After all, with so many powerful beings active here long-term, having so many high-tier Divine Spirits is not surprising.

The Painful Empress continued the introduction, "Among these thirty races, aside from the fifteen with High-tier Divine Spirits, there are seven races with Top-tier Divine Spirits, and several other races with unknown strength."

chapters.title: Chapter 972 - 497: City of Wails_2
paragraphs: Han Xing asked in confusion, "Unknown strength?"
The Painful Empress nodded, "Yes, because these races have concealed their power."
"Many races that appear to have only High-tier Divine Spirits may be hiding a Top-tier Divine Spirit."
"In some races with only Middle-tier Divine Spirits, we can even sense a True God level aura appearing and disappearing."
"For example, the Moon Shadow Bee Race and the Glacial Dragon Lion Race, these two races may both have True God level existences."
Upon hearing this, not only Han Xing but others also frowned.
Suddenly, there were potentially two more True Gods.
This Silent City indeed hides many unknown powers.
Fortunately, Han Xing was not impulsive and didn’t directly overturn Silent City.
Otherwise, he would have faced not one True God but an attack from at least three True Gods.
Thinking of this, Han Xing also felt a sense of crisis.
So, Han Xing asked, "Then if we go to Silent City now, those hidden True Gods shouldn’t come looking for trouble, right?"
The Painful Empress shook her head, "They probably won’t, because other than the True God of Yellow Sand, no other True Gods have publicly appeared in Silent City over the years."
"Therefore, they likely won’t expose themselves for this matter."
After hearing the Painful Empress’s statement, Han Xing felt slightly reassured.
He then directly said, "Madeleine, lead the way, let’s head back to your city first."
The Painful Empress softly said, "Yes, Master, I will lead you there now."
With that, she led the group straight across the sky above Silent City.
Soon they stopped in front of a giant city filled with spider webs.
The Painful Empress did not hesitate and led Han Xing and the others directly downwards.
At the same time, a system notification appeared before Han Xing and the others.
[You have discovered a special area: City of Wails.]
Meanwhile.
With the arrival of Han Xing and his group, inside this enormous city built on White Wolf’s back, many auras awakened from slumber.
They all sensed a powerful and unfamiliar aura entering Silent City.
At the very least, it was of a Top-tier Divine Spirit level.
Moreover, the location was within the City of Wails of the Painful Blood Spider Race.
Simultaneously, they received news.
The Painful Empress and Moya of the Blade Armor Demon Race returned to the Silent City together.
The gathering of these two adversaries indeed drew a lot of attention from the strong.
However, none of them released divine power to investigate.
Firstly, they were unclear who the unfamiliar Top-tier Divine Spirit in the City of Wails was.
Secondly, due to the rules set by the True God of Yellow Sand, no random investigations of others’ territories were allowed.
Upon entering the City of Wails, the scene before Han Xing and his group was quite creepy.
The city was covered with spider webs, with large mother spiders moving back and forth within.
Some were young, some mature.
Some were graceful, some alluring.
However, what’s striking was that the lower half of these beautiful women’s bodies were in the form of spiders.
Cheng Jianyong and the others looked at the spider-web-covered city with curiosity.
One could even see some large cocoons wrapped in spider silk scattered around.
It was unclear which race’s unlucky ones were trapped.
Currently, many mother spiders appeared overhead, looking curiously at Han Xing and his group from all directions.
Cheng Jianyong amusingly said, "Wow, these mother spiders are quite pretty."
Shen Yun beside him laughed, "Xiaoyongzi, I think you’ve been single for a long time if you find even spiders good-looking now?"
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, "What, don’t you think these mother spiders are quite pretty?"
Shen Yun shrugged, he didn’t argue against this point.
At this moment, the Painful Empress turned around and smiled, "Human Race friends, if you’re interested, my daughters can accompany you~"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun shivered.
They quickly waved their hands, "No, there’s no need..."
"We were just praising your daughters for their natural beauty."
Seeing their reaction, the Painful Empress covered her face and laughed lightly.
At this moment, the mother spiders overhead closed in.
They thought that these were new prey brought by the Painful Empress, each showing a look of desire in their eyes.
Some even wanted to reach out to touch Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
However, as the Painful Empress released a pulse of divine power, all the mother spiders stiffened and fell like raindrops from the sky.
The other mother spiders looked at the Painful Empress in shock, seemingly not understanding why she suddenly attacked her own kind.
The Painful Empress softly spoke, "Do not touch what you’re not supposed to touch, understood?"
In the next moment, the Blood Spiders seemed to realize something, each turned pale and retreated quickly.
The Painful Empress turned and said, "Apologies, my daughters were somewhat indiscreet."
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng and others who were frightened quickly calmed down.
They waved and said, "No, it’s alright."
This was just a minor incident, which Han Xing and the others didn’t mind.
Soon, the Painful Empress led them to a hall filled with spider webs.
As for the [Divine Demon Battleship], it was docked in the City of Wails on a large plaza.
Guarded by Blood Spiders sent by the Painful Empress.
Essentially, no strong individuals would be able to approach it.
Inside the hall.
Han Xing straightforwardly said, "Madeleine, all these years in the Land of Divine War, you must have gained quite a lot, right?"
