Suddenly, there were potentially two more True Gods.
This Silent City indeed hides many unknown powers.
Fortunately, Han Xing was not impulsive and didn’t directly overturn Silent City.
Otherwise, he would have faced not one True God but an attack from at least three True Gods.
Thinking of this, Han Xing also felt a sense of crisis.
So, Han Xing asked, "Then if we go to Silent City now, those hidden True Gods shouldn’t come looking for trouble, right?"
The Painful Empress shook her head, "They probably won’t, because other than the True God of Yellow Sand, no other True Gods have publicly appeared in Silent City over the years."
"Therefore, they likely won’t expose themselves for this matter."
After hearing the Painful Empress’s statement, Han Xing felt slightly reassured.
He then directly said, "Madeleine, lead the way, let’s head back to your city first."
The Painful Empress softly said, "Yes, Master, I will lead you there now."
With that, she led the group straight across the sky above Silent City.
Soon they stopped in front of a giant city filled with spider webs.
The Painful Empress did not hesitate and led Han Xing and the others directly downwards.
At the same time, a system notification appeared before Han Xing and the others.
[You have discovered a special area: City of Wails.]
Meanwhile.
With the arrival of Han Xing and his group, inside this enormous city built on White Wolf’s back, many auras awakened from slumber.
They all sensed a powerful and unfamiliar aura entering Silent City.
At the very least, it was of a Top-tier Divine Spirit level.
Moreover, the location was within the City of Wails of the Painful Blood Spider Race.
Simultaneously, they received news.
The Painful Empress and Moya of the Blade Armor Demon Race returned to the Silent City together.
The gathering of these two adversaries indeed drew a lot of attention from the strong.
However, none of them released divine power to investigate.
Firstly, they were unclear who the unfamiliar Top-tier Divine Spirit in the City of Wails was.
Secondly, due to the rules set by the True God of Yellow Sand, no random investigations of others’ territories were allowed.
Upon entering the City of Wails, the scene before Han Xing and his group was quite creepy.
The city was covered with spider webs, with large mother spiders moving back and forth within.
Some were young, some mature.
Some were graceful, some alluring.
However, what’s striking was that the lower half of these beautiful women’s bodies were in the form of spiders.
Cheng Jianyong and the others looked at the spider-web-covered city with curiosity.
One could even see some large cocoons wrapped in spider silk scattered around.
It was unclear which race’s unlucky ones were trapped.
Currently, many mother spiders appeared overhead, looking curiously at Han Xing and his group from all directions.
Cheng Jianyong amusingly said, "Wow, these mother spiders are quite pretty."
Shen Yun beside him laughed, "Xiaoyongzi, I think you’ve been single for a long time if you find even spiders good-looking now?"
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, "What, don’t you think these mother spiders are quite pretty?"
Shen Yun shrugged, he didn’t argue against this point.
At this moment, the Painful Empress turned around and smiled, "Human Race friends, if you’re interested, my daughters can accompany you~"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun shivered.
They quickly waved their hands, "No, there’s no need..."
"We were just praising your daughters for their natural beauty."
Seeing their reaction, the Painful Empress covered her face and laughed lightly.
At this moment, the mother spiders overhead closed in.
They thought that these were new prey brought by the Painful Empress, each showing a look of desire in their eyes.
Some even wanted to reach out to touch Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
However, as the Painful Empress released a pulse of divine power, all the mother spiders stiffened and fell like raindrops from the sky.
The other mother spiders looked at the Painful Empress in shock, seemingly not understanding why she suddenly attacked her own kind.
The Painful Empress softly spoke, "Do not touch what you’re not supposed to touch, understood?"
In the next moment, the Blood Spiders seemed to realize something, each turned pale and retreated quickly.
The Painful Empress turned and said, "Apologies, my daughters were somewhat indiscreet."
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng and others who were frightened quickly calmed down.
They waved and said, "No, it’s alright."
This was just a minor incident, which Han Xing and the others didn’t mind.
Soon, the Painful Empress led them to a hall filled with spider webs.
As for the [Divine Demon Battleship], it was docked in the City of Wails on a large plaza.
Guarded by Blood Spiders sent by the Painful Empress.
Essentially, no strong individuals would be able to approach it.
Inside the hall.
Han Xing straightforwardly said, "Madeleine, all these years in the Land of Divine War, you must have gained quite a lot, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 973 - 497: City of Wails (Part 3)
paragraphs: Upon hearing these words, the Painful Empress felt neither surprise nor reluctance, instead casually saying, "Of course, dear~ I’ve indeed amassed quite a bit of wealth over the years."
"Master, do you need them?"
The crowd seemed somewhat bewildered. The Painful Empress being so agreeable truly exceeded their expectations.
After all, the greatest goal for these powerful individuals is to become stronger, reaching higher realms.
And these treasures serve as the resources for their ascent to higher realms.
No matter how generous a person may be, they wouldn’t give them away easily.
Yet now, the Painful Empress seemed completely unconcerned.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Yes, you should know that I am gathering strength to achieve a breakthrough that only two people have accomplished in history."
"So, I need a large amount of Divine Stones and Divine Gold, as well as the Power of Rules to enhance my strength."
"Now that you’ve become someone of our faction, I won’t take them without a cause."
"In the future, when there are new True God Divine Formats and even True God Level Power of Rules, I will also bring them out to help enhance you."
Han Xing’s words are quite direct.
Invest in me now, and I’ll give you greater returns in the future.
Including the nearby God of Radiance, who also agreed, saying, "Master’s words are correct; my current strength is entirely dependent on the master’s generosity."
However, the Painful Empress indifferently said, "It’s okay~ master."
"These treasures, dear, don’t matter much to me."
"Currently, my strength has reached a critical point. Without any major opportunities, my life should stop at this realm."
"Furthermore, compared to reaching a much stronger realm, I hope to enjoy greater pain."
"If master becomes stronger, I imagine he could provide me with more intense pain?"
Han Xing’s mouth twitched.
He began to understand this maternal spider’s strange pursuit.
Upon reflection, it aligns with her name, Painful Empress.
The more pain, the more she feels pleasure and excitement.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Alright, take us there now."
The Painful Empress gently nodded.
Then, with a wave of her hands, in the next moment, everyone disappeared from their original place.
They arrived at the underground of this city.
A system prompt appeared.
[You have entered a special area: Blood Spider Race Treasure Vault]
When the group’s vision restored, they immediately felt the aura of various Divine Stones and Divine Gold surging towards them.
Han Xing saw numerous products from the Land of Divine War here, such as scales from beast bodies, horns of some monsters, and claws from them.
Apart from these, there were mountains of Philosopher’s Stones, Shimmering Terra Stones, Void Divine Stones, and so on.
The reserve of materials here reached a frightening degree.
Upon witnessing this scene, Han Xing and his companions almost instinctively wished to dash out and loot them all.
However, realizing that the Painful Empress was still beside them, they held back their actions.
The Painful Empress chuckled lightly and said, "Master, all the things here, you can take freely~"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong and others who initially wanted to take everything felt somewhat embarrassed.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Your Blood Spider Race still needs to develop. I can’t take everything; I’ll just take half for now."
Upon hearing this, the Painful Empress lightly touched her lips with her finger, "Alright~ Thank you, master, for considering us~"
Han Xing waved his hand and then said, "Let’s get to work, everyone."
The crowd, after hearing this, exchanged smiles.
Then, Cheng Jianyong laughed, "Let’s start looting!"
The team members directly walked to the piles of Divine Stones and Divine Gold and gathered all of these items.
System prompts kept appearing.
[Acquired Philosopher’s Stone *17203]
[Acquired Shimmering Terra Stone *23103]
[Acquired Chaos Divine Stone *491]
[Acquired Giant Beast Scale (Red) *17]
As they walked through, they swept with Divine Power.
Leaving half of the materials on the ground.
But despite this, their gains were still quite terrifying.
They were watching the material numbers in their backpacks growing crazily.
Han Xing, Cheng Jianyong, and others had joyous expressions at the corners of their mouths.
Meanwhile, too, the Painful Empress walked towards the depths of the treasure vault on her own.
Five minutes later.
Han Xing and others had almost moved all the materials in this vault.
Then he tallied up the harvest.
Cumulative acquisition.
[Philosopher’s Stone *28.31 million]
[Shimmering Terra Stone *17.32 million]
[Chaos Divine Stone *140 thousand]
[Calamity Divine Gold *70 thousand]
Besides these, there were Thunder Divine Stones, Extreme Ice Divine Stones, Red Flame Divine Gold, Waveless Metal, and other Element materials, totaling 16.63 million.
As well as various other Divine-level materials, roughly occupying hundreds of backpacks.
Now, half of the remaining metals and Divine Stones in the warehouse were just left exactly.
Simultaneously, the Painful Empress also walked out.
She moved her six slender legs to Han Xing.
Then, she slowly opened her palm.
At this moment.
Five Divine Formats of different sizes floated in the air, radiating multicolored divine light.
One of them emanated a crystal-colored Divine Format, showing a very strong Divine Power wave.
Han Xing’s eyes sharpened, "True God Level Divine Format!"
Hearing this, not only Han Xing and his companions but also the nearby God of Radiance showed an expression of astonishment.
It’s worth noting, he’s just a year away from breaking through to a True God.
And this process can be accelerated with a True God Level Divine Format.
That is to say, once Radiance uses this Divine Format, he can immediately break through to become a True God!
Moreover, it doesn’t stop there.
The Painful Empress opened another hand.
Two glowing nerve networks appeared,
Which are the Power of Rules, a total of two!
At this moment, even Han Xing was somewhat shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 974 - 498: 100,000 Divine Power, Activate Infinite Domain!
paragraphs: The Pain Empress suddenly took out five Divine Formats and two powers from the rules, surprising Han Xing.
"Madeleine, so many?"
The Pain Empress nodded, chuckling lightly, "This is just a small portion that’s been accumulated over thousands of years."
"Most of them have been used by me or bestowed upon the little spiders under my command."
"I hope you won’t mind."
Han Xing did not speak; he certainly wouldn’t mind.
On the contrary, the Pain Empress’s generosity indeed exceeded Han Xing’s expectations.
Thus, Han Xing nodded and said, "Thank you."
Upon hearing Han Xing express gratitude, the Pain Empress paused, then covered her face and laughed ’giggling.’
Her smooth shoulders were shaking slightly.
A moment later, the Pain Empress handed all these Divine Formats and the power of the rules to Han Xing and then said.
"Master, please accept them."
Han Xing nodded, directly scanning them with divine power.
System notifications appeared.
[Upon obtaining: Divine Form·Radiant]
[Upon obtaining: Divine Form: Sea Waves]
[Upon obtaining: Divine Format: Fish]
[Upon obtaining: Divine Crystal]
[Upon obtaining: Divine Form: Ghost]
[Upon obtaining: Power of Rules: Sky]
[Upon obtaining: Rule Power: Magma]
A total of five Divine Formats, plus two complete powers of rules.

Among these five Divine Formats, except for the "Crystal" Divine Format, all others are Divine Formats of ordinary divine spirits, offering increased Divine Power Values between 2000 and 4000 upon absorption.
Only the one "Crystal" Divine Format radiated a strong divine power fluctuation.
Moreover, the divine power value it could increase upon absorption ranged between 5000 and 8000.
Han Xing then asked, "Radiance, is the Crystal a True God?
Upon hearing the name "Crystal,"
The God of Radiance seemed puzzled.
After contemplating for a moment, he shook his head and said, "Not quite sure, in my era, there seemed to be no divine spirit governing the crystal rules."
"Perhaps, he emerged as a divine spirit after I hid within the giant beast’s body."
Han Xing nodded, simply disinterested in whether "Crystal" was a True God.
No matter what, their current power was already enough to barely counter a True God.
By then, the God of Radiance could absorb this Divine Format too and break through to the True God Realm.
It’s equivalent to Han Xing and the others possessing the ability to simultaneously deal with two True Gods.
Thus, he was less worried about those True Gods causing trouble.
Han Xing then promptly threw the shimmering crystal-like Divine Format to the God of Radiance.
The God of Radiance decisively took it and then asked, "Master, should I break through to True God now?"
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing didn’t answer but instead asked, "Radiance, is breaking through to True God a big commotion?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Quite significant, divine spirits need to absorb a lot of rule power when breaking through to True God."
"Then, forming a Tree of Rules from a Rule Leaf will cause turbulence among the rules in the void."
"I fear that the entire Land of Divine War will feel this commotion."
"Beings of Divine Spirit Level and above will know someone is breaking through to True God."
Han Xing nodded in realization; the commotion was indeed significant.
Once the God of Radiance started the breakthrough, it would undoubtedly draw numerous divine spirits and even True Gods to investigate.
By then, Han Xing and the others would be exposed.
Han Xing continued to ask, "How much time does it take to break through to True God?"
The God of Radiance replied, "Shouldn’t take long; my current power of rules has reached a critical point."
"By then, using this Crystal Divine Format to push through the limit, should be smooth sailing."
After the God of Radiance finished speaking, Han Xing had an idea in his mind.
"Alright then, don’t break through now, wait until things at the Silent City are resolved, then I’ll take you to a secluded place to break through directly."
The God of Radiance nodded.
Then, in front of everyone, Han Xing absorbed all four Divine Formats.
Crack! Crack!
The sound of crystal breaking echoed repeatedly, with rule power spreading around.
Han Xing directly swept through with divine power, absorbing all these rule powers.
System notifications appeared.
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Form·Radiant, Divine Power Value +2500]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Form: Sea Waves, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format: Fish, Divine Power Value +2000]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Form: Ghost, Divine Power Value +3500]
The four Divine Formats caused Han Xing’s Divine Power Value to surge by 11,000!
His Divine Power Value officially broke through the 100,000 mark!
When breaking through this checkpoint, Han Xing felt like he had shattered some kind of shackle.
His aura suddenly became deeper and more refined.
Like having an essence of returning to simplicity.
Everyone on the scene, including the Pain Empress, looked at Han Xing’s transformation in amazement.
Meanwhile, Han Xing’s gaze showed strong astonishment.
Because a system notification appeared before him.
[Detected Survivor Han Xing, breaking through 100,000 Divine Power Value in the Legendary Realm, achieving the milestone: Pursuer of Extremes!]
[Received special reward: Infinite Domain Level 1 (special hidden skill)]
Han Xing was deeply shocked.
"Pursuer of Extremes, Infinite Domain? What are these?"
With a sense of curiosity, Han Xing checked the skill attributes of this newly acquired skill.
[Infinite Domain Level 1: special hidden skill]

[Effect 1: With yourself at the center, activate 1 layer of Infinite Domain within a radius of 100,000 meters, increasing All Attributes (including Divine Power Value) of all friendly units (including defense towers, territory buildings, pets, servants, etc.) within the domain by 10%, and granting yourself an additional 10% damage reduction effect.]

[Effect 2: Within the Infinite Domain, you possess infinite creativity, allowing you to simulate once the strongest attack recorded upon domain activation and inflict 10% of the damage from this attack.]

chapters.title: Chapter 975 - 498: 100,000 Divine Power, Activate Infinite Domain! (Part 2)
paragraphs: After reading the Effect of this [Infinite Domain], Han Xing took a deep breath!
Holy shit!
All Attributes increased by 10%.
And it can also apply to all allied units!
And that’s not even the most important part.
What’s the key point?
This Infinite Domain can amplify Defense Towers!
You have to know, his strongest means right now are those Defense Towers.
With the amplification from the two Sun Crown Steles, any random Defense Tower already has at least over a million Attack Power!
Han Xing didn’t know whether this 10% amplification was boosting the Defense Tower’s base Attack Power,
or boosting the Attack Power after the Sun Crown Stele amplification.
If it’s the latter, that would be terrifying!
Take the Celestial Rail Strike Device as an example—after the Sun Crown Stele amplification, its Attack Power is 150 million.
At that point, Han Xing’s [Infinite Domain] adding another 10% would make it a full 165 million Attack Power, which is an enormous increase.
And besides the first Effect, the description of the second Effect was a bit vague.
Han Xing didn’t know what "simulated Attack" was supposed to mean.
But just from the Skills description, he could tell this Effect had to be insanely strong too.
Han Xing decided to test it later.
Then he glanced at his Divine Power Value.
[Divine Power Value: 104712]
"Good, I’m only short a bit over ninety thousand Divine Power Value, plus two complete strands of Power of Rules."
"Then I can directly break through to Demigod!"
Han Xing was overwhelmed with excitement.
At the same time.
Han Xing suddenly had a wild idea and decided to test the first Effect of this [Infinite Domain].
In an instant, a strange Power burst out from Han Xing’s body.
Everyone suddenly felt a surge of Power drill into their bodies, making their All Attributes skyrocket by a huge chunk.
Even the God of Radiance at his side was extremely shocked.
He clearly felt his own Power suddenly strengthen by another large step!
Know that the God of Radiance’s combat strength now was already at the ceiling for Divine Spirits, making it very hard to improve any further.
Not even half of all Divine Spirits could make the God of Radiance’s strength increase by even a tiny bit.
Yet from a mere Legend, he was actually feeling such a powerful amplification Effect from this man—so strong that it faintly seemed about to break through the limits of a Divine Spirit!
The God of Radiance said in astonishment, "Master, this Power on you is so incredible!"
Even the aura on the Painful Empress beside him was rapidly rising.
It directly reached the same height the God of Radiance had before.
The Painful Empress curiously watched the changes in her own body, then licked the corner of her mouth and said,
"Master~ Your Power is flowing inside this slave’s body, giving this slave such a wonderfully full feeling~"
Han Xing didn’t bother paying attention to the Painful Empress’s bizarre lines.
He just nodded and said, "Looks like this Infinite Domain’s Effect is pretty good. Everyone’s had a substantial boost."
And just then.
The Painful Empress and the God of Radiance, who were still immersed in the strengthened State, both had their expressions change slightly at the same time.
Han Xing noticed the change in their expressions and asked, "What’s wrong?"
The Painful Empress said softly, "Seems like a short-tempered guy is coming~"
"A short-tempered guy?"
The Painful Empress nodded. "That’s right, it’s Zigu from the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race, also a Top-tier Divine Spirit."
Hearing "Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race," Han Xing froze for a moment.
Then he more or less figured out this guy’s purpose.
Most likely the other party was coming for Samoyed.
Earlier they’d taken down the Middle-tier Divine Spirit of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race.
And in the intel these guys from Silent City had, that Middle-tier Divine Spirit had died at Samoyed’s hands.
This guy was very likely here seeking revenge.
Sure enough, before Han Xing and the others even went out, they heard a loud shout from above their heads.
"Painful Empress, hand Moya over!"
At this moment, Moya at the side wore a bitter expression.
It knew that after carrying so many blame-pots, there was no way it wouldn’t be hassled by other powerhouses.
Cheng Jianyong patted its scale-covered back and said, "Samoyed, don’t pull such a long face."
"It’s just some small Evil Ghost Tree Demon. With Brother Xing here, what are you worried about?"
Samoyed nodded at those words as well.
It knew how strong Han Xing was; dealing with a Top-tier Divine Spirit was no problem at all.
At this time, the Painful Empress looked at Han Xing beside her and softly asked, "Master~ shall we go out?"
Han Xing nodded. "Yeah, let’s go out and see what this guy wants to do."
The Painful Empress nodded, the corner of her mouth curling up into an arc.
Then with a grand wave of her hand, everyone left the underground city.
When they returned to the surface of the ’City of Wails’—
Everyone looked up to see a gigantic purple tree stump above their heads, covering the Sky and Sun.

In front of Han Xing, this guy’s name appeared.
[Evil Tree Demon: Zigu]
[Level: ???]
[Attributes: ???]
[Skills: ???]
[Divine Power Value: ???]
Aside from the name, all its other Attributes were completely unreadable.
Right now Han Xing and the others were standing inside the palace, covered in spider silk, disguised as a bunch of prey that had been captured.
The God of Radiance was in the same getup.
The Painful Empress moved her long insect legs and chuckled lightly. "Zigu, what brings you to this slave’s City of Wails?"
The facial features on that colossal tree stump shifted, glaring at the Painful Empress as it roared, "Madeleine, don’t play dumb here."
"Moya killed Borco of my race. I’m taking it back now to give my people an explanation!"
The Painful Empress raised a finger and tapped her lips. "Oh? How come this slave doesn’t know that Moya killed your race’s Borco?"

chapters.title: Chapter 976 - 498: 100,000 Divine Power, Activate the Infinite Domain! (Part 3)
paragraphs: "Also, you should speak more respectfully to me."
"If you anger me, the consequences could be quite serious~"
Zigu Yi furrowed his brow, "Madeleine, what do you mean?"
"According to the rules of the Land of Divine War, hatred between two races should be resolved by the parties involved."
"Are you here to stand up for Moya now?"
His tone carried a hint of malice.
Equally top-ranking deities, Zigu Yi was among the strongest and most hot-tempered.
However, the Painful Empress was completely unafraid of his threats, covering her face with a laugh.
"What does the rules of the Land of Divine War have to do with me?"
"I only know that Moya is a little pet that I managed to capture with great effort."
"If you really want to trouble him, why didn’t you act before me, why wait until after I brought Moya back to Silent City to come and demand an explanation?"
"Could it be that you, Zigu Yi, are afraid of something, and therefore didn’t dare to act?"
In the sky, the gigantic purple stump’s face changed color.
Zigu Yi immediately retorted, "Hmph! I was in seclusion before, and only when I emerged did I find out that Borco had been killed by Moya!"
"Just as I was about to act, I received news that Moya had already been taken back to Silent City by you."
He explained impatiently.
The Painful Empress chuckled again, "Hehehe~ So that’s how it is."
"Let’s just say it like that."
"But, Zigu Yi, I think you’ve got something wrong."
"Moya did not break through to the High-tier Divine Spirit; he doesn’t even possess the strength of the Middle-tier Divine Spirit Level, so how could he have killed Borco?"
Upon hearing this, Zigu Yi furrowed his brow.
He also sensed that something seemed off about Moya’s aura.
The reports said Moya had already ascended to a High-tier Divine Spirit.
However, now, there is no sign of a High-tier Divine Spirit’s aura, not even that of a Low-tier Divine Spirit.
Moreover, he seemed to still carry hints of injury.
This greatly contradicts Zigu Yi’s intel.
Zigu Yi furrowed his brow and asked, "Moya, what is going on?"
"Was Borco of my race not killed by you?"
Below, Samoyed certainly wouldn’t admit to it and replied, "It definitely wasn’t me who killed him!"
"I’m just a Middle-tier Divine Spirit, how could I possibly have defeated Borco?"
Zigu Yi continued asking, "Then what about your injuries, what’s the story there?"
This question left Samoyed momentarily at a loss for words.
Zigu Yi’s pupils shifted; he seemed to understand something.
"Madeleine, was my race’s Borco killed by you?"
"You saw Borco’s fight with Moya."
"Then you suddenly struck, first killing Borco, then injuring Moya, and took the opportunity to capture him, didn’t you?"
The Painful Empress laughed again, "Zigu Yi, you have quite the imagination."
"However, I must inform you, I have never met your race’s Borco, nor was it I who killed him."
Zigu Yi remained skeptical upon hearing this, furrowing his brow, "If that’s the case, then return Moya to me."
"I’ll take him to my race’s territory for questioning and ensure he’s not a problem before returning him to you."
Upon hearing this, the smile on the Painful Empress’s face vanished, replaced by a cold expression, "Zigu Yi, you know Moya is my little pet."
"You want me to hand Moya over to you; do you truly believe that you can intimidate me?"
Upon speaking, a terrifying divine power erupted from the Painful Empress.
Within a million-mile radius, throughout the ’City of Wails,’ a dense red spider web appeared.
This web directly enveloped the Painful Tree Demon’s body entirely.
Zigu Yi hadn’t anticipated that the Painful Empress would change so quickly, acting as soon as she spoke.
But he was not a patient sort either; at once, a burst of purple divine power exploded from him!
The two opposing divine powers began clashing.
The terrifying energy fluctuations even caused the powerful figures across Silent City to sense them!
"Madeleine, don’t be so ungrateful after accepting favors!"
"Despite being equals amongst top-tier divine spirits, your skills in direct combat aren’t a match for mine. Should you choose to wage war against me, you are sure to be the one who loses!"
At this moment, the Painful Empress didn’t reply.
Instead, an aura of cruelty, pain, and malice gradually emanated from her body.
This aura faintly overwhelmed the Evil Ghost Tree Demon, causing the little spiders in the City of Wails to look at their Empress with terror.
In Silent City, there was not a single top-tier divine spirit who was a pushover.
The Painful Empress licked her lips, then chuckled, "Zigu Yi, you have angered me!"
"I will surely bind you within the spider web, tear you apart bit by bit, and then devour you."
Those familiar with the Painful Empress knew she was now in a state of Anger.
She was like a jungle hunter, having locked onto her target.
Meanwhile, deep within Zigu Yi’s heart rose a sense of dread.
Initially set on launching a divine spirit battle, Madeleine suddenly heard a voice transmission.
"Madeleine, apart from Zigu Yi, how many spirits does this Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race have in the Silent City?"

The aura emanating from the Painful Empress suddenly paused, and she transmitted back, "Master, the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race is relatively formidable; when I returned, I sensed around five spirits in Silent City."
"However, their strength isn’t significant, at most Middle-tier Divine Spirit Level."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s heart stirred.
He rapidly analyzed in his mind and already formed a plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 977 - 499: The Mad Plan
paragraphs: Han Xing transmitted his voice to the Painful Empress: "Madeleine, in a moment you directly drag it into the Void for battle."
"Then try to delay the duration of the fight as much as possible."
"I’ll take Radiance and first go to the lair of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race to steal their treasury."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s plan, the Painful Empress’s eyes lit up.
She giggled like a little girl participating in some mischief.
In the sky, Zigu watched the Painful Empress’s strange behavior.
One moment furious, another moment childish.
"Madeleine, why are you laughing?"
The Painful Empress chuckled softly: "It’s nothing, I just thought of something funny~"
Zigu furrowed his brows again, simultaneously raising his guard, fearing the Painful Empress might pull some stunts.
The Painful Empress secretly transmitted back: "Master, you just reminded me, and I suddenly have a more daring idea."
Han Xing was taken aback, "What is it?"

The Painful Empress replied: "Since Master plans to steal from the lair of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race, although those ordinary divine spirits won’t notice, once Zigu becomes aware, he will definitely try everything to investigate you guys."
"By then, in his furious urgency, he’ll ask the True God of Yellow Sand to intervene, and they’ll definitely find out it was you."
Hearing this, Han Xing frowned.
He already had some understanding of the formidable power of the True Gods.
Their methods are simply heaven-defying, able to deduce the truth from mere traces.
According to the God of Radiance.
Some True Gods even have the means to reverse time and space, extremely absurd.
Han Xing asked: "Madeleine, do you have any suggestions?"
The Painful Empress chuckled softly: "My suggestion is to go all out!"
"In a moment, I will openly declare a life-and-death duel with Zigu, drawing the attention of all the strong contenders in Silent City!"
"Then, Master, you can take advantage of the distraction to loot those great races."
"I’ll provide you a map, noting which powerful tribes might hide top-tier divine spirits or True Gods,"
"Master just needs to avoid these races, then you can plunder extensively."
"After finishing this big heist, we’ll leave Silent City directly.
Listening to the Painful Empress’s ambitious plan, even Han Xing was a bit stunned on the spot.
Holy crap!
He originally just planned to steal from one race’s lair.
Now the Painful Empress says what?
She’s letting him raid most of the races’ lairs in Silent City!
That’s a bit too crazy, isn’t it?
However, Han Xing liked this kind of madness.
Obviously, if Han Xing succeeded, the rewards from this operation would far exceed any previous yield they had!
After all, these are the accumulation of numerous races in Silent City through the years in the Land of Divine War!
Though once the matter exposes, they’d be hunted by at least hundreds of divine spirits, dozens of top-tier divine spirits, and even True Gods.
But likewise, high risk also represents high profit.
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly said: "Alright, Madeleine, let’s proceed according to plan."
The Painful Empress also chuckled lightly.
Then, she soared into the sky, opening her mouth: "Zigu, shall we play a game?"
Zigu’s eyes looked strange: "Madeleine, what trick are you trying now?"
The Painful Empress chuckled: "Don’t you want Moya?"
"Let’s make a wager, have a life-and-death duel with me."
"We’ll fight with all our strength and see who can kill the other."
"The winner not only obtains Moya but also everything from the other’s race, how about it?"
Her voice was soft, yet using her special means, this voice spread throughout the entire Silent City.
Simultaneously, countless gazes turned towards the sky, puzzled.
"This voice seems to be from the Painful Empress?"
"She just said she wants a life-and-death duel with Zigu, and is betting her whole race?"
"Good heavens! How did such a big move come about suddenly?
The Painful Empress’s words instantly attracted the attention of over half of Silent City.
Yet Zigu’s expression turned somewhat baffled.
He questioned in confusion: "Madeleine, are you mad?"
"For one Moya, you want to fight me to the death, and wager your entire race?"
At this moment, the Painful Empress chuckled lightly: "Zigu, are you afraid?"
With such a provocation, Zigu’s face turned furious, "Madeleine, do you wish for death that much?"
The Painful Empress licked her lips, "Zigu, are you afraid?"
In the next moment, she deliberately shot out a spider web.
Poof!
Zigu’s massive body was instantly enveloped by the Divine Power Spider Web.
The moment those webs touched its flesh body, they emitted hissing sounds!
As if tightening into its flesh, the more it struggled, the tighter they became.
"Damn it!"
Zigu hadn’t expected the Painful Empress to act so decisively, attacking at the mention.
"Roar!"
Zigu roared furiously, millions of branches began to swing wildly.
Crash!
Yet, no matter how much it resisted, the webs upon its body only continued to constrict.
Hundreds of branches had already been sliced off by the webs!
At this moment, the Painful Empress on the side manipulated threads in her hands as if controlling a marionette.
Simultaneously, she continued to spin more Divine Power Spider Webs, entangling Zigu.
Only at this moment did Zigu truly understand the Painful Empress’s might!
Their kind, these top-tier divine spirits, each have their signature techniques.
Zigu realized that if he didn’t use his true power soon, he’d really be completely trapped by the Painful Empress, never to escape!

He questioned in confusion: "Madeleine, are you mad?"
"For one Moya, you want to fight me to the death, and wager your entire race?"
At this moment, the Painful Empress chuckled lightly: "Zigu, are you afraid?"
With such a provocation, Zigu’s face turned furious, "Madeleine, do you wish for death that much?"
The Painful Empress licked her lips, "Zigu, are you afraid?"
In the next moment, she deliberately shot out a spider web.
Poof!
Zigu’s massive body was instantly enveloped by the Divine Power Spider Web.
The moment those webs touched its flesh body, they emitted hissing sounds!
As if tightening into its flesh, the more it struggled, the tighter they became.
"Damn it!"
Zigu hadn’t expected the Painful Empress to act so decisively, attacking at the mention.
"Roar!"
Zigu roared furiously, millions of branches began to swing wildly.
Crash!
Yet, no matter how much it resisted, the webs upon its body only continued to constrict.
Hundreds of branches had already been sliced off by the webs!
At this moment, the Painful Empress on the side manipulated threads in her hands as if controlling a marionette.
Simultaneously, she continued to spin more Divine Power Spider Webs, entangling Zigu.
Only at this moment did Zigu truly understand the Painful Empress’s might!
Their kind, these top-tier divine spirits, each have their signature techniques.
Zigu realized that if he didn’t use his true power soon, he’d really be completely trapped by the Painful Empress, never to escape!

chapters.title: Chapter 978 - 499: The Crazy Plan! (Part 2)
paragraphs: The next moment.
Zigu’s body no longer swelled, but shrank a hundred times in an instant.
It turned into a giant tree ten thousand meters tall.
Then, purple flames ignited from its body.
These purple flames started burning the Divine Power Spider Web of the Painful Empress, twisting the space with their terrifying heat.
Crack! Crack!
The threads of the web snapped one by one.
Both sides began a confrontation of divine power.
The battle between these two top-tier entities attracted the attention of the entire Silent City.
More and more powerful entities soared into the sky, heading towards the City of Wails.
The Painful Empress’s lips curled into a slight arc.
Because this was exactly the effect she wanted.
As more and more powerful entities gathered around.
The Painful Empress lightly laughed, "Zigu, let’s fight in the void."
As she spoke, the Painful Empress transformed into a red stream of light, rapidly charging towards the void.
Zigu hesitated for a moment, then followed suit.
Seeing the protagonists of the battle leave.
The surrounding powerful entities exchanged glances, then also flew towards them.
Among them, Han Xing sensed at least a dozen high-tier Divine Spirits and two or three top-tier Divine Spirits.
At this moment, the team members looked at Han Xing with puzzled faces.
As if unaware of what he had discussed with the Painful Empress, causing such a sudden change.
Han Xing understood the team’s confusion and quickly explained his plan to them.
After listening to Han Xing’s explanation, the team members showed not only a sense of realization but also a trace of shock in their eyes.
They couldn’t help but be surprised by the Painful Empress’s bold idea.
Cheng Jianyong laughed, "This Painful Empress is really interesting."
"She’s not afraid of making a big deal, nor worried that things might get exposed and implicate her."
Shen Yun nodded, "Indeed interesting, but this also indirectly shows that those gathered around Brother Xing are not ordinary people."
Hearing this, everyone exchanged smiles.
Han Xing then said, "Let’s move, let’s do it!"
"If we succeed, our power will definitely skyrocket!"
"At least, I will gather the Divine Format and Power of Rules needed to break through to a Demigod!"
Everyone nodded in unison, feeling a bit excited.
At the same time.
The God of Radiance also heard about Han Xing’s plan and understood the significance of this action.
He directly released divine power to help the team members conceal their aura.
The Samoyed remained in place.
A group of six quietly left the City of Wails.
Meanwhile, as the news of the Painful Empress and Zigu, two top-tier Divine Spirits, battling to the death in the void spread.
In a lake ten thousand miles deep, a terrifying creature covered in tentacles and with a fish-like body suddenly opened its eyes.
"Interesting, the Painful Empress and Zigu are going to fight to the death?"
"Just right, I’ve been stuck in the high-tier Divine Spirit realm for years, let’s see just how strong these so-called top-tier Divine Spirits are!"
As it spoke, a vortex appeared in the lake.
Then, a terrifying figure burst into the sky.
At the same time, in a city shrouded by corrupted ice and snow, a giant dragon, its entire body like an ice crystal, began to tremble.
It seemed to have been stationary here for thousands of years.
When it spread its wings, there was a crisp ’crack, crack’ sound.
Whoosh—whoosh—
The massive wings flapped, and this ice crystal giant dragon gradually flew into the sky.
Apart from these two places.
Throughout the Silent City, in hundreds of different areas, the aura of Divine Spirits erupted.
More and more Divine Spirits, either awakening from a dormant state or exiting a cultivation state.
Upon receiving the news, they reacted like the others.
They burst out of the Silent City, heading to the void to witness the battle between the two top-tier Divine Spirits.
After all, opportunities like this are not common.
Top-tier Divine Spirits are an extremely terrifying existence to them.
If they can gain something from the Painful Empress and Zigu’s battle, it would be a worthwhile experience.
More and more Divine Spirits left Silent City.
At this time, six figures moved in the opposite direction of these Divine Spirits.
It was Han Xing and his team.
After leaving the City of Wails.
Han Xing immediately opened the map to check the area closest to them.
Then, Han Xing quickly locked onto a target.
It was a city covered in black crystal, lined with buildings made of black crystal.
This is the territory of the Crystal Bone Demon race!
Under the cover of the God of Radiance, they soon arrived above the city.
Han Xing directly said, "Radiance, scout the number and power of strong entities left here."
The God of Radiance did not hesitate and immediately began a divine power search.
Because he knew their time was tight.
They must raid more cities before the Painful Empress’s side concludes.
"Buzz!"
Invisible divine power waves swept over.
In less than a second, the God of Radiance had the answers.
He reported, "Master, I have scouted. Inside, there’s only one low-tier Divine Spirit left, the rest are Demigods and some Legends."
Hearing this number, Han Xing felt reassured.
Then, he said again, "Continue scouting, find the location of this race’s treasures and the entry pathway, and determine a safe route."
The God of Radiance nodded and began sensing meticulously again.
This time, he spent a bit longer.
Divine power waves swept repeatedly, from the ground to tens of thousands of kilometers underground, not letting any area go unchecked.

chapters.title: Chapter 979 - 499: The Mad Plan! (Part 3)
paragraphs: Twenty seconds later, the God of Radiance suddenly opened his eyes.
Then he spoke, "Master, I’ve found it."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing and his companions immediately rejoiced.
"Great, now take us there!"
The God of Radiance nodded and, without any pause, led the group straight to a remote corner of the black city below.
There seemed to be a hidden passage there.
They dashed into the passage, unobstructed under the cover of the God of Radiance.
This city, as vast as a continent, housed powerful beings of Divine Spirit Level who were entirely unaware.
And the prohibitive measures they set were completely ineffective against the divine power of the God of Radiance.
Within ten seconds, they followed this passage and advanced a hundred thousand meters.
Through twists and turns, breaking through numerous restrictions.
Then, they reached a hidden basement.
There was no light here.
However, in the radiance naturally emitted by the gems, everything was so bright.
Before them were heaps and heaps of Shadow Divine Stones, Extreme Ice Divine Stones, Shimmering Terra Stones, and other treasures piled high.
The quantity of materials here was already comparable to the value of those in the Light God’s Treasure Vault!
The group immediately held their breath in awe.
Han Xing took a deep breath and said, "Radiance, shield the divine power fluctuations here with all your might."
"Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, let’s move quickly."
"There are five layers in this area."
"Within ten seconds, we must clear out everything and then leave."
Upon hearing this, the team members all nodded.
The next moment, Han Xing announced decisively, "Let’s begin the action now!"
As soon as he spoke, Han Xing had already rushed forward.
This time, he didn’t bother to see what items were on the ground, collecting everything, whether valuable or not, indiscriminately.
System notifications appeared one after another.
[Acquired Philosopher’s Stone *127231]
[Acquired Shimmering Terra Stone *21352]
[Acquired Black Abyss Stone *15334]
[Acquired...]
With the five members looting at full speed, they cleared out the first layer of the basement in just two seconds.
At that moment, their actions seemed to have triggered some kind of restriction here.
The entire basement began to tremble slightly, and a fierce Power of Restriction appeared ready to burst.
Han Xing’s expression changed.
Boom!
However, as the divine power of the God of Radiance burst forth, the Power of Restriction was forcibly suppressed.
The group breathed a sigh of relief.
They exchanged glances, then immediately dashed out, racing to the second layer to continue their frantic looting.
The second layer was similarly filled with Divine Stones, Divine Gold, and some special items.
Han Xing and the others collected everything in sight.
[Acquired Black Gold Stone *182315]
[Acquired Philosopher’s Stone *251466]
[Acquired Waveless Metal *63314]
[Acquired Calamity Divine Gold *14331]
[Acquired...]
As the fourth second ended, they hurriedly rushed to the third layer.
The basement had a total of five layers.
In the third layer, they spent another two seconds plundering the entire storehouse clean.
Next, the fourth layer.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed with delight, while looting, "Whoa! Whoa! This feels so great!"
"The wealth accumulated by these races over a thousand years, taken by us in one swoop, robbed and then ran."
"It feels like sneaking into old Wang’s house next door to steal things without having to be responsible!"
The group collectively rolled their eyes.
Apparently, Cheng Jianyong’s peculiar analogy left them at a loss for words.
However, this reckless looting felt indeed thrilling.
It’s as though money was scattered everywhere, and you could just pick it up.
By the eighth second, they finished looting the fourth layer of the basement warehouse.
Next was the final fifth layer.
Here, besides the precious metals,
they also saw six divine formats floating on an altar!
Even more astonishingly, there were two complete rules beside the six divine formats!
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in shock, "Whoa! Six divine formats! Two complete rules!"
"We’re rich, we’re rich!"
The group also showed intense excitement in their eyes.
Suppressing his inner joy, Han Xing quickly communicated with divine power, "We’ll split up; I’ll collect these divine formats, and you all grab the rest of the materials from the fifth layer.
The group nodded.
With that, they transformed into five streaks of light, rushing to different positions.
In an instant, Han Xing reached the side of the six divine formats and two powers of rules.
With a sweep of divine power, he directly collected them.
System notifications appeared.
[Acquired Divine Format·Monkey]
[Acquired Divine Format·Cangying]
[Acquired Divine Format·Ash]
[Acquired Divine Format·Cloud]
[Acquired Divine Format·Xia]
[Acquired Divine Format·Snow Mountain]
Next were the remaining two powers of rules.
[Acquired Power of Rules·Rock Giant]
[Acquired Power of Rules·Mammoth]
Seeing ten complete powers of rules in his backpack, Han Xing felt intense joy within!
Finally, another condition was completed!
Now, he only needed to elevate his divine power value to 200,000 to officially become the third entity in history to break the rules.
Just then, Han Xing suddenly felt an intense burst of black divine power emanating from the altar where the divine formats and rules were originally placed.
His act of forcibly taking these divine formats seemed to have triggered a prohibition.
A cloud of black mist instantly spread.
Han Xing frowned.
At that moment, a brilliant golden light descended from overhead, forcibly suppressing the black mist.
Han Xing breathed a sigh of relief, then immediately said, "Let’s go, quickly to the next place!"
With that, the five of them instantly became streaks of light, appearing on the first layer.
Upon seeing Han Xing and others return.
The God of Radiance, without any pause, directly unleashed golden divine power, enveloping them all!
Whoosh!
The group instantly vanished from their original spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 980 - 500: Frenzied Looting, Wealth Soars!
paragraphs: The True God of Radiance took Han Xing and his group of five and vanished straight into the Crystal Bone Demon’s treasury.
The next moment, the group of six reappeared in the sky above Silent City.
At the same time.
The battle between the Painful Empress and the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Zigu officially began.
Even from such a distance, they could sense the waves of divine power coming through.
This clearly showed how intense the battle was.
But now was not the time to focus on that.
Han Xing needed to cherish the time the Painful Empress had secured for him and plunder as many treasuries from different races as possible.
He continued to examine the map of Silent City.
Beyond the Crystal Bone Demon race was a terrain resembling a muddy swamp.
That was the territory of the Funeral Bell Demon Fish race.
This was also a ferocious race, able to move freely on land, in swamps, and even in water.
They looked like piranhas but were even more vicious than the piranha race.
When they arrived above the swamp, without needing Han Xing to say anything, the God of Radiance had already begun his investigation.
Ten seconds later, the God of Radiance opened his eyes.
"I have detected it. Deep within the swamp, there are about two divine-level Funeral Bell Demon Fish."
"And the location where they hide their treasures is about seven hundred thousand meters deep in the swamp, where there seems to be a space bubble."
"There’s no restriction sensed on that space bubble, I can teleport the master there instantly."
Hearing this, Han Xing was delighted.
He then said directly, "Great, let’s move now."
The God of Radiance nodded.
The next moment, a burst of invisible divine power illuminated, and the group vanished from their original spot.
Then, they indeed arrived at the depths of the swamp.
It wasn’t as dirty or foul-smelling as imagined.
Instead, there was an invisible divine power shield separating the mud.
This was the space bubble the God of Radiance had mentioned.
Han Xing took a look, and the durability of the space bubble appeared before his eyes.
[Funeral Bell Demon Fish Race Space Bubble]
[Durability: 120 million]
A durability value of over a hundred million, equivalent to the health of a top demigod.
Plus 100,000 armor.
Without using the Divine Demon Battleship, it would take them some time to break open this space bubble.
If they attacked forcefully, it would alert the Funeral Bell Demon Fish race and other divine-level creatures.
After all, the God of Radiance had just said there were two divine-level Funeral Bell Demon Fish here.
"Radiance, is there a way to take us directly inside?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "I’m deciphering, please wait a moment, master."
The group watched as the God of Radiance’s divine power began to sweep over the space bubble wave after wave.
He closed his eyes to sense carefully.
A moment later, the God of Radiance suddenly opened his eyes and said, "I’ve found the weak spot in the space, I can teleport you to that area directly."
Such a space bubble is akin to a barrier of a small world.
Just not as hard and complete as a small world barrier.
So generally, space bubbles will have one or two weak spots, which are the entrance and exit left by the Funeral Bell Demon Fish race.
Perhaps they never expected someone would come to their lair to plunder their treasures.
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
Han Xing said excitedly, "Good, good, Radiance, quickly take us there."
The God of Radiance nodded, then once more used divine power to envelop Han Xing and the others.
At the same time, the light flashed.
The six of them vanished from the spot directly.
When they opened their eyes again, they were already inside the space bubble.
System prompt appeared.
[You have entered the special area: Treasury of the Funeral Bell Demon Fish Race]
At this moment, Han Xing and the others found the interior of the space bubble was completely different from the outside.
It looked more like an underwater Dragon Palace.
Crystal clear seawater flowed gently, with a lavishly decorated palace nestled within.
Looking at the palace filled with precious metals.
Han Xing gave the command directly, "Search! Take everything!"
The group transformed into five streams of light and began to scour separately.
Han Xing also went directly to a corner of the palace and saw boxes upon boxes of black horns and some purple-red bells.
These items seemed to be the hardest parts of the Funeral Bell Demon Fish race.
And they contained extremely strong waves of divine power.
Han Xing didn’t have time to check their attributes and directly pocketed them all at once.
[Acquired Demon Fish Horn (Red) *172]
[Acquired Demon Fish Bell (Red) *133]
[Acquired Philosopher’s Stone *152351]
[Acquired Demon Fish’s Spike (Red) *121]
[Acquired...]
Meanwhile, after Han Xing plundered all the materials at the palace’s edge, he began heading directly towards the palace interior.
And in the center of the palace.
Han Xing saw a lavish altar with 7 Divine Formats and 1 complete Rule placed on it.
Han Xing’s breath became more rapid; he subdued his inner excitement and rushed over instantly.
Then, directly pocketed all those Divine Formats and the complete Rule.
System prompt appeared.
[Acquired Divine Format: Demon Fish]
[Acquired Divine Format: Maple Leaf]
[Acquired Divine Format...]
[Acquired Power of Rules: Dance]
After eight continuous prompts.
Without time to check their attributes, Han Xing rushed to one side, taking away all other Divine Stones and Divine Gold from the ground!
In the same span of ten seconds, they completely plundered everything inside the huge bubble.
On the way, the bold actions of the five triggered various restrictions, but all were forcibly suppressed by the God of Radiance.
Then, they regrouped again.

When they arrived above the swamp, without needing Han Xing to say anything, the God of Radiance had already begun his investigation.
Ten seconds later, the God of Radiance opened his eyes.
"I have detected it.
Deep within the swamp, there are about two divine-level Funeral Bell Demon Fish."
"And the location where they hide their treasures is about seven hundred thousand meters deep in the swamp, where there seems to be a space bubble."
"There’s no restriction sensed on that space bubble, I can teleport the master there instantly."
Hearing this, Han Xing was delighted.
He then said directly, "Great, let’s move now."
The God of Radiance nodded.
The next moment, a burst of invisible divine power illuminated, and the group vanished from their original spot.
Then, they indeed arrived at the depths of the swamp.
It wasn’t as dirty or foul-smelling as imagined.
Instead, there was an invisible divine power shield separating the mud.
This was the space bubble the God of Radiance had mentioned.
Han Xing took a look, and the durability of the space bubble appeared before his eyes.
[Funeral Bell Demon Fish Race Space Bubble]
[Durability: 120 million]
A durability value of over a hundred million, equivalent to the health of a top demigod.
Plus 100,000 armor.
Without using the Divine Demon Battleship, it would take them some time to break open this space bubble.
If they attacked forcefully, it would alert the Funeral Bell Demon Fish race and other divine-level creatures.
After all, the God of Radiance had just said there were two divine-level Funeral Bell Demon Fish here.
"Radiance, is there a way to take us directly inside?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "I’m deciphering, please wait a moment, master."
The group watched as the God of Radiance’s divine power began to sweep over the space bubble wave after wave.
He closed his eyes to sense carefully.
A moment later, the God of Radiance suddenly opened his eyes and said, "I’ve found the weak spot in the space, I can teleport you to that area directly."
Such a space bubble is akin to a barrier of a small world.
Just not as hard and complete as a small world barrier.
So generally, space bubbles will have one or two weak spots, which are the entrance and exit left by the Funeral Bell Demon Fish race.
Perhaps they never expected someone would come to their lair to plunder their treasures.
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
Han Xing said excitedly, "Good, good, Radiance, quickly take us there."
The God of Radiance nodded, then once more used divine power to envelop Han Xing and the others.
At the same time, the light flashed.
The six of them vanished from the spot directly.
When they opened their eyes again, they were already inside the space bubble.
System prompt appeared.
[You have entered the special area: Treasury of the Funeral Bell Demon Fish Race]
At this moment, Han Xing and the others found the interior of the space bubble was completely different from the outside.
It looked more like an underwater Dragon Palace.
Crystal clear seawater flowed gently, with a lavishly decorated palace nestled within.
Looking at the palace filled with precious metals.
Han Xing gave the command directly, "Search!
Take everything!"
The group transformed into five streams of light and began to scour separately.
Han Xing also went directly to a corner of the palace and saw boxes upon boxes of black horns and some purple-red bells.
These items seemed to be the hardest parts of the Funeral Bell Demon Fish race.
And they contained extremely strong waves of divine power.
Han Xing didn’t have time to check their attributes and directly pocketed them all at once.
[Acquired Demon Fish Horn (Red) *172]
[Acquired Demon Fish Bell (Red) *133]
[Acquired Philosopher’s Stone *152351]
[Acquired Demon Fish’s Spike (Red) *121]
[Acquired...]
Meanwhile, after Han Xing plundered all the materials at the palace’s edge, he began heading directly towards the palace interior.
And in the center of the palace.
Han Xing saw a lavish altar with 7 Divine Formats and 1 complete Rule placed on it.
Han Xing’s breath became more rapid; he subdued his inner excitement and rushed over instantly.
Then, directly pocketed all those Divine Formats and the complete Rule.
System prompt appeared.
[Acquired Divine Format: Demon Fish]
[Acquired Divine Format: Maple Leaf]
[Acquired Divine Format...]
[Acquired Power of Rules: Dance]
After eight continuous prompts.
Without time to check their attributes, Han Xing rushed to one side, taking away all other Divine Stones and Divine Gold from the ground!
In the same span of ten seconds, they completely plundered everything inside the huge bubble.
On the way, the bold actions of the five triggered various restrictions, but all were forcibly suppressed by the God of Radiance.
Then, they regrouped again.

chapters.title: Chapter 981 - 500: Frenzied Looting, Wealth Soars! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Han Xing’s face carried an excited expression,
"Radiance, go!"
As soon as Han Xing’s words fell, the God of Radiance directly released divine power, enveloping them.
With another flash, they reappeared in the sky.
Han Xing quickly opened the map and then checked the nearest areas.
Two seconds later, Han Xing had already made a decision.
"Let’s go, next stop."
"Demon Blood Slime race!"
Buzz!
The six of them transformed into a stream of light and vanished.
They began frantically looting along the map.
At the same time.
Inside the Void.
The Painful Empress and Zigu were already engaged in a frenzied battle.
At this moment, the Painful Empress was wildly laying more spider webs, turning this Void into her battlefield.
However, no matter how many webs she laid, Zigu swung billions of purple branches to fiercely destroy them.
The battlefield of the two top-tier fighters constantly shifted.
The battle had only started, yet within a minute, their battlefield had moved several million kilometers.
Void storms raged on.
The webs laid down appeared with many holes.
They were also stained with some of the Painful Empress’s blood and broken branches from Zigu’s body.
Thus, it was evident how fierce the battle between these two top-tier divine spirits was.
After all, the Painful Empress said it was a life-and-death battle, and she wasn’t joking.
Since Zigu agreed, it meant he was determined to kill the opponent.
So, neither showed any mercy.
At this moment, the Painful Empress once again extended her spike-like fingers, then tightened the string in her hand, binding Zigu’s massive body tightly.
And Zigu’s expression was one of pain due to the constant constriction.
Zigu gritted his teeth and said, "Madeleine, you’re courting death!"
At the next moment, a great sword burning with demon fire appeared in his hand out of nowhere.
"Swish!"
Zigu swung his sword.
The terrifying demon fire sword qi instantly swept over ten thousand miles.
Not only did it sear through those divine power webs, it also slashed heavily against the Painful Empress.
The Painful Empress’s stomach took a sword strike and her body bent over immediately.
Moreover, the places on her body injured by the sword qi still had residual purple demon fire, continually eroding the Painful Empress’s flesh body.
Seeing this scene, Zigu’s lips curled into a smug smile, "Madeleine, I’ve told you, you’re not good at direct combat,"
"Yet you chose a life-and-death battle with me."
"You asked for this!"
"After I kill you, I’ll devour your power of rules, and perhaps have a chance to leap to the True God level, hahaha!"
Zigu laughed out loud, his voice echoing throughout the Void.
From afar, many divine spirit experts watching the scene had a slight shift in their gazes,
They all knew Zigu was speaking the truth.
After all, both the Painful Empress and Zigu were top-tier divine spirits, only one step away from True God existence.
No matter who wins this battle, the surviving party, if able to absorb the other’s rules, has a great chance to take that final step.
Then, with only a few years’ time to settle, they could break through to the True God Realm!
Thinking of this, the nearby experts suddenly held their breath!
Because they were going to witness the process of a True God’s birth firsthand.
Everyone widened their eyes, fearing to miss any detail of the battle between the two top-tier fighters.
However, a portion of the experts held different thoughts.
Their eyes lingered on the Painful Empress and Zigu.
Since this battle was destined to have a victor,
They wanted to try and see if there was an opportunity to snatch the power of rules!
Not just one or two divine spirits had this idea.
Divine spirits from different worlds present all harbored ulterior motives.
They foresaw that even after the Painful Empress and Zigu’s battle concluded, the turmoil would not cease.
To fight for that top-tier divine spirit’s rules, more experts might intervene!
Thinking of this, those divine spirits discreetly sent messages, requesting more divine spirits to be dispatched from their clans.
In this way, when it came time to vie for the power of rules, their odds would be greater.
Suddenly, more divine spirits rushed from silence towards the battlefield of the two top-tier divine spirits.
Yet, unbeknownst to them, this played right into Han Xing’s plans.
The fewer divine spirits in Silent City, the lower the likelihood of Han Xing and his team being discovered.
At the same time.
Han Xing continued to lead his team on a rapid journey.
In just five minutes, they had already looted the treasuries of eight races!
The other materials are not accounted for in detail.
But just the quantity of Philosopher’s Stones had already surpassed three billion!
There were 45 pieces of Divine Format.
And there were 9 complete powers of rules!
Looking at his backpack full to the brim with materials.
Han Xing’s heart bloomed with intense joy.
"Good, good, this wave is truly a huge gain!"
"After this, I will surely be able to gather the Divine Format to break through to Demigod!"
"Then the excess materials can raise more Calamity Defense Towers, and even build several Lingxiao Mechas."
To know, the Lingxiao Mecha possesses divine level combat power.
Moreover, it can receive the Sun Crown Stele and Han Xing’s [Infinite Domain] boost.
Far stronger than ordinary divine spirits.
Thinking of this, Han Xing’s heart was already filled with anticipation.
"Let’s go, onward!"
Six of them turned into flowing light, speeding along,
excluding the travel time and looting the treasury.
They roughly spent every two minutes clearing out one race’s treasury.
However, at the tenth race’s domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 982 - 500: Frenzied Plundering, Wealth Soars! (Part 3)
paragraphs: In a deep sea as silent as death, everyone came to a halt.
Han Xing said, "The map shows that this is the territory of the Deep Sea Worm Race."
"Radiance, investigate a bit."
The God of Radiance nodded.
After probing with divine power for a moment, his expression suddenly changed.
The next moment, he almost without hesitation led Han Xing and the others rushing forward.
Although the group didn’t know what had happened.
But from the reaction of the God of Radiance, they could tell he must have encountered something rather terrifying.
Not until they completely distanced themselves from that pitch-black sea area, did the God of Radiance finally begin to relax.
Han Xing asked, "Deep Sea Worm Race, is there a problem?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes, master, there, I vaguely sensed an aura of a True God."
Hearing the words "True God," everyone on the scene felt a chill run down their spine.
Han Xing almost instinctively wanted to flee with the group.
At this moment, the God of Radiance said, "Master, there’s no need to worry, that True God seems to be in a dormant state, its aura appears very weak."
"Although it sensed my aura, it didn’t seem to want to come out to investigate."
Han Xing breathed a sigh of relief, "That’s good."
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but begin to ponder a certain issue.
The waters of Silent City are too deep.
There could be many True Gods, top-tier Divine Spirits lurking here.
And under the perception of such level powerhouses,
The God of Radiance could not evade their divine power detection, nor could he loot these races’ treasure troves.
Of course, not being able to loot these treasure troves is still secondary.
The main concern is encountering some hot-tempered guy.
After sensing the God of Radiance’s divine power investigation, might see it as a provocation and come out to fight them directly.
By then, their plans would be exposed.
At this point, Han Xing asked, "Radiance, is there any way to avoid these races with top-tier Divine Spirits or True Gods?"
The God of Radiance pondered for a moment, seemingly searching his mind for a corresponding method.
After a moment, he slowly said, "It seems there is. Like us top-tier Divine Spirits, even True Gods, will feel a faint awe of each other’s Power of Rules when approaching."
"I can rely on this feeling to roughly estimate the opponent’s strength."
"However, this method isn’t very accurate; those True Gods might have already left, but I might still sense them.
"So, in this way, we might miss some races."
Han Xing nodded directly and said, "It doesn’t matter, just miss them, safety first."
"With so many races in Silent City, it’s uncertain if we can loot them all this time."
The God of Radiance nodded.
From then on, they maintained vigilance and quick actions.
Within five minutes, Han Xing looted the treasure troves of six more races!
It could be said to be incredibly swift.
So far,
The number of divine formats in Han Xing’s hand had reached 80.
As for the complete Power of Rules, along with the eight he previously collected, it had reached 24!
Completely surpassing the requirements to break through to becoming a demigod!
And until now.
The battle between the Painful Empress and Zigu had lasted for about seven minutes.
The current battle status is that the Painful Empress is still barely holding on.
Bear in mind, her previous battle with the God of Radiance lasted less than five minutes before a victor was decided.
And though Zigu is weaker than the God of Radiance, this guy is also an extremely skilled combat divine spirit.
Therefore, the Painful Empress is indeed not a match for Zigu.
In the void, more and more spectating divine spirits gathered.
Seeing the Painful Empress fall into a disadvantage.
At this moment, the people watching on the side, with solemn expressions, watched the two divine spirits in battle.
Their battle’s momentum was really too terrifying, the void energy within millions of miles around had been evaporated by them.
If they were now fighting in a small world,
That small world would have already exploded due to their divine power fluctuations.
A divine spirit shook his head and said, "It seems there’s already a winner, Madeleine won’t last long before Zigu slays her."
Other divine spirits also nodded in agreement, "Indeed, but that the Painful Empress can persist until now is already quite remarkable."
"After all, this Zigu guy originally hails from a dreadful world, has been in slaughter and combat his whole life, and is truly a divine spirit that rose from massacre."
"If the Painful Empress falls, with her ’pain’ rule, Zigu has at least an 80% chance of breaking through to True God."
After hearing this divine spirit’s analysis,
Some divine spirits expressed their agreement.
And at this time, a male who looked human but with three eyes spoke, "What a pity, the Painful Empress is still so charming, such a beautiful creature is about to perish, truly a waste."
The divine spirits beside him looked at this guy in horror and exclaimed, "Brother... the Painful Empress is from the Blood Spider Race!"
This young man with three eyes nodded, "I know, so what if she’s from the Blood Spider Race?"
"As long as she’s pretty, has a good figure, who cares about that."
Then he said with interest, "Besides, don’t you think an encounter with the Blood Spider Race has its unique flavor?"
His words didn’t get approval from other divine spirits.
A Tumor Monster Rat Race divine spirit mocked, "I think your brain is fried, still wanting an encounter with the Painful Empress."
"You should know, the Blood Spider Race treats their partner as food after mating."
"How a guy like you, driven solely by desire, became a divine spirit, baffles me."
While this Tumor Monster Rat Race divine spirit intended to speak further, a high-tier divine spirit quickly pressed him down with a slap, "Shuyi, shut up!"
With a terrified face, it rebuked, "Apologize to this presence immediately!"

chapters.title: Chapter 983 - 501: The True God’s Attention
paragraphs: "Apologize to this existence right now, at once!"
The Tumor Monster Rat that had been suddenly slapped was still completely dumbfounded.
You had to know, it was also a High-tier Divine Spirit—yet the other party actually dared slap it in the face in public; that was downright trampling its dignity!
And just then, a transmitted voice sounded by its ear.
"This is a True God."
Hearing that transmitted voice, that Tumor Monster Rat Divine Spirit instantly felt his scalp go numb!
He immediately, right in front of all the Divine Spirits, dropped to his knees in the Void.
Then, with a face full of terror, he shouted, "My lord, it was this little one who failed to recognize Mount Tai, and offended you. Please, my lord, forgive my sins!"
The other Divine Spirits on the field all looked at this scene in puzzlement.
Their gazes shifted from the Painful Empress and Zigu to land on this Three-Eyed Human.
However, that Divine Spirit of the Tumor Monster Rat race, seeing that this Three-Eyed Human did not respond, felt his terror intensify.
He started banging his head on the ground—thud, thud, thud—knocking out loud kowtows, while crying for mercy at the same time.
Seeing this, the many Divine Spirits who had still been a bit confused now understood.
This seemingly ordinary Three-Eyed Human Race member had to be a terrifying existence of the highest order!
To make a High-tier Divine Spirit kneel on the spot—something even a Top-tier Divine Spirit couldn’t force.
The answer was already screaming to be revealed.
This Three-Eyed Human Race member was a True God.
After reaching this conclusion, all the powerhouses on the field immediately retreated a huge step back.
None dared approach the place where that Three-Eyed Human Race member was.
Yet that mysterious Three-Eyed Human merely chuckled softly and shook his head.
In the next instant, his figure suddenly vanished from where he had stood, as if he had never appeared at all.
At the same time, that Divine Spirit of the Tumor Monster Rat race showed a look of having survived a great catastrophe.
He cast a grateful glance at the High-tier Divine Spirit beside him who had slapped him earlier.
In that moment, about the fact that the Silent City was full of crouching tigers and hidden dragons, the Tumor Monster Rat felt an even deeper impression in his heart.
At this moment, in the battlefield of the two Top-tier Divine Spirits.
The Painful Empress’s body was covered in Sword wounds.
Terror-inducing purple Flame was burning her body, and was suppressing her Divine Power.
It was stopping her from drawing on the Power of Rules to restore her body.
Right now, a twisted expression surfaced on the Painful Empress’s face.
She savored the pain coursing through her entire body, and that feeling of her flesh and blood being burned together.
Her features were both anguished and ecstatic.
In that instant, Madeleine stretched out her spike-like hand, cupping her own face, releasing a suppressed yet exhilarated moan.
"Ah~ such a fierce burning sensation~"
"So painful... it hurts so much..."
"Too wonderful, just too wonderful..."
Watching the Painful Empress’s mad reaction.
Zigu let out a cold snort. "Madeleine, I already told you, you could never be my match. All of this—you brought it on yourself!"
The Painful Empress didn’t reply. Instead, she extended a finger, put it in her mouth and sucked on it, her eyes showing a drunken, intoxicated look.
"What a marvelous feeling~ this lady is about to fall in love with it~"
In the next instant, the two sides clashed again.
Hum!
A sky-full of Divine Power Spider Webs appeared.
Different from before, this time, crawling across the Webs were blood-Red little spiders.
These little spiders didn’t radiate any particularly strong aura, yet they charged at Zigu at a terrifying speed, swarming him madly.
Zigu sneered. "Madeleine, are you out of other methods?"
"You even let these little spiders out—do you really think they’ll have any Effect on me?"
The Painful Empress still didn’t answer, only watched Zigu with an obsessed smile.
In the next moment, those Blood Spiders began frenzied Self-Destructing.
"Puff! Puff puff puff!"
The whole stretch of Void resounded with dense explosions.
Clouds of blood mist burst open one after another.
Zigu seemed to realize there was something wrong with these Blood Spiders.
He hurriedly whipped his branches, launching wild Attacks on the Blood Spiders to stop them from getting close.
Yet the instant his branches came into contact with those clouds of blood mist, it was as if they had touched some kind of sulfuric acid—corrosive sizzling sounds rang out at once.
An extreme agony invaded his nerves in an instant.
And this wasn’t some simple pain, but a torment that directly acted on the deepest reaches of the Spirit.
Hundreds of times, even thousands of times more painful than ordinary burning!
"Tsss!!"
Zigu sucked in a sharp breath of cold air.
He looked around at the Blood Spiders with a face full of horror. "Madeleine, what kind of method is this?"
The Painful Empress giggled. "But of course, these are my most beloved children."
"They’re pain crystals that I managed to collect with great difficulty, able to bring me the most extreme enjoyment~"
"Using them on you, I almost feel reluctant~"
Now, Zigu had truly felt the terror and weirdness of these Blood Spiders.
He didn’t dare touch those Blood Spiders anymore, not even the tiniest bit.
Yet the Blood Spiders were like Self-Destruct robots, crazily closing in on Zigu.
"Puff! Puff puff puff!"
The dense explosions kept ringing by Zigu’s ears.
And Zigu’s screams of misery kept echoing out as well.
"Damn you! Get away from me!"
"Aaaah!!!"
Listening to those hair-raising howls of agony, the powerhouses watching from around felt goosebumps all over.
Their attention shifted away from that True God of Three Eyes, returning to the battlefield between the two Top-tier Divine Spirits.
Seeing the Painful Empress wrestle back a round.
The other Divine Spirits all sighed emotionally. "As expected, you really can’t underestimate any Top-tier Divine Spirit!"
"For them to have cultivated to such a mighty realm, they definitely have some powerful trump cards up their sleeves."
The Divine Spirits beside them all echoed, "Yeah, after this move from the Painful Empress, the outcome is anyone’s guess now."

sentences.text: "Apologize to this existence right now, at once!"

This seemingly ordinary Three-Eyed Human Race member had to be a terrifying existence of the highest order!

The answer was already screaming to be revealed.
This Three-Eyed Human Race member was a True God.
