chapters.title: Chapter 984 - 501: The True God’s Attention (2)
paragraphs: The battle between two top-tier divine spirits ignited once again.
Meanwhile.
Han Xing and his companions had already begun to raid the vault of the seventeenth race.
Here lies a forest filled with plants.
The plants here grow in strange ways.
They resemble purple stumps, dotted with demon eyes.
And this place was his initial target.
The territory of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race.
At that moment, that Zigu guy was battling with the Painful Empress, and the other divine spirits had received the news, appearing in the void.
They feared any mishap might occur to their clan leader during the battle with the Painful Empress, almost deploying in full.
And their old base was virtually unmanned.
The God of Radiance sensed around and said with joy, "Master, I’ve scanned it, not a single divine spirit is here."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing and the others’ faces lit up with joy.
For this meant they could freely gather the treasures of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race.
Han Xing nodded, "Radiance, lead us there."
The God of Radiance nodded.
In the next moment, he waved his big hand and led everyone deep into the forest filled with purple fog.
These stumps are all living Evil Ghost Tree Demons.
But with the God of Radiance’s divine power shielding them, they walked past these Evil Ghost Tree Demons without arousing any notice.
In just a second, they ventured tens of thousands of kilometers into the territory of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race.
They stopped in front of a decaying ancient tree.
The God of Radiance spoke, "Master, the entrance to the vault is behind that ancient tree."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing hesitated and asked, "Um, do we need to enter the body of this ancient tree?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes."
Cheng Jianyong worriedly said, "This... won’t be discovered, right?"
The God of Radiance chuckled, "No, just put the ancient tree into a sleep state."
Upon these words, the God of Radiance tapped with his hand, and a burst of radiant divine power erupted.
Then, the demigod-level Evil Ghost Tree Demon directly shut its eyes.
With curious gazes upon them.
Suddenly a wooden door opened behind the stump.
The wooden door wasn’t large, just enough for one person to pass through.
Then, everyone stepped inside one after another.
The scene changed abruptly.
They found themselves in an underground labyrinth.
This place was filled with the roots of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race.
The dense branches filled the entire underground area.
In the deeper underground, there was a vast space.
In this underground space.
Han Xing and the others saw, compared to previous races, multiples of various metals and divine stones!
Nearby, large quantities of Black Gold Stones, Black Abyss Stones, and even the Fantasy Level material they previously discovered, Black Emperor Stones, were scattered.
Moreover, Han Xing saw many powerful divine energy-emitting amethysts here.
This amethyst seemed similar to the Life Tree Heart of the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
But the aura on it was more formidable than the Life Tree Heart!
With a casual glance.
Han Xing was momentarily breathless.
Evil Ghost Tree Heart: High-tier Demigod
Item Effect: Consuming it can increase your Attack Power by 10,000 points and divine power by 500 points.
Note: The same tier Evil Ghost Tree Heart can only be consumed three times.
Evil Ghost Tree Heart: Low-tier Divine Spirit
Item Effect: Consuming it can increase your Attack Power by 50,000 points and divine power value by 2,000 points.
Evil Ghost Tree Heart: Top-tier Divine Spirit
Item Effect: Consuming it can increase your Attack Power by 200,000 points and divine power value by 5,000 points.
Note: The same tier Evil Ghost Tree Heart can only be consumed three times.
These tree hearts have an effect even stronger than divine formats.
Han Xing glanced roughly.
There was only one top-tier Divine Spirit level Evil Ghost Tree Heart.
Adding up all the various levels of Evil Ghost Tree Hearts, there were over a hundred.
Despite the usage limit.
It’s imaginable that just these Evil Ghost Tree Hearts could elevate Han Xing’s divine power value to an extremely terrifying level!
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Wow... truly worthy of a race with top-tier divine spirits!"
"This foundation almost surpasses the vaults of the five races we’ve raided before!"
The team members nodded excitedly.
Han Xing restrained the joy in his heart and swiftly commanded, "Make it quick, collect all these materials!"
Upon hearing this, everyone instantly transformed into five streaks of flowing light, spreading out to collect in this underground labyrinth.
With divine power sweeping over, large areas of materials were gathered.
While Han Xing focused on collecting those Evil Ghost Tree Hearts.
And Black Gold Stones, Black Abyss Stones, and Black Emperor Stones.
With divine power sweeping over, he collected all these materials.
Continuous system prompts appeared.
Acquired Philosopher’s Stone*1.74 million.
Acquired Shadow Divine Stone*720,000.
Acquired Evil Ghost Tree Heart: High-tier Demigod*63.
Acquired Evil Ghost Tree Heart: Low-tier Divine Spirit*27.
Acquired Evil Ghost Tree Heart: Middle-tier Divine Spirit*6.
Acquired Black Gold Stone (Red)*150,000.
Acquired Black Abyss Stone (Red)*170,000.
Acquired Black Emperor Stone (Colored)*50,000.
Acquired...
This time, it took them 30 seconds to completely clear the vault of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race.
After 30 seconds, the five regrouped.
Han Xing asked, "How did the search go, are there any places missed?"
Cheng Jianyong replied, "No worries, Brother Xing, we didn’t even leave a single permanent gold brick behind, it’s all thoroughly cleaned!"
Everyone chuckled.
Shen Yun nodded as well, "It’s almost perfectly cleaned, I found 12 complete divine formats and three whole rules inside."

chapters.title: Chapter 985 - 501: True God’s Attention_3
paragraphs: After speaking, Shen Yun handed over all these complete rules and divine formats to Han Xing.
Han Xing looked at the bag full of 167 divine formats of varying sizes, plus 43 complete powers of rules.
A strong sense of joy erupted within.
These were the legacy of 27 races, accumulated over at least a thousand years.
And now, all have been collected by Han Xing.
If others knew Han Xing had so many divine formats and powers of rules,
even true gods would be tempted to take action against them!
The next moment, the God of Radiance waved a large hand.
They once again disappeared from their original place, appearing above this purple forest.
Everyone hurriedly headed straight to the next area.
Time slowly passed.
Five minutes later.
They once again plundered the treasuries of 15 races!
Thus, at least a third of the races in Silent City have been visited by Han Xing and his companions.
And Han Xing now possesses 274 divine formats, plus 67 complete powers of rules!
If these divine formats and powers of rules were all absorbed.
Han Xing’s divine power value could directly break through 1 million!
Added to which, the various precious divine stones are nearly filling everyone’s backpacks.
In the meantime, they returned to the Divine Demon Battleship to transfer supplies once.
From this, one can imagine how much wealth Han Xing has looted.
Just when Han Xing thought they could continue plundering.
The God of Radiance’s expression suddenly changed.
Their traveling stopped abruptly, directly entering battle state!
Han Xing and others don’t know what happened.
Only saw a humanoid creature with a white robe and three eyes appearing ahead.
Han Xing had no impression of this humanoid creature.
He has never seen it before.
And for making the God of Radiance react like this.
The opponent’s strength must be at least a top-tier divine spirit.
In this instant, everyone entered battle state.
Yet at this time, the God of Radiance coldly said, "Master, you should leave quickly."
"This guy is a true god!"
Upon hearing this, everyone was shocked.
Han Xing even prepared to use [Hunter’s Burning Blood Arrow], the only chance to use it!
True God!
This three-eyed man is actually a true god.
They finally encountered a true god-level existence.
However, on this three-eyed man, everyone felt no divine power fluctuations.
The opponent seemed just like an ordinary person.
Yet, not feeling any fluctuations is what’s most terrifying.
When Han Xing looked over.
The system displayed a bunch of ’???’.
This means the opponent’s strength far exceeded Han Xing and others’ imagination, not even able to investigate his name.
Han Xing took a deep breath and asked gravely, "Radiance, how long can you hold?"
The God of Radiance shook his head with a serious expression, "Not clear."
"But regardless, I will fight for the master to escape."
Han Xing shook his head, "Don’t talk about escaping yet, Radiance, can you hold until I bring the Divine Demon Battleship over?"
The Divine Demon Battleship is now staying in the ’City of Wails’.
And they are roughly five million kilometers from City of Wails.
Using the transmission function of five [Oracle Thrones], they can reach quickly.
Then coming over would take just a few seconds.
By then, relying on the Divine Demon Battleship, along with the God of Radiance, it should be barely possible to handle a true god.
However, even those few seconds can decide the outcome of a battle.
After all, the gap between a divine spirit and a true god is too big.
The God of Radiance may not hold long against this true god.
If not, Han Xing can only use [Hunter’s Burning Blood Arrow].
The God of Radiance pondered, "If going all out, a few seconds should be possible."
Han Xing nodded, "Good, try to delay as much time as possible."
"When we arrive, directly use the firepower on the Divine Demon Battleship to bombard him!"
They communicated through divine sense, already finished in a very short time.
Han Xing has made the battle plan.
Just as Radiance was preparing to gather divine power for a deadly fight against this true god.
The opposite suddenly spoke softly, "I am not here to fight you."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s group was stunned.
At this moment, the three-eyed true god said, "If I wanted to deal with you, I wouldn’t appear before you, but from a very long distance, could directly strike."
Han Xing looked at the opponent in confusion, seemingly not believing.
However, the three-eyed true god seemed to know Han Xing’s thoughts, smiled and said, "Do you think if I truly wanted to strike you, I’d be standing here chatting with you?"
After hearing, Han Xing somewhat started to believe, asked, "Then why are you blocking us?"
The opposite continued shaking his head, "Of course, to stop you from jumping deeper into the fire pit."
"You little guys are truly bold, also quite crazy."
"Dare to loot the treasuries of those races in Silent City, do you truly have no idea how deep the waters here are?"
Han Xing replied, "I know, aren’t we avoiding those powerful races?"
"We haven’t provoked those top-tier divine spirits and true gods."
Yet the opponent shook his head, "You are wrong, you have vastly underestimated the power at true god level."
"When you looted the second race, you already caught some attention."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing and his group glanced at each other, seeing disbelief in the opponent’s eyes.
"Is what you said true?" Han Xing inquired.
The three-eyed man nodded, "Yes, otherwise, how do you think I found you?"

Han Xing replied, "I know, aren’t we avoiding those powerful races?"
"We haven’t provoked those top-tier divine spirits and true gods."
Yet the opponent shook his head, "You are wrong, you have vastly underestimated the power at true god level."
"When you looted the second race, you already caught some attention."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing and his group glanced at each other, seeing disbelief in the opponent’s eyes.
"Is what you said true?" Han Xing inquired.
The three-eyed man nodded, "Yes, otherwise, how do you think I found you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 986 - 502: Battle of True Gods
paragraphs: The three-eyed man chuckled lightly, "Otherwise, how do you think I found you?"
Han Xing was taken aback, and then a trace of frustration appeared in his eyes.
They had thought their plan was flawless.
Now it seemed that those True Gods already knew what they were doing.
It made sense, after all, their actions were right under the noses of those True Gods, it would be a wonder not to be discovered.
Han Xing asked puzzled, "Then why didn’t they stop us?"
The three-eyed True God replied calmly, "Why else, of course they want to turn black against black."
"These guys have long wanted to do exactly what you’re doing."
"But due to the restraints of other True Gods, they didn’t dare to act."
"And now, Silent City has suddenly brought a few young daredevils."
"They want to wait for you to fatten up, then slaughter directly."
Upon hearing the explanation, Han Xing, Cheng Jianyong, and others felt a chill down their spines.
"Damn! Are these True Gods so insidious?"
The three-eyed True God smiled lightly and nodded.
Han Xing puzzled further, "Then why don’t you wait like those True Gods to turn black against black, and instead come over and tell us this?"
The three-eyed True God shook his head again, "If I say I’m here to help you, would you believe me?"
Han Xing was stunned, seemingly not understanding what he meant.
The three-eyed True God continued, "Under the surveillance of those few guys, you absolutely won’t survive leaving Silent City."
"So, I’m here to help you."
At this moment, not only Han Xing but also his teammates were bewildered.
They didn’t know why the three-eyed True God was saying these things, nor why he wanted to help them.
Just then, the three-eyed True God’s face changed, solemnly announcing.
"They’re here!"
Upon hearing this, the crowd didn’t realize the situation.
The next moment, they suddenly felt three extremely terrifying auras rising in different corners of Silent City!
Any one of these auras was a hundredfold surpassing the God of Radiance.
Under the pressure of such level auras.
Han Xing and others even experienced a feeling as if their lives did not belong to them!
At the same time.
From the body of this three-eyed man, an equally formidable aura erupted.
Competing with these three True God level auras!
Buzz!
The four True God’s auras collided, directly creating terrifying energy storms in the void.
Sweeping out billions of kilometers!
Even the distant battle between Painful Empress and Zigu was involuntarily halted.
They put in all their power, striving to resist these four dreadful auras.
And those divine spirits watching the battle were caught off guard, as if struck by lightning.
The group of divine spirits exclaimed in terror, "Oh my God! What happened?"
"True Gods! It’s the aura of True Gods!"
"And not just one True God!"
They all turned their gaze over there.
Everyone’s attention was attracted by those four terrifying auras.
No, can’t say attracted, but suppressed!
In the entire void, those divine spirits, high-tier divine spirits, under the suppression of these auras, couldn’t even move!
Let alone the weaker demigods and legends.
At this moment, a voice, aged and seemingly from ancient times, echoed.
"Celestial Fall, do you want to stop us?"
The three-eyed man chuckled lightly, "You old things living for who knows how many years, is it right to plot against the younger generation?"
The opposite side replied again, "We just don’t want Silent City’s things to be taken by a few outsiders."
"Celestial Fall, speed up, make way!"
At this moment, the True Gods and demigods listening seemed to realize something had happened within Silent City.
Which even led these True Gods to act!
The three-eyed man turned and looked at Han Xing and his team, saying, "Hurry up, leave here far away."
"Wait until you have True God’s power and then come back to reclaim that guy’s body.
Upon hearing the last sentence, Han Xing’s pupils shrank suddenly.
He looked at the three-eyed man in shock, "You know Hunter?"
The three-eyed man nodded.
Han Xing was even more shocked, questioning in confusion, "Who are you?"
The three-eyed man chuckled lightly, "You’ll naturally know my identity when you’re strong enough."
"Now, you’d better leave quickly."
At the same time, because the three-eyed man didn’t reply, the auras of the other three True Gods began to fully erupt.
Buzz!
Terrifying auras surged, like three burning suns!
The next moment, the three-eyed man also charged into the sky.
Then collided with those three star-like shining auras.
The entire Silent City began to tremble violently.
The True Gods have commenced battle!
All demigods, divine spirits couldn’t help but kneel down.
They exclaimed in horror, "What exactly happened, why did a battle of True Gods appear?"
"It’s not the True God of Yellow Sand, but another four True Gods!"
"How can Silent City have so many True Gods lurking?"
These suddenly appearing True Gods, let alone Han Xing and his group, even the strong ones who have been in Silent City for so many years didn’t know.
Han Xing gazed in the direction the three-eyed man left, and at the four terrifying auras in the void.
Then, he directly said, "Radiance, take us back to the Divine Demon Battleship, quickly!"
The God of Radiance nodded, the next moment, divine power wrapped around everyone.
They transformed into a stream of light, heading straight for the ’City of Wails’.
At the same time, the sky’s battle of the four True Gods had begun.
With a casual strike, they caused energy storms within millions of kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 987 - 502: True God Battle (Part 2)
paragraphs: A breath could stir a terrifying hurricane.
At this moment, the three-eyed man was battling a completely black Deep Sea Worm and a skinless Orc.
There was also a Knight cloaked in shadows, riding an Undead Warhorse!
In their hands, Silent City seemed as if it could be destroyed with a wave.
In fact, those three True Gods were doing just that.
They directly struck, instantly crossing millions of kilometers, aiming to capture Han Xing and the others.
At this moment, even the God of Radiance felt an overwhelming sense of helplessness.
In the void, the three-eyed man chuckled lightly, "Reaching your hand out so far, isn’t very good, you know~"
The next moment, a beam suddenly shot out from the eye on his forehead.
This beam caused time and space to begin warping, seemingly triggering an eerie scene of temporal distortion.
In an instant, the three True Gods, as if struck by lightning, retracted their extended hands.
While Han Xing and the others felt like they had just walked through the gates of hell.
Cheng Jianyong said with a trembling heart, "Damn! These True Gods are outrageous!"
"From such a distance, they could have casually crushed us if not for the intervention of the True God of Three Eyes. We would have truly been in danger today!"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Get to the spaceship, we must leave quickly!"
"Samoyed! Get in, now."
With that, everyone almost without hesitation, scrambled into the spaceship.
Even the bewildered Samoyed beside them also immediately slipped into the spaceship.
Then, Han Xing said, "Radiance, use coercive methods to take away all the living beings of the Blood Spider Race."
The God of Radiance nodded.
He no longer concealed his aura, and the terrifying Divine Power burst forth instantly!
A force surpassing the Painful Empress and Zigu rose up.
Ten-thousand-foot radiance completely illuminated the entire ’City of Wails’.
The observing Divine Spirits couldn’t help but cast their eyes over.
"My God! Another aura of a top-tier Divine Spirit!"
"And it seems to have emerged from within the City of Wails!"
This move by the God of Radiance seemed to trigger an emergency response from the hidden strong beings of other races.
Throughout Silent City, all the hidden top-tier Divine Spirits erupted with their auras,
"Rumble!"
Waves of terrifying aura appeared.
In an area of ancient architecture within Silent City, a giant sword standing millions of meters tall stood erect.
In the endless sea area, a tentacle millions of meters long extended out, flailing wildly in the void.
Beside it, a tremendously large Cannibal Flower also unfolded its petals.
The Divine Spirits observing in the sky only felt wave after wave of suffocation.
Today’s events were beyond anything they could have imagined.
They had no idea what was happening.
How did a battle of True Gods suddenly occur?
And now so many top-tier Divine Spirits erupted with terrifying force.
The entire Silent City was in utter chaos.
Even the battle between Zigu and the Painful Empress came to a halt.
Compared to their battle, the upheaval in Silent City was even more captivating.
At this moment, the Divine Demon Battleship rapidly ascended.
The Blood Spider Race in the City of Wails was also forced into the Divine Demon Battleship by the God of Radiance.
These Blood Spiders were in a state of bewilderment.
They seemed to realize that they were being captured.
In the next moment, these Blood Spiders attempted to retaliate immediately.
Han Xing said, "Don’t make a move, I’m taking your Empress with me."
Upon hearing the word "Empress," all the Blood Spiders fell silent.
Han Xing had no time to explain.
The Divine Demon Battleship started, rushing towards the battlefield of the Painful Empress and Zigu.
At this moment, Zigu, seeing a strange battleship approaching, had a look of confusion in its eyes.
"Madeleine, is this reinforcement you called for?"
"You still had a top-tier Divine Spirit hidden in the City of Wails, truly well hidden!
Zigu naturally noticed the aura erupted from the God of Radiance.
Seeing the Divine Demon Battleship approaching, Zigu assumed they were ready to ally with the Painful Empress against it.
Zigu licked its lips and raised the Longsword in its hand high, "Come on, I too want to see where my ultimate strength lies."
"Evil, be slashed!"
With that, a terrifying Sword Qi slashed towards the Divine Demon Battleship.
However, at this moment, Han Xing only wanted a quick victory.
Seeing that Zigu dared to take the initiative to attack, Han Xing was also stirred with murderous intent.
The next moment, all the Energy Cannons on the Divine Demon Battleship, except for the Celestial Rail Strike Device, activated.
"Buzz!"
And this concentrated fire attack was augmented by Han Xing’s [Infinite Domain] effect, more terrifying than any before!
An arc more than ten thousand meters in diameter.
Tens of thousands of meters of energy beams, accompanied by countless Dark Energy Shells and Frozen Star Cannons!
All of it was blasting towards Zigu at this moment.
As for its previously unleashed Sword Qi, it had long been obliterated by the energy beam of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon.
Seeing those terrifying shells bombarding towards itself, Zigu could only feel an imminent sense of death.
Its scalp tingled, and it questioned in fear, "Damn it! What is this thing?"
However, there was no one to answer it.
Because by this time, the terrifying energy wave had already erupted.
Boom!
An ocean of plasma appeared out of nowhere,
The surrounding void energy within a million miles was directly evaporated.
Adding to that, the firepower of those Frozen Star Cannons and Dark Energy Cannons.
At this moment, an energy vortex seemed to be reappearing.
This momentum was nearly reaching True God Level!
Causing the four True Gods fighting in the distance to turn their gazes over.

chapters.title: Chapter 988 - 502: True God War (Part 3)
paragraphs: They also realized that it was an attack released by the few humans who had just escaped.
The three-eyed man said with interest, "Interesting, this kid still has such powerful strength hidden."
"Is this his trump card? No wonder he’s so daring, daring to sneak into the Silent City as a thief."
Boom!
The place where Zigu originally was is now filled with various energies.
Han Xing looked overhead at that thick energy vein, covered with dense cracks.
At a critical moment, Zigu fled into the Power of Rules.
If he had been a little slower in action, Han Xing would have killed him on the spot.
And now, with another attack, Han Xing could directly take out Zigu.
However, from afar, the skinned Beastman True God extended his blood-red right hand, reaching for Han Xing and the others.
"Dream on if you want to escape!"
Across millions of kilometers.
The blood-red right hand seemed to cross space, appearing right above Han Xing’s head.
An invisible Power of Imprisonment emerged.
Everyone heard a system prompt beside their ears.
[You are affected by the rule of the True God of Blood Demon, all divine power sealed, unable to move, teleport, etc...]
[Passive skill All Things in the Forest has taken effect, this rule sealing is invalid.]
Han Xing broke free from that terrifying state of imprisonment, but it was to no avail.
After all, attacks from True God level are simply too fast and too terrifying.
That large hand was already reaching for them.
Han Xing pulled back the bowstring and already had the Hunter’s Burning Blood Arrow set in place.
He had to take out the opponent before this True God could kill them!
At this moment, the True God of Three Eyes suddenly also held a longbow in his hand.
He instantly pulled the bowstring.
An arrow, carrying a brilliant stream of light, directly nailed the Beastman True God’s right hand into the Void.
"Roar!"
A painful roar echoed.
"Damn Celestial Fall! I will kill you!"
In this situation, Han Xing could clearly drive the Divine Demon Battleship and directly bombard this right hand!
However, the Painful Empress was still outside, they needed to hurry and escape.
Han Xing took a deep breath, abandoning the idea.
So, he shouted to the Painful Empress, "Madeleine! Get on!"
The Painful Empress also broke free from that terrifying state of imprisonment.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s call, she hesitated not at all, her figure flashing directly into the cabin.
Then, Han Xing directly engaged the teleportation state.
[Entering teleportation state, countdown five seconds...]
Five seconds is enough time for those True Gods to kill Han Xing and the others a thousand times!
Just now, hoping that the three-eyed man could hold on!
The Divine Demon Battleship advanced frantically, waiting for teleportation to be ready.
Meanwhile.
Seeing the Divine Demon Battleship about to escape, the attacks of the three True Gods grew increasingly frantic.
"Celestial Fall! These humans took too much, they cannot leave!"
"Celestial Fall, once Yellow Sand returns, are you not afraid we will deal with you together?"
"Damn it! Catch that ship!"
They kept deploying various means to capture Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship.
Yet the three-eyed man’s efforts unraveled them repeatedly.
The battle disturbances of the four True Gods behind kept echoing.
Their Divine Demon Battleship, like a small ship in a storm, shook violently.
Everyone’s heart hung in suspense.
At this moment, Zigu also reappeared from the rules.
He looked at the soon-to-depart battleship with horror, experiencing a sense of post-disaster survival.
At the same time, the three True Gods sensed strong spatial fluctuations emerging around the battleship.
They seemed to be preparing some means of teleportation.
They knew they must quickly intercept the battleship.
Otherwise, once the opponents teleport away, capturing them would be exceedingly difficult.
Then, the three True Gods’ gaze locked onto the closest Zigu.
The skinned Beastman True God said, "Zigu, intercept the battleship."
"If you can stop them, we’ll help you find a way to take the last step!"
The other two True Gods echoed, "That’s right, we can help you!"
Originally full of fear, Zigu’s pupils contracted upon hearing the last words.
He knew what ’taking the last step’ meant.
This implied the three True Gods proposing to help him break into the True God Realm!
Thinking of this, Zigu swiftly suppressed his fear, a fierce intent forming within.
As the saying goes, one dies for wealth as birds perish for food, the conditions put forward by the three True Gods utterly convinced Zigu.
The next moment, Zigu used the movement speed of a top-tier Divine Spirit, instantly catching up to Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship.
Without the teleportation state, the Divine Demon Battleship’s movement speed was at best on par with a High-tier Demigod.
So they were easily caught by Zigu.
Meanwhile, Han Xing coldly watched the display of Zigu from the cockpit.
The God of Radiance said, "Master, resolving this guy leaves little time."
"He’s already on guard against master’s energy cannons, attacking now will allow him to dodge easily."
"Unless we directly use the Celestial Rail Strike Device, otherwise hope to take him down is slim."
Han Xing nodded.
The Celestial Rail Strike Device is his trump card.
Possessing True God level attack power and speed.
Even achieving time-space distortion effects.
Zigu, as a top-tier Divine Spirit, simply cannot dodge such an attack.
However, this simultaneously means revealing that Han Xing has means to counter True Gods.
Using the Burning Blood Arrow can equally easily kill Zigu.
But such means to kill True Gods, dealing with a top-tier Divine Spirit, is a complete overkill.

However, the Painful Empress was still outside, they needed to hurry and escape.
Han Xing took a deep breath, abandoning the idea.
So, he shouted to the Painful Empress, "Madeleine!
Get on!"
The Painful Empress also broke free from that terrifying state of imprisonment.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s call, she hesitated not at all, her figure flashing directly into the cabin.
Then, Han Xing directly engaged the teleportation state.
[Entering teleportation state, countdown five seconds...]
Five seconds is enough time for those True Gods to kill Han Xing and the others a thousand times!
Just now, hoping that the three-eyed man could hold on!
The Divine Demon Battleship advanced frantically, waiting for teleportation to be ready.
Meanwhile.
Seeing the Divine Demon Battleship about to escape, the attacks of the three True Gods grew increasingly frantic.
"Celestial Fall!
These humans took too much, they cannot leave!"
"Celestial Fall, once Yellow Sand returns, are you not afraid we will deal with you together?"
"Damn it!
Catch that ship!"
They kept deploying various means to capture Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship.
Yet the three-eyed man’s efforts unraveled them repeatedly.
The battle disturbances of the four True Gods behind kept echoing.
Their Divine Demon Battleship, like a small ship in a storm, shook violently.
Everyone’s heart hung in suspense.
At this moment, Zigu also reappeared from the rules.
He looked at the soon-to-depart battleship with horror, experiencing a sense of post-disaster survival.
At the same time, the three True Gods sensed strong spatial fluctuations emerging around the battleship.
They seemed to be preparing some means of teleportation.
They knew they must quickly intercept the battleship.
Otherwise, once the opponents teleport away, capturing them would be exceedingly difficult.
Then, the three True Gods’ gaze locked onto the closest Zigu.
The skinned Beastman True God said, "Zigu, intercept the battleship."
"If you can stop them, we’ll help you find a way to take the last step!"
The other two True Gods echoed, "That’s right, we can help you!"
Originally full of fear, Zigu’s pupils contracted upon hearing the last words.
He knew what ’taking the last step’ meant.
This implied the three True Gods proposing to help him break into the True God Realm!
Thinking of this, Zigu swiftly suppressed his fear, a fierce intent forming within.
As the saying goes, one dies for wealth as birds perish for food, the conditions put forward by the three True Gods utterly convinced Zigu.
The next moment, Zigu used the movement speed of a top-tier Divine Spirit, instantly catching up to Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship.
Without the teleportation state, the Divine Demon Battleship’s movement speed was at best on par with a High-tier Demigod.
So they were easily caught by Zigu.
Meanwhile, Han Xing coldly watched the display of Zigu from the cockpit.
The God of Radiance said, "Master, resolving this guy leaves little time."
"He’s already on guard against master’s energy cannons, attacking now will allow him to dodge easily."
"Unless we directly use the Celestial Rail Strike Device, otherwise hope to take him down is slim."
Han Xing nodded.
The Celestial Rail Strike Device is his trump card.
Possessing True God level attack power and speed.
Even achieving time-space distortion effects.
Zigu, as a top-tier Divine Spirit, simply cannot dodge such an attack.
However, this simultaneously means revealing that Han Xing has means to counter True Gods.
Using the Burning Blood Arrow can equally easily kill Zigu.
But such means to kill True Gods, dealing with a top-tier Divine Spirit, is a complete overkill.

chapters.title: Chapter 989 - 503: Blasting a Top-tier Divine Spirit
paragraphs: So, apart from the[Celestial Rail Strike Device]and[Hunter’s Burning Blood Arrow], are there any other means to deal with a top-tier Divine Spirit?
Han Xing’s thoughts were rapidly spinning in an extremely short period.
The next moment, it seemed like he remembered something.
When his Divine Power Value surpassed 100,000, he acquired a new skill called Infinite Domain.

One of its effects is: within the Infinite Domain, there’s an unlimited creative ability, allowing simulation once, recording the strongest ally attack while the domain is active, and causing 10% of the attack’s damage.
And Han Xing had always kept the domain active.
So what was the strongest attack he recorded just now?
Undoubtedly, it was the Divine Demon Battleship’s wave of cannon fire!
"Can this be simulated?"
Han Xing was a bit unsure, but he prepared to give it a try.
The next moment, a scene of the recent barrage appeared out of thin air in his mind.
And the scenes in his mind became increasingly realistic.
At the same time, a system alert appeared.
[Infinite Domain simulation successful: This attack will deal 10% damage. Simulation cooldown: 12 hours.]
The next moment, the Void Energy, which had been gradually settling down, was once again thrown into terrifying turbulence.
Zigu discovered in horror.
A large number of scaled-down energy beams, Dark Energy Shells, Frozen Star Shells, suddenly appeared out of nowhere without any warning.
And they were blasted toward it simultaneously!
The team members’ eyes lit up simultaneously.
Although they didn’t know what had happened.
But with such a sudden appearance of attacks that belonged to a battleship, it was certainly related to Han Xing.
Han Xing’s face also carried a look of surprise.
He didn’t expect the simulation function of[Infinite Domain]to be this terrifying.
Even the Divine Demon Battleship’s barrage could be simulated.
Although, it can only simulate 10% of the damage.
But with the battleship’s terrifying firepower, this wave of attacks can even instantly kill a Middle-tier Divine Spirit!
For Zigu, who had already suffered serious injuries and was on the brink of death, this was the last straw!
Boom!
Zigu couldn’t dodge in time and was directly covered by this attack.
The next moment, its colossal purple tree stump body showed a dense network of cracks.
And collapsed in the void, turning into piles of ashes.
Throughout the void, Zigu’s unwilling roar echoed.
Yet, no matter how unwilling it was, it was of no effect.
Because its body had been completely blasted into fragments.
Meanwhile.
The glowing Power of Rules in the sky also snapped directly.
The void shook violently.
It even turned blood-red.
This was the sign of a top-tier Divine Spirit’s death.
Not just the other spectating Divine Spirits.
Even the True Gods’ battlefield fell into a momentary pause.
After all, it was a top-tier Divine Spirit, and it died just like that.
At this point, the admiration in the eyes of the three-eyed man became even stronger.
"Good lad, I underestimated you a bit."
"With your current strength, you have the confidence to deal with a True God."
"Even without me today, I reckon you could escape Silent City."
Of course, despite saying that.
If it weren’t for the three-eyed man’s interference.
Even if Han Xing and his team could escape Silent City, they would likely pay a significant price.
And this was something he didn’t want to see.
Meanwhile, a system notification appeared next to Han Xing’s ear.
[Successfully killed Evil Tree Demon: Zigu (Top-tier Divine Spirit Level), gained Experience Value 2,713.3 billion, automatically absorbed opponent’s Divine Power Value, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Due to your excellent performance in this battle, you receive an additional reward of 50 layers of World Will, Legendary Points +2000]
A whopping reward of two thousand Legendary Points and 50 layers of World Will!
Han Xing was filled with wild joy.
And now, he finally realized how powerful this[Infinite Domain]was!
Infinite, unlimited!
As long as within this domain, any attack from allies can be simulated.
It’s truly formidable to an intimidating extent!
It sounds lengthy, but in reality, it all happened in less than three seconds.
At this moment, there were two seconds left before the teleportation state of the Divine Demon Battleship.
And Han Xing already saw a string of Power of Rules in the air transforming into dozens of light dots falling down.
Including the other spectating Divine Spirits, they saw the Rule Fragments dropping after Zigu’s death.
They wanted to rush over and snatch these Rule Fragments.
After all, this was the Power of Rules owned by a top-tier Divine Spirit.
However, due to the deterrence of the battleship, all Divine Spirits dared not act recklessly.
Han Xing then rushed directly and collected all these light points.
System prompt appeared.
[Acquired Power of Complete Rules · God of Ten Thousand Demons]

[Effect]: Mastering this Power of Rules allows breaking through from Demigod to reach Divine Realm, becoming a new God of Ten Thousand Demons, or can be directly absorbed to increase 40,000 Divine Power Value.
Upon seeing the item description, Han Xing was pleasantly surprised.
"Deserving of a top-tier Divine Spirit’s Divine Format, direct absorption can increase forty thousand Divine Power!"
At this moment, the entire Silent City was still immersed in the shock of the top-tier Divine Spirit’s death.
And after Han Xing grabbed the Power of Rules, he unhesitatingly re-entered the Divine Demon Battleship,
Meanwhile.
The teleportation countdown of the Divine Demon Battleship reached the last second.
[Countdown: Zero...]
[Begin teleportation.]
Buzz!
After a burst of terrifying energy fluctuation, the Divine Demon Battleship disappeared from the spot.
Those Divine Spirits, including those True Gods, looked at the battleship with complex expressions.

chapters.title: Chapter 990 - 503: Bombarding the Top-tier Divine Spirit (Part 2)
paragraphs: The main characters of today’s incident were supposed to be the Painful Empress and Zigu.
However, something happened that led to a battle of True God level.
Then, again, something happened causing all the top-tier divine spirits to unleash their auras.
In the end, this divine demon battleship forcefully entered the fray, taking away the Painful Empress and obliterating Zigu.
Everything happened so quickly, leaving everyone completely unable to react.
After today, the entire Silent City is likely to go madly investigating information about Han Xing and his group.
And those divine spirits will also deeply remember the names of these few humans.
A few seconds later, Han Xing and his companions appeared more than ten million kilometers away.
Even from so far away, they could clearly see that enormous giant wolf.
And the battlefield covered in blood in the void with the four True Gods nearby.
Han Xing and the others had arrived at Silent City in less than half a day, yet brought an unprecedented chaos to that place.
But now was not the time to lament these things.
Han Xing only wanted to quickly get away from Silent City.
After all, their harvest this time was truly terrifying!
A total of 274 divine formats, 68 complete powers of rules!
Among them, one was a True God level power of rules, and there were three top-tier divine spirit level powers of rules!
In addition, countless various divine stones, divine gold, and those divine artifact level materials.
The value contained within is simply unimaginable!
Those True Gods had been secretly observing Han Xing and his group for a long time, clearly knowing the terrifying resources they possessed.
So, even though they were now held up by the three-eyed man.
These True Gods would certainly not let Han Xing go.
Once they freed themselves from the entanglement of the three-eyed man, they would definitely rush into the void to hunt Han Xing down.
"Master, what should we do now?" the God of Radiance asked.
Han Xing replied directly, "First, escape! Escape to a safe place, and I’ll have you break through first."
"Then we’ll see if Madeleine can also break through to True God."
"By then, we will have two True God level combat powers in hand, then directly fight back to Silent City."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s plan, everyone turned serious.
Even the nearby Blade Armor Demon and the Painful Empress couldn’t help but marvel at this man’s audacity.
They had just been chased by three True Gods like a dog.
For the average person, the fright alone would have them thinking only of escaping quickly.
Yet this man was already contemplating a return assault.
What a crazy guy!
However, when the Painful Empress heard that Han Xing would help her break through to True God, her beautiful eyes immediately showed a look of surprise.
The divine demon battleship continued to advance at full speed.
As soon as the cooldown time for the teleportation function ended, it was activated without hesitation.
Under the blessing of two Sun Crown Steles.
The movement speed of the divine demon battleship in the void was already comparable to that of an average True God.
Buzz! Buzz!
The divine demon battleship flickered continuously.
Moving along this Forbidden Star River, constantly heading downward.
An hour later.
Back in Silent City.
The three-eyed man was still strenuously holding back the three True Gods, preventing them from leaving the battlefield to pursue Han Xing.
As for the other divine spirits, they did not dare return to Silent City at this time.
The battle of the four True Gods made Silent City shake continuously, going back now would be suicide.
And just then.
A desert suddenly appeared in the distant void.
The desert moved with an eerie speed.
Much like the folding of time and space, it instantly arrived above Silent City.
Then, this desert gradually transformed into a humanoid shape.
This was the True God of Yellow Sand.
His sand-like body stretched across the void.
He frowned and asked, "Celestial Fall, Sea Worm... what are you doing?"
His tone carried anger, clearly showing the True God of Yellow Sand was very upset.
However, the four True Gods on the field were engaged in battle to a point where they couldn’t be separated.
Even at the True God of Yellow Sand’s questioning, they just ignored him and continued their intense battle.
The True God of Yellow Sand’s face showed signs of irritation.
"Damn it, stop!"
In the next moment, he directly transformed into a desert, appearing in the battlefield of the four True Gods.
This boundless desert even completely engulfed the entire sky above Silent City.
The True God level attacks falling onto it were quickly dissipated by a sky full of sandstorms.
And the True God of Yellow Sand was truly enraged.
The desert began to spin wildly, like a spiral vortex.
Then, a terrifying energy erupted!
All four True Gods were separated.
The True Gods, including the three-eyed man, all looked warily at the True God of Yellow Sand.
The True God of Yellow Sand could remain in Silent City for so long due to his forcefulness, far stronger than an average True God.
At this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand transformed back into a humanoid.
With a slightly angry tone he asked, "Now, can any of you tell me what happened?"
None of the four True Gods spoke.
After all, as True Gods, they each had their pride and dignity.
The interrogative tone of the True God of Yellow Sand made them feel underestimated.
Moreover, under the watchful eyes of the hundreds of races’ living beings in Silent City.
They were even less willing to speak up.
At this point, the True God of Yellow Sand also knew the situation was a bit off.
Thus, with a wave of his hand, the four True Gods including himself vanished from the scene.
They needed to find another place to talk.
After the five True God-level strong left.
The chaotic energy in that area still hadn’t settled down.
At this time, the group of divine spirits finally dared to cautiously return to Silent City.

chapters.title: Chapter 991 - 503: Blasting a Top-tier Divine Spirit_3
paragraphs: At this moment, a divine-level Funeral Bell Demon Fish leapt back into the swamp it belonged to.
This Funeral Bell Demon Fish seemed to sense that something was amiss in its territory.
However, it couldn’t pinpoint what was wrong.
It vaguely felt that perhaps other creatures had entered its domain.
Thus, the Funeral Bell Demon Fish found a demigod-level kin and asked, "During the time I was away, did anything happen in the territory?"
The other Funeral Bell Demon Fish shook its head, "Lord God, there are no abnormal occurrences perceived."
Upon hearing this, the divine-level Funeral Bell Demon Fish nodded.
Yet, a vague uneasiness lingered in its heart.
It felt as if there really was an issue somewhere.
After pondering for a moment, the Funeral Bell Demon Fish began patrolling its territory.
When it reached the depths of the swamp, the tens of thousands of meters area, it immediately noticed the enormous spatial bubble.
And everything inside it had already been emptied!
At this moment, the Funeral Bell Demon Fish felt it must have seen incorrectly.
But upon confirming again, it felt as if struck by lightning!
"Heavens! Our Race’s treasure vault, our thousand-year accumulation!"
"Damn it! Which creature infiltrated our Race’s treasure vault!"
The furious roars echoed throughout the void.
Nearby formidable beings could discern the anger in the voice of the Funeral Bell Demon Fish.
Those powerhouses wondered, "The treasure vault of the Funeral Bell Demon Fish Race was stolen?"
"When did this happen?"
"Oh my, who on earth would dare, with such audacity, to intrude upon a race’s territory?"
The powerhouses discussed among themselves.
At this time, one powerhouse suddenly said, "Do you remember one True God mentioned that those human boys took away too many things?"
"Could it be those folks on that battleship did it?"
Upon hearing this speculation, other divine-level powerhouses also fell into contemplation, finding the reasoning quite plausible.
Then suddenly someone realized something.
"No, if it were just the treasure vault of the Funeral Bell Demon Fish Race that was stolen, it wouldn’t provoke those True Gods to act."
"Those humans must have taken far more than that!
"You all should quickly go back and check your own territories!"
Hearing the powerhouse’s reminder, other race powerhouses also realized this point.
Their pupils contracted instantly, and they dashed madly back to their territories.
However, not long after.
In the Silent City, an angry roar echoed once more.
"Damn it! Our Hemin Giant Race’s treasure vault was stolen too!"
This set off a thousand waves.
Powerhouses from various races began to check their treasure vaults one after another.
"Damn it, our Crystal Bone Demon Race’s treasure vault was also raided, not even leaving us one tile!"
"Aaaah! Our Sharp-toothed Demon Race’s thousand-year savings!"
"And our Bloodhoof Race, I want to kill those human punks!"
Furious roars resounded through Silent City.
Billions of beings watched with eyes filled with shock.
Given the current situation, at least dozens of races had one after another voiced their angry roars.
They all found their treasure vaults emptied, not even a single floor tile left.
Everyone couldn’t help but marvel at the insanity and audacity of those few humans!
And they realized why those True Gods would suddenly engage in battle.
Those races whose treasure vaults were luckily not raided now eyed with gratitude.
"Oh my... fortunately, our race wasn’t visited by those thieves, or I might react even more than them."
"Indeed, these guys acted too brutally, not leaving even one Philosopher’s Stone, simply digging three feet into the ground!"
"It’s outrageous..."
Regarding the situation in Silent City, Han Xing and others were unaware.
He was still maneuvering the Divine Demon Battleship in a frenzied escape.
The Painful Empress stood at the corner of the cabin, recovering from her injuries.
The God of Radiance was also deploying the Divine Power Domain, suppressing the void fluctuation caused by the battleship’s teleportation.
While also handling the leftover traces of their journey.
In this way, even if those True Gods were to chase after them, it would take longer to find them.
The battleship sped forward at full throttle.
Everyone was nervously eyeing the void behind them.
Luckily, after half a day of travel, they did not sense the arrival of any True God level presence.
It seemed that the three-eyed man’s combat power was extraordinarily formidable, capable of holding off three other True Gods for so long.
Han Xing and the others couldn’t help but breathe a little easier.
Time passed swiftly, and soon it had been a full day.
When the battleship reappeared.
It had already entered a strange void.
At this moment, the Painful Empress was in the cabin, soothing the other Blood Spiders.
From these Blood Spiders’ descriptions.
She understood that in the final moments, it was Han Xing who instructed the God of Radiance to take all her kin away.
The reason was quite simple.
Now, those True Gods in Silent City already knew the Painful Empress was allied with Han Xing.
She, along with this group of humans, had orchestrated this sensational conspiracy.
Leading to the treasure vaults of thirty-some races in Silent City being plundered completely.
So, once Han Xing took the Painful Empress away, even if those True Gods refused to lose face and go after ordinary blood spiders.
Other races might due to their anger, implicate other blood spiders.
The Painful Empress approached Han Xing, gratefully saying, "Master, thank you."
Her tone still carried its usual alluring charm, but it could be heard that this gratitude was sincere.
The Painful Empress valued her kin quite highly.
Han Xing shook his head, "It’s nothing, since you have already pledged allegiance to me, it is akin to being my people."
"The plan was ours, naturally we cannot let your kin be implicated."
Upon hearing this, the Painful Empress chuckled lightly, "Indeed~"
"Everything of mine belongs to my master..."

sentences.text: At this moment, a divine-level Funeral Bell Demon Fish leapt back into the swamp it belonged to.
This Funeral Bell Demon Fish seemed to sense that something was amiss in its territory.
However, it couldn’t pinpoint what was wrong.
It vaguely felt that perhaps other creatures had entered its domain.
Thus, the Funeral Bell Demon Fish found a demigod-level kin and asked, "During the time I was away, did anything happen in the territory?"
The other Funeral Bell Demon Fish shook its head, "Lord God, there are no abnormal occurrences perceived."
Upon hearing this, the divine-level Funeral Bell Demon Fish nodded.
Yet, a vague uneasiness lingered in its heart.
It felt as if there really was an issue somewhere.
After pondering for a moment, the Funeral Bell Demon Fish began patrolling its territory.
When it reached the depths of the swamp, the tens of thousands of meters area, it immediately noticed the enormous spatial bubble.
And everything inside it had already been emptied!
At this moment, the Funeral Bell Demon Fish felt it must have seen incorrectly.
But upon confirming again, it felt as if struck by lightning!
"Heavens!
Our Race’s treasure vault, our thousand-year accumulation!"
"Damn it!
Which creature infiltrated our Race’s treasure vault!"
The furious roars echoed throughout the void.
Nearby formidable beings could discern the anger in the voice of the Funeral Bell Demon Fish.
Those powerhouses wondered, "The treasure vault of the Funeral Bell Demon Fish Race was stolen?"
"When did this happen?"
"Oh my, who on earth would dare, with such audacity, to intrude upon a race’s territory?"
The powerhouses discussed among themselves.
At this time, one powerhouse suddenly said, "Do you remember one True God mentioned that those human boys took away too many things?"
"Could it be those folks on that battleship did it?"
Upon hearing this speculation, other divine-level powerhouses also fell into contemplation, finding the reasoning quite plausible.
Then suddenly someone realized something.
"No, if it were just the treasure vault of the Funeral Bell Demon Fish Race that was stolen, it wouldn’t provoke those True Gods to act."
"Those humans must have taken far more than that!
"You all should quickly go back and check your own territories!"
Hearing the powerhouse’s reminder, other race powerhouses also realized this point.
Their pupils contracted instantly, and they dashed madly back to their territories.
However, not long after.
In the Silent City, an angry roar echoed once more.
"Damn it!
Our Hemin Giant Race’s treasure vault was stolen too!"
This set off a thousand waves.
Powerhouses from various races began to check their treasure vaults one after another.
"Damn it, our Crystal Bone Demon Race’s treasure vault was also raided, not even leaving us one tile!"
"Aaaah!
Our Sharp-toothed Demon Race’s thousand-year savings!"
"And our Bloodhoof Race, I want to kill those human punks!"
Furious roars resounded through Silent City.
Billions of beings watched with eyes filled with shock.
Given the current situation, at least dozens of races had one after another voiced their angry roars.
They all found their treasure vaults emptied, not even a single floor tile left.
Everyone couldn’t help but marvel at the insanity and audacity of those few humans!
And they realized why those True Gods would suddenly engage in battle.
Those races whose treasure vaults were luckily not raided now eyed with gratitude.
"Oh my... fortunately, our race wasn’t visited by those thieves, or I might react even more than them."
"Indeed, these guys acted too brutally, not leaving even one Philosopher’s Stone, simply digging three feet into the ground!"
"It’s outrageous..."

He was still maneuvering the Divine Demon Battleship in a frenzied escape.
The Painful Empress stood at the corner of the cabin, recovering from her injuries.
The God of Radiance was also deploying the Divine Power Domain, suppressing the void fluctuation caused by the battleship’s teleportation.
While also handling the leftover traces of their journey.
In this way, even if those True Gods were to chase after them, it would take longer to find them.
The battleship sped forward at full throttle.
Everyone was nervously eyeing the void behind them.
Luckily, after half a day of travel, they did not sense the arrival of any True God level presence.
It seemed that the three-eyed man’s combat power was extraordinarily formidable, capable of holding off three other True Gods for so long.
Han Xing and the others couldn’t help but breathe a little easier.
Time passed swiftly, and soon it had been a full day.
When the battleship reappeared.
It had already entered a strange void.
At this moment, the Painful Empress was in the cabin, soothing the other Blood Spiders.
From these Blood Spiders’ descriptions.
She understood that in the final moments, it was Han Xing who instructed the God of Radiance to take all her kin away.
The reason was quite simple.

"Everything of mine belongs to my master..."

chapters.title: Chapter 992 - 504: Breaking Through to True God
paragraphs: "Everything of mine belongs to the master..."
The Painful Empress’s words seemed to have other implications, her elongated phoenix eyes gazing at Han Xing.
But Han Xing had no mind to focus on that now.
At this moment.
They had already arrived at the downstream position of the Forbidden Galaxy.
An entire day of travel with almost no pause, as soon as the teleportation cooldown of the Divine Demon Battleship ended, they immediately teleported again.
Han Xing was unsure if a True God was tracking him.
But now, he needed to seize the time to improve himself.
At the very least, possess the power to protect himself in front of those True Gods.
So, Han Xing directly shouted, "Everyone gather."
The next moment, four team members, the God of Radiance, Samoyed, all appeared beside Han Xing.
They were all watching Han Xing, waiting for his next command.
Han Xing directly asked, "Radiance, how long do you need to break through to True God?"
The God of Radiance pondered for a moment, "About half an hour. I need to absorb more Power of Rules to transform into the Tree of Rules."
"However, this will cause a big commotion."
"Even though we’ve left Silent City far behind, those True Gods can still sense it."
"Even those True Gods in the Forbidden Star River will sense my breakthrough."
Han Xing nodded upon hearing this.
Half an hour was within his expected time.
After all, they had already traveled billions of miles away from Silent City.
Even for a True God, crossing such a distance requires time.
As for the breakthrough being too loud, Han Xing was indifferent.
Anyway, he’s decided to strike back at Silent City once everyone here has been enhanced.
So sooner or later, they would face those True Gods.
Han Xing then looked at the Painful Empress beside him and continued,
"Madeleine, if I give you Zigu’s Power of Rules and three True God-level Divine Formats, can you immediately break through to True God?
Right now, he was holding a large amount of Power of Rules and Divine Formats, it could be said he was extravagant.
The Painful Empress pondered for a moment, gently nodded and said, "No problem, dear master~"
"However, I might need slightly longer than this guy."
Han Xing’s face instantly lit up with joy.
"Very good, then you should breakthrough together!"
As long as the Painful Empress can breakthrough.
Then Han Xing would directly possess two True God-level forces!
Striking back at Silent City would be even more assured.
Then, Han Xing directly handed the Rule of Ten Thousand Demons to the Painful Empress.
Also gave her three True God-level Divine Formats.
The Painful Empress chuckled as she accepted them, her gaze at Han Xing also filled with infatuation.
At this moment, Samoyed was staring expectantly at Han Xing.
And Han Xing glanced at him, asked, "One Power of Rules from a High-tier Divine Spirit, can you recover to the Middle-tier Divine Spirit’s strength?"
Samoyed immediately nodded excitedly, "Yes, definitely can, master!"
Although it was severely injured now, the Power of Rules from a High-tier Divine Spirit was already stronger than the rules it previously controlled.
Samoyed could completely replace the rules, allowing itself to quickly restore peak strength and even breakthrough further.
Han Xing nodded and directly handed it a glowing Nerve Network.
This Power of Rules is called Netherworld.
Samoyed accepted it with joy.
Then, Han Xing directly announced, "Next, I’ll wait for the God of Radiance and Madeleine to successfully breakthrough, and then break through to Demigod."
"Xiaoyongzi, Shen Yun, our task is to guard them until they successfully break through."
"No matter what happens, we cannot let their breakthrough fail."
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong solemnly nodded.
Han Xing had a premonition that the commotion during his breakthrough to Demigod might be bigger than theirs to True God.
In the depths of his mind, a great crisis loomed.
Especially after Han Xing’s Divine Power Value reached 100,000, that sense of crisis became even stronger.
So Han Xing was uncertain about what he would encounter when he began breaking through to Demigod.
And before his breakthrough, having two True Gods to assist him would provide greater assurance for Han Xing.
As Han Xing’s instructions were carried out, everyone began executing them immediately.
Their figures flashed onto the deck of the Divine Demon Battleship.
Meanwhile, the God of Radiance and the Painful Empress stood on opposite sides of the Void.
Han Xing and the others stood at the center of the battleship.
They watched Han Xing, and upon seeing him nod.
The two top-tier Divine Spirits didn’t hesitate for a moment and immediately began their breakthrough steps.
The God of Radiance first crushed the ’Shiny’ Divine Format in his hand.
A surge of pure Divine Power was directly absorbed by him!
The next moment!
A dazzling light emerged from the Power of Rules.
Under this rule, everyone present felt so insignificant.
Only that radiant figure seemed like the sole Dominator.
The God of Radiance then said, "Master, watch carefully."
"Next, I’ll perform the first step to transcend into True God."
Han Xing nodded.
Although he hadn’t yet reached the level to break through to True God.
But now, having a top demigod demonstrate steps to transcend to True God before them was a rare opportunity.
The next moment.
The God of Radiance spread his arms, his whole body directly merging into that rule.
In the depths, a voice seemed to appear in Han Xing and the others’ ears: "First step to transcend into True God, merge with the rule!"
"In this state, I’m going to completely integrate my body into the rule."

chapters.title: Chapter 993 - 504: Breaking Through to True God! (Part 2)
paragraphs: "Once successful, as long as the rules remain, I shall not die."
The crowd understood that this was the God of Radiance explaining to them.
In the next moment, an invisible fluctuation swept across overhead.
Whether it was Han Xing or Cheng Jianyong and others, they all felt the divine power within them stirring.
This represented the success of the God of Radiance.
The God of Radiance continued, "The first step of merging with the rules is simple, a method commonly used by most top-tier Divine Spirits."
"In this state, I am the rules, and the rules are me."
"Then, comes the second step of transforming into a True God, absorbing energy to strengthen the Power of Rules."
"After an extreme sublimation, transform the Power of Rules into the Tree of Rules."
After speaking, the God of Radiance began the second step.
Then, a terrifying energy storm appeared!
Rumble!
Han Xing and others only felt the Divine Demon Battleship underfoot shaking violently.
The terrifying energy storm swept across millions of miles of territory.
Even the Forbidden Star River began to tremble slightly.
Any breakthrough to a True God is quite astonishing.
Even separated by endless distances, those strong individuals would feel a slight awareness in their hearts.
The energy storm dispersed through the Endless Void, throughout the Forbidden Star River.
Within the galaxy, countless sealed entities awoke from their slumbering state.
They opened their long-dormant eyes, gazing intently at the starry galaxy.
It seemed they could see through this galaxy and peer into the Endless Void.
Within the galaxy, the sealed entities conversed among themselves.
"Is another strong individual about to break through to a True God?"
"Interesting, didn’t expect that even as the Era of Extinct Gods is about to arrive, so many strong individuals are still breaking through to True God."
Among them, an incredibly old and decayed presence chuckled lightly, "So what if they break through to True God?"
"Ultimately, they cannot grasp the true essence of rules. From the Age of Ten Thousand Gods to the Dark Age, onto the Abyss Era, how many talents have risen, how many have perished prematurely?"
"Those capable of killing us, there have only been two so far."
Upon hearing this, a True God far away laughed as well, "Year, you’ve been trapped here for so long, don’t be so arrogant."
"What if another Demon like Cheng emerges in the Holy Spirit Realm? We would all face the risk of demise!"
The ancient presence scoffed dismissively, "You’re thinking too much. It takes mere hundreds, if not thousands of years, for someone like Cheng to grow."
"And how long is left until the Era of Extinct Gods arrives, at most several decades?"
"No one can grow to Cheng’s level in such a short time."
"Moreover, when this Era of Extinct Gods arrives, we’ll all leave, thoroughly sealing all rule loopholes."
"From now on, there will be no more anomalies like Cheng and the Demon Emperor."
"And we will maintain our ruling position for billions of years, never decaying!"
"Immortal!!!"
His voice resonated across much of the Forbidden Star River.
All the sealed entities heard this declaration.
No one rebutted, for what he said was the truth.
At this time, a True God filled with majesty furrowed his brows and said, "It feels like the rule fluctuations of this newly-broken True God are somewhat familiar."
"Seems like it’s a Divine Spirit from the Light Lineage?"
Upon hearing this, another True God beside him asked puzzledly, "Judgement, isn’t there only the God of Light left among the Light Element Divine Spirits?"
"Could it be that fellow broke through to a True God?"
The True God of Judgment shook his head, "Doesn’t seem like it. The God of Light’s aura doesn’t have such strong fluctuations."
"This aura seems akin to one from our era."
The True God of Judgment’s words puzzled the other True Gods even more.
Just then, the True God of Judgment suddenly exclaimed, "I remembered!"
"He is the God of Radiance, the one chased by the God of Light from the Forbidden Land to the Endless Void."
"To think he hasn’t died and broke through to a True God after all these years!"
Following his words, other True Gods were also taken by surprise.
"Radiance..."
"It’s this guy after all..."
"Judgement, is the God of Radiance from the Descendant faction or the Seal faction? Can he first go to the Holy Spirit Realm and prematurely activate the rule seals to let us out?"
The God of Judgment looked towards the distance, at the direction filled with Galaxy Energy, and asked, "What do you think?"
"Back in the day, most of the Descendant faction Divine Spirits were hunted down, the remaining ones are sealed within the Forbidden Star River like us."
Upon hearing this, the Divine Spirits sighed somewhat regretfully.
At this time, a female voice came from afar.
"It’s alright, the Era of Extinct Gods is about to arrive, we’ve waited for thousands of years, a few more decades won’t make a difference."
"Everyone, just wait a bit longer..."
Following the female voice, the depths of the Forbidden Star River fell silent once more.
At the same time.
The area where Han Xing resided, surrounding millions of kilometers, had been filled with the intense Radiant Divine Power.
It seemed to have transformed into a realm of paradise.
The warm Radiant Divine Power enveloped everyone.
Han Xing and others even felt their bodies becoming younger and more vital.

Cheng Jianyong secretly clicked his tongue and said, "Old Guang’s divine power spillover during the breakthrough can take us back to our youth? I feel like I’ve grown younger by ten years, nearly turning into a teenager!"
Shen Yun laughed, "Come off it, you a teenager indeed."
"Even if you look younger, your voice with its roughness like a middle-aged man betrays you the moment you speak."

chapters.title: Chapter 994 - 504: Breaking Through to True God! (3)
paragraphs: Hearing Shen Yun’s mockery, Cheng Jianyong’s eyes bulged. "Damn, you’re the one who’s a dozens-of-years-old uncle!"
Han Xing ignored the two of them joking around.
He turned his gaze to the Painful Empress beside him.
By now, she had also finished absorbing the top-tier Rule of the Divine Spirit Han Xing had bestowed.
Plus three True God Level Laws.
At this moment, the Divine Power fluctuations on her body had already reached the level of the God of Radiance.
The Painful Empress looked at Han Xing, smiling charmingly.
"Master, this slave has finished absorbing everything. I can break through to True God at any time. Please give your slave the order~"
Han Xing nodded, then said directly, "Break through, Madeleine."
"Become a True God. Become the true Painful Empress."
Hearing that last sentence, the seduction in the Painful Empress’s eyes shifted into endless tenderness.
"As you command, my dear Master~"
The next instant, the Painful Empress summoned a Red nerve network.
Its scale was actually on par with the Power of Rules of the God of Radiance.
Then the Painful Empress directly fused her Flesh Body into the Rule.
As she began her breakthrough.
The second Energy Storm appeared once more.
Rumble—!
This region had originally been saturated with dense Radiant Divine Power.
And now, another surge of Red Divine Power was added.
The Void trembled, and even caused the riverbank of the Forbidden Galaxy to shake more violently.
Those True Gods who had originally quieted down opened their eyes once again.
In their eyes was an expression of disbelief, as they exclaimed, "Another powerhouse is breaking through to True God?"
"Who is it?"
This time, however, no one could answer.
Because the Painful Empress was neither from the Holy Spirit Realm, nor a Divine Spirit of their era.
The Painful Empress came from a small, unfamiliar world.
Within the Forbidden Star River, that female voice spoke again: "Within this fluctuation of Rules, I sensed intense pain and desire."
"In the Holy Spirit Realm, there is no powerhouse who controls this aspect of the Power of Rules. It should be a Divine Spirit from another world."
Hearing this explanation, the other True Gods all nodded in sudden realization.
However, because the commotion caused by two Divine Spirits breaking through to True Gods was just too great.
The fierce fluctuations even spread all the way to the Silent City!
The three-eyed man, the other three True Gods, and the True God of Yellow Sand were all within an unknown stretch of Void.
At this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand, together with the other three True Gods, stood on the same side.
They seemed intent on targeting this three-eyed man together.
The three-eyed man smiled faintly. "Yellow Sand, what are you trying to do?"
Opposite him, the True God of Yellow Sand wore a grave expression. "Celestial Fall, you know I’ve always been lenient with you."
"But this time, what you’ve done has already crossed my bottom line!"
"I must take you down and give the people of Silent City an explanation!"
The three-eyed man chuckled lightly. "Yellow Sand, let me make this clear first: this matter was not led by me from the beginning."
"The Worm, the Blood Demon, and the Shadow Beast—those three guys already knew about those humans’ actions, yet didn’t stop them."
"You should be well aware of what they had in mind, right?"
Hearing this, the faces of the three True Gods besieging the man all changed.
They argued, "Celestial Fall, don’t try to twist the truth here!"
"We did have that idea, but no matter what, those resources would ultimately return to our Silent City."
"Yet you not only blocked us, you let those humans get away, which is equivalent to handing over all the resources of Silent City to outsiders!"
"This is simply unforgivable!"
Hearing this, the True God of Yellow Sand at the side also nodded. "The Worm is right."
"Even if they truly had such intentions, once I found out, I would have made them return all the resources to the various races."
"But you, Celestial Fall, colluded with outsiders, stealing away a huge amount of our Silent City’s resources and causing massive losses to the races!"
"I must seize you and give the races an explanation!"
At these words, the three-eyed man also understood.
The True God of Yellow Sand was determined to deal with him today.
He shook his head with a soft laugh. "So what you mean is, you want to take down me—a Middle-tier True God—to report back to that group of ants?"
"You, Yellow Sand, have that kind of ability?"
The True God of Yellow Sand snorted coldly. "You’ll know whether I have it or not once you try!"
The battle was about to erupt.
At that moment, the three-eyed man and the True God of Yellow Sand both changed expression at the same time.
The strength of the other True Gods was slightly inferior.
They all seemed unaware of what had happened.
The skinless Beastman asked in confusion, "Yellow Sand, what’s going on?"
The True God of Yellow Sand took a deep breath, then said gravely, "There’s a powerhouse breaking through to True God!"
"And not just one—there are two powerhouses breaking through at the same time!"
"What?"
The three True Gods present all felt it was utterly unbelievable.
"Two powerhouses breaking through to True God? Who are they?"
Before the True God of Yellow Sand could explain.
An invisible fluctuation of Rules appeared.
In that instant, even those Top-tier Divine Spirits could sense that this fluctuation of Rules contained a powerful Power of Radiance.
At this moment, that Deep Sea Worm monster exclaimed in surprise, "Such a strong Light Element Rules fluctuation!"
"I remember now—among those who moved with those humans yesterday, one of them had this same Rules fluctuation on him!"
However, before their shock could end.
Another fluctuation of Rules swept over.
From this fluctuation of Rules, they sensed an aura of pain and desire.
In that instant, in the entire Silent City, all the True Gods’ faces changed.
"It’s the Painful Empress!"
"She’s breaking through to True God too!"
"Damn it! We should’ve thought of this earlier. They took away far too many things this time—they were bound to use all of it to boost their strength!"

chapters.title: Chapter 995 - 505: True God Metamorphosis, Enemy Assault!
paragraphs: At this moment, the entity completely shrouded in shadow, like a dark sphere, spoke: "What should we do? Suddenly, two more True Gods. At this rate, even we can’t handle those kids!"
The Deep Sea Worm said gravely, "Yellow Sand, can you sense the location of the rule fluctuations?"
The True God of Yellow Sand sensed carefully and nodded, "I have a vague position, but it’s too far away. It’ll take time to get there."
The Deep Sea Worm continued, "No matter how far it is, Yellow Sand, quickly take us there!"
The True God of Yellow Sand nodded.
However, before these four True Gods could act,
at that moment, the three-eyed man suddenly took out a longbow.
It looked like a wooden longbow picked randomly from the roadside.
Yet, the three-eyed man shot an arrow.
Thump thump thump!
This arrow contained immense piercing power and sealing power.
Nailing all four True Gods, including the True God of Yellow Sand, into the Void.
Their eyes were filled with expressions of disbelief.
The three-eyed man chuckled lightly, "You were about to leave, did you ask me?"
"Celestial Fall! Do you really want to go against us?"
The True God of Yellow Sand was extremely angry!
However, the three-eyed man replied indifferently, "Didn’t you just say you want to take me down to account for those ants."
"Now asking me this question, isn’t it a bit naive?"
Upon hearing this, the True God of Yellow Sand felt even more enraged.
"Celestial Fall, you are good!"
With those words, the God of Yellow Sand transformed into a massive desert, frantically crashing towards the three-eyed man.
The battle among True Gods ignited again.
But this time, from the original four against one, it turned into three against one.
The residents of Silent City below were bewildered, completely unaware of what was happening.
The battle fluctuations among the True Gods transmitted into Silent City.
Rumble!
The Void trembled madly.
The gods and demigods of all races instantly changed their expressions, "Oh god! They’re fighting again!"
"Quick, hide in the Divine Hall!"
The battle between True Gods, even a slight ripple, is not something those ordinary divine spirits can withstand.
Below, the demigods and legends were at risk of falling.
The entire Silent City descended into chaos again.
The three-eyed man wielded a wooden bow, battling four True Gods alone.
Though being singly oppressed, he wore a leisurely smile.
Not only that, he knew Silent City was the soft spot for these four gods.
During the battle, he deliberately led them towards Silent City.
The Deep Sea Worm unleashed an energy breath.
The three-eyed man’s figure flashed, evading the attack.
Then, that energy breath landed beneath Silent City, instantly evaporating a large Divine Hall area.
Inside was the habitat of the Ten Thousand Poison Mummies race.
Yet due to a breath from the True God, the entire race vanished in an instant.
"Damn it!"
"Worm, you reckless fool!"
The True God of Yellow Sand reprimanded from the side.
The Deep Sea Worm felt furious, mouth agape.
"Damn Celestial Fall!"
The next moment, others’ attacks came together.
However, the three-eyed man’s figure flashed again.
Those attacks all landed on Silent City.
Instantly, four or five races perished.
"Damn it! This guy’s deliberate!"
The Blood Demon was so furious his head was about to explode, veins bulging!
The True God of Yellow Sand also realized, the three-eyed man was intentional.
This way, they would fall into a passive state.
Thus, the True God of Yellow Sand said, "Don’t rush to deal with Celestial Fall."
"Blood Demon, Worm, Shadow Demon, you three hold Celestial Fall, I’ll stop the Painful Empress and another god from breaking through to True God!"
The three True Gods seemed to remember this.
Celestial Fall fought them to prevent them from interrupting the Painful Empress’s breakthrough.
And now, by not tackling Celestial Fall, it meant regaining control.
So, the three True Gods agreed simultaneously, "Okay!"
"Yellow Sand, go quickly!"
The True God of Yellow Sand suddenly transformed into a yellow stream of light, fleeting swiftly.
The three-eyed man drew his bowstring, his tone became slightly anxious, "Stop!"
However, as a middle-tier True God, Celestial Fall obviously couldn’t stop him.
In an instant, the yellow stream appeared millions of kilometers away.
Celestial Fall just wanted to pursue.
However, the three True Gods beside him started fully erupting, holding Celestial Fall firmly!
"Damn it!"
Celestial Fall’s tone showed slight agitation.
The Deep Sea Worm chuckled lightly, "Celestial Fall, now you can’t escape!"
"Still trying to stop us, naive!"
Celestial Fall’s expression turned grave, realizing he couldn’t break through the blockade of the three True Gods in a short time.
He glanced in the direction where the True God of Yellow Sand disappeared, praying inwardly, "Hope those kids can successfully break through."
With those words, Celestial Fall focused on his opponents.
A wave of killing intent burst from his body.
Meanwhile.
Where Han Xing and the others were.
The two top-tier divine spirits were both sprinting towards the True God Level.
Alongside them, Samoyed also started absorbing the high-tier divine level’s power of rules.
Everyone paid attention to the Painful Empress and the God of Radiance.
Watching their nerve networks begin extending more branches.
Like a sapling sprouting branches and leaves.
The progress of the God of Radiance was noticeably faster than the Painful Empress.
His power of rules had become incredibly robust, with countless branches extending from it.
