chapters.title: Chapter 996 - 505: True God Metamorphosis, Enemy Assault! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Not only that, faintly glowing leaves appeared on those branches.
A tree of rules is about to take shape.
In contrast, on the side of the Painful Empress, she is still in the stage of strengthening the power of rules and forming the trunk of the tree of rules.
Han Xing nodded secretly and said, "It looks like what the God of Radiance said is indeed correct."
"In half an hour, he can completely break through to become a True God."
Of course, this has to do with the God of Radiance having accumulated for many years.
Moreover, he is absorbing the rules of the God of Light, which is of the same attribute.
The breakthrough now can be said to be a natural progression.
Everyone also nodded.
Being able to witness the breakthrough process of two Divine Spirits to True God is a rare opportunity for them.
Time flew by, another twenty minutes passed.
The tree of rules of the God of Radiance has grown even larger.
The whole void can see a tree looming over everyone’s heads, emitting holy white light.
Rustle... rustle...
The branches of the tree of rules gently swayed.
An extremely terrifying power seemed to be about to be born!
Only the last step remains, and the God of Radiance can complete the transformation!
At that moment, Han Xing suddenly felt a mass of yellow light appear from a far away place.
That mass of light contained intense divine power fluctuations and was swiftly rushing towards them!
Seeing this, Samoyed, who had recovered to the strength of a middle-tier Divine Spirit, immediately exclaimed, "Master! It’s the True God of Yellow Sand!"
"He’s already on his way!"
Upon hearing this, everyone turned serious.
They hadn’t expected the True God from Silent City to arrive so quickly!
You should know, from the start of the God of Radiance’s breakthrough to now, only twenty minutes have passed!
Not only did the True God of Yellow Sand sense it, but he crossed countless billions of kilometers in such a short time.
It’s equivalent to them teleporting an entire day’s journey.
You should know, even with the Sun Crown Stele, the teleportation of the Divine Demon Battleship had the movement speed of a high-tier Divine Spirit.
And now, the movement speed of the True God of Yellow Sand is at least a hundred times faster than a high-tier Divine Spirit!
This is really terrifying!
Han Xing asked, "Samoyed, what is the strength of the True God of Yellow Sand?"
Samoyed replied, "Master, I don’t know how the strength of True Gods is divided."
"But the True God of Yellow Sand has held his position in Silent City for so long, and those hidden True Gods and top-tier Divine Spirits dare not act rashly."
"So I suspect that Yellow Sand must be much stronger than the average True God, estimated to have the combat power of a middle-tier True God!"
After hearing Samoyed’s analysis.
Han Xing’s expression grew even more serious.
In the Divine Realm, regardless of initial or middle tier, the gap between each tier is enormous.
Let alone, an even more formidable True God!
"Trouble, I didn’t expect to face a middle-tier True God right off the bat."
"If it were an ordinary True God, it would be somewhat better."
"Middle-tier True God, I really don’t know how terrifying their power is, whether Hunter’s arrow can deal with it."
Han Xing’s expression was grave.
Moreover, Hunter’s arrow has only one use opportunity, if it can’t take down the True God of Yellow Sand, then it’s a huge loss.
Beside them, the team members were also somewhat worried.
"Brother Xing, how should we act?"
Cheng Jianyong directly picked up the Holy Artifact: Immortal Giant.
As long as Han Xing orders, even if the opponent is a True God, he dares to confront them.
Although doing so is akin to courting death.
Han Xing analyzed, "Before Radiance completes the breakthrough, it won’t be long."
"We’ll use the Divine Demon Battleship to try to delay the True God of Yellow Sand, and stall for time.
"Once Radiance breaks through, and along with the Divine Demon Battleship, dealing with a middle-tier True God shouldn’t be an issue."
Upon hearing this, the team members understood that the situation had reached a very critical point.
Even Han Xing had to step in to deal with the True God of Yellow Sand.
Simultaneously, Han Xing directly controlled the Divine Demon Battleship, heading towards the rapidly approaching yellow light.
The opponent was too fast.
Almost within seconds, both parties had contact.
At this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand stopped, seeing this strange warship.
Yesterday, when Han Xing and his team caused a ruckus in Silent City, the True God of Yellow Sand was a step late and didn’t witness the Divine Demon Battleship annihilating Zigu.
Therefore, he is unaware of the terrifying power of the Divine Demon Battleship.
The two parties faced each other from an extremely distant distance.
And Han Xing had already placed his hand on the bowstring, ready to shoot an arrow at the first sign of aggression.
The True God of Yellow Sand, with his keen eyesight, saw Han Xing and the others standing on the battleship’s prow.
In an instant, the True God of Yellow Sand realized that these few humans were the ones that Worm and Blood Demon mentioned, who stole a large amount of treasure from Silent City!
"It’s you! You daring little fellows, how dare you act recklessly on the True God’s territory!"
"Now, you’ll pay the price!"
The True God of Yellow Sand said and was about to take action.
However, Han Xing unexpectedly said, "Presumably, you are the True God of Yellow Sand, I’ve long heard of your name!"
"The junior has just arrived at the Land of Divine War and has heard of the True God of Yellow Sand’s reputation, everyone says you are charming, a True God through the ages."
"Seeing now, indeed you are elegant and extraordinary!"
Han Xing started off with a mouthful of flattery.
The appearance of the True God of Yellow Sand, although humanoid.
But he looks like a big rock, completely unrelated to elegance and charm.
The True God of Yellow Sand froze for a moment, then confusedly said, "You know me?"
Han Xing’s eyes slightly moved.
Because the True God of Yellow Sand is actually willing to talk, which he didn’t expect.

Cheng Jianyong directly picked up the Holy Artifact: Immortal Giant.
As long as Han Xing orders, even if the opponent is a True God, he dares to confront them.
Although doing so is akin to courting death.
Han Xing analyzed, "Before Radiance completes the breakthrough, it won’t be long."
"We’ll use the Divine Demon Battleship to try to delay the True God of Yellow Sand, and stall for time.
"Once Radiance breaks through, and along with the Divine Demon Battleship, dealing with a middle-tier True God shouldn’t be an issue."
Upon hearing this, the team members understood that the situation had reached a very critical point.
Even Han Xing had to step in to deal with the True God of Yellow Sand.
Simultaneously, Han Xing directly controlled the Divine Demon Battleship, heading towards the rapidly approaching yellow light.
The opponent was too fast.
Almost within seconds, both parties had contact.
At this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand stopped, seeing this strange warship.
Yesterday, when Han Xing and his team caused a ruckus in Silent City, the True God of Yellow Sand was a step late and didn’t witness the Divine Demon Battleship annihilating Zigu.
Therefore, he is unaware of the terrifying power of the Divine Demon Battleship.
The two parties faced each other from an extremely distant distance.
And Han Xing had already placed his hand on the bowstring, ready to shoot an arrow at the first sign of aggression.
The True God of Yellow Sand, with his keen eyesight, saw Han Xing and the others standing on the battleship’s prow.
In an instant, the True God of Yellow Sand realized that these few humans were the ones that Worm and Blood Demon mentioned, who stole a large amount of treasure from Silent City!
"It’s you!
You daring little fellows, how dare you act recklessly on the True God’s territory!"
"Now, you’ll pay the price!"
The True God of Yellow Sand said and was about to take action.
However, Han Xing unexpectedly said, "Presumably, you are the True God of Yellow Sand, I’ve long heard of your name!"
"The junior has just arrived at the Land of Divine War and has heard of the True God of Yellow Sand’s reputation, everyone says you are charming, a True God through the ages."
"Seeing now, indeed you are elegant and extraordinary!"
Han Xing started off with a mouthful of flattery.
The appearance of the True God of Yellow Sand, although humanoid.
But he looks like a big rock, completely unrelated to elegance and charm.
The True God of Yellow Sand froze for a moment, then confusedly said, "You know me?"
Han Xing’s eyes slightly moved.
Because the True God of Yellow Sand is actually willing to talk, which he didn’t expect.

chapters.title: Chapter 997 - 505: True God Metamorphosis, Enemy Attack! (Part 3)
paragraphs: He was fully prepared to engage in battle with the True God of Yellow Sand upon arrival.
This way, Han Xing could delay for more time.
Perhaps, he wouldn’t even need to use the Hunter’s Burning Blood Arrow.
Han Xing smiled and said, "Of course, who in the entire Forbidden Star River doesn’t know your name!"
"Ever since we arrived at the Land of Divine War, the name we’ve heard the most is the True God of Yellow Sand."
"They say it was you who single-handedly crafted Silent City, allowing the Void Worlds to have a stable place to develop in the Land of Divine War."
"All mighty beings greatly respect and admire you, and we juniors have been long in awe as well."
The True God of Yellow Sand frowned, "If you kids know me, why did you go and cause trouble in my Silent City?"
"You better hand over everything you’ve stolen from Silent City, otherwise, I can crush you all in an instant!"
The True God of Yellow Sand was right.
As a Middle-tier True God, his strike speed was unimaginably fast.
He could indeed wipe out Han Xing and everyone in a split second.
However, Han Xing laughed and said, "This was indeed a rash act on our part; we later realized the gravity of our mistake."
"I will return all the materials we obtained from Silent City immediately."
"I hope the True God of Yellow Sand will give us a chance to mend our ways."
The True God of Yellow Sand was stunned for a moment; he didn’t expect this Legendary Level kid to be so sensible, seeing him arrive and willingly give up the goods.
He was prepared to expend some effort.
Han Xing then winked at Cheng Jianyong.
Cheng Jianyong understood and instantly disappeared from his place.
Han Xing smiled and said, "Please wait a moment, True God; my friend will retrieve the items shortly."
The True God of Yellow Sand nodded slightly.
One of the main reasons he hadn’t acted immediately was because of Han Xing’s Human Race identity.
After all, as the creator of Silent City,
He also knew that the being who originally created the Forbidden Star River was a human.
Though it’s confirmed that the terrifying being is already dead.
But now, standing beside the Forbidden Galaxy, the True God of Yellow Sand still harbored some fear.
After all, that being was simply too terrifying.
An arrow had slain countless divine spirits, and True Gods fell like rain.
Even now, the Forbidden Galaxy still seals numerous terrifying True Gods.
Moreover, over the years, the True God of Yellow Sand had learned some details of that battle back then.
He knew that Silent City he built was the resting place of that one’s partner.
He feared something might still remain from that one.
This was one reason why he was willing to communicate with Han Xing and the others.
If these humans were willing to return all the resources of Silent City, then the True God of Yellow Sand wouldn’t mind sparing their lives.
Consider it compensation for turning that one’s partner into a Void City.
However, after waiting a moment, the True God of Yellow Sand realized that the humans hadn’t handed over the items as promised.
As an ancient being,
He immediately realized that these humans were likely stalling for time.
He saw from the distance that the God of Radiance and the Tree of Rules were gradually taking shape, and uneasiness crept into his heart!
The True God of Yellow Sand angrily shouted, "Brats, how dare you deceive me!"
He extended his sand-like giant hand, which suddenly appeared over Han Xing and the others.
At this moment, a flustered Cheng Jianyong rushed out, carrying several large boxes.
"Wait! We got the items!"
The sand hand of the True God of Yellow Sand stopped in mid-air.
Cheng Jianyong, wiping his sweat nervously, said, "Sincere apologies, True God, because there were too many items, I spent a lot of time organizing them."
"Now everything has been brought here."
The suspicion remained in the eyes of the True God of Yellow Sand.
He tried probing with his divine power.
He quickly sensed that the boxes of Cheng Jianyong contained no divine power fluctuations!
"Damn! You’re tricking me again!"
The sand hand descended directly!
Yet, due to the change, Han Xing and the others delayed a few more seconds.
As the sand hand descended,
The threat of death surged forth.
To everyone including Han Xing, it felt like ants facing an elephant.
However, Han Xing, possessing the Passive Skill of All Things, instantly dispelled this terrifying pressure.
And at this very moment.
Han Xing unleashed the Infinite Domain again, simulating the scenario of a Divine Demon Battleship bombardment.
In the Void, suddenly appeared hundreds of terrifying aura shells and a light beam with a diameter of ten thousand meters!
Thick arcs, drizzling rain, and flying snowflakes.
These attacks at this moment all struck overhead.
"Boom!"
The countless terrifying shells made contact with the sand hand, triggering a violent explosion.
Though Infinite Domain could only simulate 10% of the attack power, it was enough to kill ordinary divine spirits and severely injure middle-tier divine spirits!
However, it was easily extinguished by the sand hand.
Unable to block even 0.1 seconds.
But that was enough.
Because by this time, the Energy Cannons on the Divine Demon Battleship had finished charging!
"Boom!"
All Calamity Defense Towers, Energy Cannons, including the Divine Demon Battleship Main Cannon, unleashed a simultaneous barrage.
This complete battleship barrage was many times stronger than what Han Xing had simulated!
In one collision, the sand hand dissipated.
The True God of Yellow Sand looked bewildered at how his attack was blocked by these Legendary demigod-level ants, as if witnessing something dreadful.
However, Han Xing showed no hesitation and directly activated the teleportation function.

chapters.title: Chapter 998 - 506: Battle! True God of Yellow Sand!
paragraphs: A voice broadcast came online.
"Entering Teleportation state, countdown five seconds..."
The True God of Yellow Sand said in shock, "You actually possess Technology Weapons this powerful?"
"That last Attack could already injure an ordinary True God!"
"In ten thousand years, I’ve only heard of Technology Weapons this strong once!"
"Who the hell are you?"
Han Xing didn’t answer.
Because right now he was maintaining the [Infinite Domain] State the whole time, and the Divine Demon Battleship’s firepower was boosted another tier.
At this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand also sensed intense spatial ripples appearing around that battleship.
They seemed to be using some kind of teleportation method, getting ready to escape.
The True God of Yellow Sand instantly shouted, "Don’t even think about running!"
The next moment, a giant Yellow Sand hand slapped toward them once more.
And right then, Han Xing activated the [Celestial Rail Strike Device] without any hesitation.
This was his first time using this thing against a True God.
A terrifying Energy Burst.
The True God of Yellow Sand instantly felt how horrific that glowing circular object was!
This was Power that could truly wound a True God!
And not only that, Han Xing also ordered all Energy Cannons on the battleship to enter a second-wave Charging Time State.
This was going to be the strongest strike he had ever unleashed in his life!
And also the most powerful enemy he had ever used it against.
The True God of Yellow Sand said in shock, "There’s actually something even more terrifying than those Energy Cannons, an even more terrifying Technology device!"
"How in the world were these things built?"
Han Xing didn’t reply; he simply stared quietly at the Celestial Rail Strike Device’s Energy Burst.
After the initial shock, the True God of Yellow Sand also regained his composure.
He said calmly, "Your Technology Weapons are indeed very strong. If you really landed a hit on me, it might cause me no small amount of injury."
"If it were an average True God, there’d even be a risk of falling!"
"However, you’ve vastly underestimated True God Level speed. Before you can Attack me, I’d have enough time to crush your battleship ten thousand times over!"
The True God of Yellow Sand wasn’t wrong.
Han Xing’s battleship was strong, but the hard flaw was that after each shot it had to recharge.
Several seconds of Charging Time at a time—in this kind of battlefield, it was basically like some clumsy child.
The True God of Yellow Sand acted exactly like that: he stretched out his giant hand without hesitation, trying to slap Han Xing and the others to pieces.
"Then die, all of you!"
The True God of Yellow Sand had already formed the intent to kill.
And right then, a strange item radiating endless Green energy appeared in Han Xing’s hand.
It was precisely the [Holy Artifact: Heart of the Endless Tree Sea].
This was also one of the few methods Han Xing had that could inflict a control Effect on a True God.
The next moment, endless vines began to madly surge and grow.
The entire Void was completely filled with vines.
This was Han Xing’s strongest control method; every time he used it, it never failed.
Even the True God of Yellow Sand was dragged and bound by those terrifying vines, forced to wildly unleash Yellow Sand palms to slap them away.
"A Holy Artifact! It’s actually a Holy Artifact Level item!"
He slapped frantically!
Boom! Boom boom!
The Void kept shaking.
Every slap of that giant hand could vaporize vines within a radius of a million kilometers.
However, the regrowth speed of the vines from the Heart of the Endless Tree Sea was even faster than his strikes!
After all, this thing was a Holy Artifact.
Something that stands above Rules, one of a kind.
The True God of Yellow Sand could only watch helplessly as every Energy Cannon on that battleship finished charging.
The next moment.
From the Celestial Rail Strike Device Center, a beam of Energy light erupted that twisted space-time.
At the same time.
The second wave of Divine Demon Battleship Main Cannon fire, Calamity Defense Towers, Frozen Star Cannons, Godslaying Cannons, and Dark Energy Cannons all rained down their Attacks!
"Boom!"
Everyone only felt a flash of white light in front of their eyes.
Even with their Demigod Level eyesight, they experienced a brief blindness.
This was because too many types of Energy exploded in that region in an instant, too mixed, too overpowering.
It triggered a strange reaction.
Even the True God’s Power of Rules and the Power of the Void were dimmed under this bombardment.
That region seemed to enter a state of space-time chaos.
Hum!
The intense light lasted for nearly five seconds!
Only then did everyone’s vision gradually recover.
And when they opened their eyes again.
They suddenly saw an endless desert appear out of nowhere in that region.
In the desert there stood a Divine Hall whose height was unknown, stretching tens of thousands of kilometers.
However, at this moment that desert had been blasted open into a void, and even that Divine Hall had half of it blown to pieces!
"Huh? Didn’t hit?"
"Where’s the True God of Yellow Sand?" Shen Yun asked, puzzled.
Han Xing shook his head. "No, we hit."
"That desert is the God of Yellow Sand’s true body. At the last moment, it released this desert to block the Divine Demon Battleship’s Attacks."
Everyone nodded in sudden realization.
They had really thought the True God of Yellow Sand used some special method to escape from the [Endless Entanglement] State.
Now it seemed the True God of Yellow Sand hadn’t escaped, but instead used some method to forcibly tank the strike.
Sure enough, as soon as Han Xing finished speaking.
That desert vanished.
The True God of Yellow Sand reappeared in the Void.
He looked at Han Xing’s battleship with a pale face, then spat out a mouthful of Blood of the True God.
That blood fell into the Void, and everyone watched it transform into countless grains of sand.
Every single one of those grains had a mass comparable to a small planet.
Because the mass was too terrifying.
Just that one mouthful of blood pressed so hard that the Void exploded into countless cracks.

chapters.title: Chapter 999 - 506: Battle! True God of Yellow Sand! (Part 2)
paragraphs: "Huff... huff..."
The True God of Yellow Sand kept taking deep breaths.
It took a few seconds to stabilize its injuries.
As mentioned before, if it were an ordinary True God, caught off guard by Han Xing’s concentrated attack,
even if it survived, it would be severely injured.
Thankfully, the True God of Yellow Sand was a middle-tier True God, with a body strong enough to withstand this wave of attack.
The True God of Yellow Sand spoke with a pale face, "Terrifying technological means..."
"No wonder you youngsters dare to act recklessly in my Silent City, with this move, even if the worm or Blood Demon came, they would suffer greatly!"
The True God of Yellow Sand expressed sincere admiration.
After all, for several Legends and True Gods to inflict such serious injuries on it was truly a feat worthy of pride, even worthy of being recorded in history.
At this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand looked sinisterly at Han Xing and his group.
"However, there are limits to the usage time of the Holy Artifact. You might trap me once, but now, what means will you use to handle me?"
Han Xing spread his hands.
Indeed, he had no more control methods.
But that didn’t mean he had no other means to deal with True Gods.
However, at this moment, the teleportation countdown of the Divine Demon Battleship had ended.
Previously, Han Xing’s terrifying concentrated attack disturbed space-time.
The teleportation progress of the Divine Demon Battleship had stalled.
Now, as space-time gradually stabilized,
the Divine Demon Battleship could start teleporting.
The True God of Yellow Sand sensed that the Divine Demon Battleship was about to escape into the Void.
In the next moment, he snorted coldly, "Trying to leave?"
The True God of Yellow Sand unleashed an explosion of terrifying Divine Power!
The Void within a million miles fell into intense vibrations!
Moreover, Han Xing even witnessed time reversing in the Void.
The group even saw themselves standing on the Divine Demon Battleship a few seconds ago.
With their eyes still closed.
"Boom, boom, boom!"
As the Divine Power of the True God of Yellow Sand continuously burst forth,
the range of its influence became increasingly terrifying!
The space within ten thousand miles was completely sealed by him.
Even the teleportation state of the Divine Demon Battleship was forcibly halted.
Han Xing once again realized the terror of a True God.
Indeed!
The Attack Power of the Celestial Rail Strike Device was already capable of affecting space-time rules.
And as an authentic True God, a middle-tier True God at that.
The True God of Yellow Sand could disturb the space-time of an entire area, which was only natural.
Everyone was shrouded in an overwhelming sense of oppression!
It seemed that this Void turbulence was about to spread to the breakthrough location of the God of Radiance and the Painful Empress.
Especially the Tree of Rules of the God of Radiance, which was constantly fluctuating in the Void.
It seemed that it was about to destroy the Divine Demon Battleship as well.
But at this moment.
The turbulence instantly calmed.
Time seemed to freeze.
A voice gently emerged.
The voice appeared as if it was by everyone’s ear, yet also in their minds.
"Light comes from the void..."
With the words, a beam of white light suddenly shot out from a very distant Void.
That white light seemed to be the oldest, most primitive light in the entire Void.
Wherever it passed, everything was illuminated.
Even the hidden rules’ threads in the Void, Void Beasts, and those special areas were revealed by this beam of light.
Apart from the vast distance, all True Gods sensed it.
They unanimously looked towards the direction where the light emerged, murmuring.
"The original rules..."
Then, the white light merged into the Tree of Rules, and a human-shaped virtual shadow with an indistinct face descended.
It was like the source of all divine things, unseeable, inspiring awe.
As he gently spoke, the entire Void seemed to become lively, countless radiant particles began to dance.
"Today, the Radiance Rule is established..."
"I decree: Under the Radiance, everything is steady, everything like a bubble."
"I decree: Flowers bloom in the Void, blooms eternal, I am eternal..."
"I decree..."
As the God of Radiance continuously established rules,
the entire Void indeed turned as he described.
The chaotic Void returned to peace, and sacred flowers grew within it.
This miraculous scene stunned the team members.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Words becoming reality! I actually witnessed true words becoming reality!"
"Damn! That’s amazing! My light!"
The team members were also filled with joy.
Because they knew, these phenomena indicated that the God of Radiance had successfully broken through to True God.
However, the True God of Yellow Sand beside them scoffed, "You’ve merely just entered True God, your rules cannot confine me."
"Break for me!"
Boom!
Endless yellow sand rapidly swept forward, each grain containing True God level Power of Rules.
The sacred light curtain across the Void was instantly torn open into a large hole.
In the blink of an eye, it was covered by the sandstorm.
However, the torn regions quickly emitted dazzling radiance again.
"Light... invisible and formless, omnipresent..."
"Where there’s dark, there’s light, where there’s light, there’s dark."
"It can pass through everything, it can illuminate everything..."
The God of Yellow Sand watched in shock as his Law of Yellow Sand was penetrated by endless radiance.
Even the entire Void was enveloped by the Divine Power of Radiance.
He actually possessed power capable of contending with the True God of Yellow Sand!
The True God of Yellow Sand also spoke with great disbelief, "How could this be? Didn’t you just step into the True God realm?"
In the next moment, he seemed to understand something.
"I see, you have mastered the Light Element Law, one of the oldest and strongest Laws, so upon breaking through, you already wield enough power to battle me!"

sentences.text: "Huff... huff..."
The True God of Yellow Sand kept taking deep breaths.
It took a few seconds to stabilize its injuries.
As mentioned before, if it were an ordinary True God, caught off guard by Han Xing’s concentrated attack,
even if it survived, it would be severely injured.
Thankfully, the True God of Yellow Sand was a middle-tier True God, with a body strong enough to withstand this wave of attack.
The True God of Yellow Sand spoke with a pale face, "Terrifying technological means..."
"No wonder you youngsters dare to act recklessly in my Silent City, with this move, even if the worm or Blood Demon came, they would suffer greatly!"
The True God of Yellow Sand expressed sincere admiration.
After all, for several Legends and True Gods to inflict such serious injuries on it was truly a feat worthy of pride, even worthy of being recorded in history.
At this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand looked sinisterly at Han Xing and his group.
"However, there are limits to the usage time of the Holy Artifact.
You might trap me once, but now, what means will you use to handle me?"
Han Xing spread his hands.
Indeed, he had no more control methods.
But that didn’t mean he had no other means to deal with True Gods.
However, at this moment, the teleportation countdown of the Divine Demon Battleship had ended.
Previously, Han Xing’s terrifying concentrated attack disturbed space-time.
The teleportation progress of the Divine Demon Battleship had stalled.
Now, as space-time gradually stabilized,
the Divine Demon Battleship could start teleporting.
The True God of Yellow Sand sensed that the Divine Demon Battleship was about to escape into the Void.
In the next moment, he snorted coldly, "Trying to leave?"
The True God of Yellow Sand unleashed an explosion of terrifying Divine Power!
The Void within a million miles fell into intense vibrations!
Moreover, Han Xing even witnessed time reversing in the Void.
The group even saw themselves standing on the Divine Demon Battleship a few seconds ago.
With their eyes still closed.
"Boom, boom, boom!"
As the Divine Power of the True God of Yellow Sand continuously burst forth,
the range of its influence became increasingly terrifying!
The space within ten thousand miles was completely sealed by him.
Even the teleportation state of the Divine Demon Battleship was forcibly halted.
Han Xing once again realized the terror of a True God.
Indeed!
The Attack Power of the Celestial Rail Strike Device was already capable of affecting space-time rules.
And as an authentic True God, a middle-tier True God at that.
The True God of Yellow Sand could disturb the space-time of an entire area, which was only natural.
Everyone was shrouded in an overwhelming sense of oppression!
It seemed that this Void turbulence was about to spread to the breakthrough location of the God of Radiance and the Painful Empress.
Especially the Tree of Rules of the God of Radiance, which was constantly fluctuating in the Void.
It seemed that it was about to destroy the Divine Demon Battleship as well.
But at this moment.
The turbulence instantly calmed.
Time seemed to freeze.
A voice gently emerged.
The voice appeared as if it was by everyone’s ear, yet also in their minds.
"Light comes from the void..."
With the words, a beam of white light suddenly shot out from a very distant Void.
That white light seemed to be the oldest, most primitive light in the entire Void.
Wherever it passed, everything was illuminated.
Even the hidden rules’ threads in the Void, Void Beasts, and those special areas were revealed by this beam of light.
Apart from the vast distance, all True Gods sensed it.
They unanimously looked towards the direction where the light emerged, murmuring.
"The original rules..."
Then, the white light merged into the Tree of Rules, and a human-shaped virtual shadow with an indistinct face descended.
It was like the source of all divine things, unseeable, inspiring awe.
As he gently spoke, the entire Void seemed to become lively, countless radiant particles began to dance.
"Today, the Radiance Rule is established..."
"I decree: Under the Radiance, everything is steady, everything like a bubble."
"I decree: Flowers bloom in the Void, blooms eternal, I am eternal..."
"I decree..."
As the God of Radiance continuously established rules,
the entire Void indeed turned as he described.
The chaotic Void returned to peace, and sacred flowers grew within it.
This miraculous scene stunned the team members.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Words becoming reality!
I actually witnessed true words becoming reality!"
"Damn!
That’s amazing!
My light!"
The team members were also filled with joy.
Because they knew, these phenomena indicated that the God of Radiance had successfully broken through to True God.
However, the True God of Yellow Sand beside them scoffed, "You’ve merely just entered True God, your rules cannot confine me."
"Break for me!"
Boom!
Endless yellow sand rapidly swept forward, each grain containing True God level Power of Rules.
The sacred light curtain across the Void was instantly torn open into a large hole.
In the blink of an eye, it was covered by the sandstorm.
However, the torn regions quickly emitted dazzling radiance again.
"Light... invisible and formless, omnipresent..."
"Where there’s dark, there’s light, where there’s light, there’s dark."
"It can pass through everything, it can illuminate everything..."
The God of Yellow Sand watched in shock as his Law of Yellow Sand was penetrated by endless radiance.
Even the entire Void was enveloped by the Divine Power of Radiance.
He actually possessed power capable of contending with the True God of Yellow Sand!
The True God of Yellow Sand also spoke with great disbelief, "How could this be?
Didn’t you just step into the True God realm?"
In the next moment, he seemed to understand something.
"I see, you have mastered the Light Element Law, one of the oldest and strongest Laws, so upon breaking through, you already wield enough power to battle me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1000 - 506: Battle! True God of Yellow Sand! (3)
paragraphs: The True God of Yellow Sand was shocked.
He never imagined that there would actually be someone who could master such an ancient law and break through to become a True God.
Wasn’t it said that the basic elemental laws of the world had all been mastered by some terrifying existence?
How did this guy manage it?
The God of Radiance did not answer but instead waved his hand, enveloping Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship.
He intended to transfer Han Xing and his people to a safe place to prevent them from being caught up in the battle between himself and Yellow Sand.
The True God of Yellow Sand immediately saw through the True God of Radiance’s intentions.
He chuckled lightly, "Your combat power is indeed strong, but you’re still too immature!"
With those words, the True God of Yellow Sand directly reached for Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship.
He intended to fight the True God of Radiance for the battleship and the people aboard it, including Han Xing.
Seeing the attack from the True God of Yellow Sand approaching.
The True God of Radiance remained calm and continued to speak softly, "Light... infinite variations."
In the next moment, the endless radiant divine power transformed into fine threads of rain.
Then, the Rain of Light poured down from the sky.
The gigantic hand of yellow sand was instantly riddled with holes by the Rain of Light.
This move completely stunned the True God of Yellow Sand.
He no longer regarded the God of Radiance—no, he should now be called the True God of Radiance—as a greenhorn who had just broken through to True God.
This scene showed that the God of Radiance was extremely familiar with his own power.
He had fully adapted to the power of the True God level.
The True God of Yellow Sand said with shock, "You’re not a newly-ascended True God; you are an extremely ancient Divine Spirit!"
He wasn’t wrong. The God of Radiance, having broken through during the Age of Ten Thousand Gods, was already extremely familiar with his power.
Furthermore, after so many years of refinement, he had absorbed the Law of Light, which was of the same system.
Therefore, as soon as the God of Radiance broke through, he could possess combat power far beyond that of an ordinary True God.
The True God of Yellow Sand solemnly looked at the opponent in front of him and the scene behind him.
Behind him, a massive blood-colored Tree of Rules was also about to take shape.
That was the Tree of Rules of the Painful Empress.
By then, when the Painful Empress broke through again.
Faced with the encirclement of two True Gods, plus the attacks from that kid’s battleship.
He, the True God of Yellow Sand, absolutely couldn’t withstand it!
However, as a True God, who hasn’t fought their way out of desperate situations?
The True God of Yellow Sand had experienced countless battles in his life, encountering situations far more dangerous than this many times over, let alone fearing the battle before him.
"Interesting, I originally thought that only a few rats had infiltrated my Silent City."
"Now it seems, you few are not rats, but rather deep sea crocodiles!"
"However, I, Yellow Sand, have stood my ground for so long in the Land of Divine War; naturally, I’m not to be trifled with!"
"You are called Radiance, aren’t you?"
"Very well, once I solve you, I’ll go capture that kid."
With those words, the True God of Yellow Sand burst forth with divine power from his entire body!
BOOM!
The Yellow Sand Domain clashed once again with the Radiant Domain.
And in an instant, the two True Gods crossed the endless time and space, suddenly engaging in close contact.
This method of teleportation was even more ridiculous than the teleportation of the Divine Demon Battleship.
The two terrifying beings engaged in the first wave of clashes.
Within 0.0001 seconds, they quickly retreated, pulling back millions of kilometers apart.
Then, the two figures returned to the starting point, beginning a second wave of conflict.
Moreover, as their blinking frequency increased.
The crowd even saw that the area already had countless Yellow Sand True Gods and tens of thousands of Radiant True Gods simultaneously attacking.
And every second, hundreds of thousands of Yellow Sand True Gods were being blasted apart.
Likewise, hundreds of thousands of Radiant True Gods were being crushed on the spot.
The spectators, including Han Xing, could no longer comprehend what was happening.
Cheng Jianyong wiped his forehead, shocked, "Damn... Is this really the battle of True Gods? I totally can’t understand it at all."
"How on earth are they fighting? Why are so many Yellow Sand True Gods and Gods of Radiance dying?"
The team members were equally baffled.
However, at that moment, Han Xing was in the [Infinite Domain] state.
He was doing everything he could to capture the actions of the God of Radiance, trying to mimic his attacks.
However, the battle at the True God level was simply too bizarre.
With the help of [Infinite Domain], Han Xing could only vaguely discern a little.
Their battle involved time and space.
For example, the God of Radiance who died the previous second might be the defeated Radiance from their encounter in the last 0.0001 milliseconds.
But in reality, they might have cut out the results of what happened in that one millisecond.
In other words, they hadn’t actually fought in that millisecond.
Yet at the same time, these encounters did actually exist.
As evidenced by the fluctuations accompanying each blow, capable of annihilating a high-tier Divine Spirit.
So, this made the situation even more bizarre.
As a Legend, Han Xing trying to understand the actions of True Gods felt like his brain was about to explode!
Cheng Jianyong looked on in surprise as smoke began to rise from Han Xing’s head.
"Oh my... Brother Xing, your hair is smoking!"
Following the sound, everyone turned their gaze towards Han Xing and indeed saw white smoke rising from his hair, with eyes wide as if witnessing something amazing.
Han Xing didn’t hear Cheng Jianyong’s call.
Because he was focusing all his spirit on keeping up with the movements of the God of Radiance.
Nevertheless, as a Legend, this was undoubtedly impossible.
Han Xing could feel his brain was close to crashing, about to cease functioning.
Had it not been for the existence of [Infinite Domain], Han Xing would have burst into pieces the moment he tried to capture the attack trajectory of a True God.
Gritting his teeth, Han Xing said, "Just a little more! Just a little more!"
"Hold on for me!"
He felt his consciousness becoming increasingly unclear.
At the critical moment, Han Xing fiercely bit his own tongue tip.
The sharp pain struck instantly, granting him a brief clarity!
